@payments_bp.route("/payment/<int:project_id>")
@login_required
def payment_page(project_id: int) -> ResponseReturnValue:
    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role not in ("customer", "client", "admin"):
        flash("Customer access required to view checkout.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

    if user_role == "admin":
        project = Project.query.get(project_id)
    else:
        project = Project.query.filter_by(id=project_id, customer_id=current_user.id).first()

    if not project:
        flash("Project not found or not accessible from your account.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

    addon_id = request.args.get("addon_id", type=int)
    addon = None
    if addon_id is not None:
        addon = ProjectAddOn.query.filter_by(id=addon_id, project_id=project.id).first()
        if addon is None or addon.status != "Pending Payment":
            flash("This scope add-on is unavailable or already paid.", "warning")
            return redirect(url_for("customer.project_details", project_id=project.id))

    if (
        addon is None
        and project.package.strip().casefold() == STARTER_RETAINER_PACKAGE.casefold()
    ):
        flash(
            "The Starter Retainer is billed through a recurring mandate. Set up AutoPay from the project workspace.",
            "info",
        )
        return redirect(url_for("customer.project_details", project_id=project.id))

    # Calculate paid milestone count on file
    paid_payments = Payment.query.filter_by(project_id=project.id, status="Paid", addon_id=None).all()
    paid_count = len(paid_payments)

    milestone_num = request.args.get("milestone", type=int)
    if not milestone_num:
        milestone_num = paid_count + 1

    if addon is not None:
        amount = Decimal(str(addon.amount))
        project_currency = sanitize_currency(addon.invoice.currency if addon.invoice else project.currency)
    else:
        # Check if the requested milestone is already paid
        if milestone_num <= paid_count:
            flash(f"Milestone {milestone_num} has already been authorized and paid.", "info")
            return redirect(url_for("customer.project_details", project_id=project.id))

        project_currency = sanitize_currency(project.currency)
        try:
            total_pkg_amount = get_package_price(
                project.package,
                project_currency,
                PACKAGE_PRICES,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            logger.warning("Cannot price project #%s for checkout: %s", project.id, exc)
            flash("This project package has no configured price in its billing currency.", "warning")
            return redirect(url_for("customer.project_details", project_id=project.id))

        if milestone_num in (2, 3):
            amount = (total_pkg_amount * Decimal("0.25")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
        else:
            amount = (total_pkg_amount * Decimal("0.50")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))

    amount_minor_units = to_minor_units(amount)
    is_test_mode = "placeholder" in RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.lower() or not RAZORPAY_KEY_ID

    return render_template(
        "payment.html",
        project=project,
        addon=addon,
        amount=amount_minor_units,
        gross_val=amount,
        milestone_num=milestone_num or 1,
        currency=project_currency,
        razorpay_key_id=RAZORPAY_KEY_ID,
        is_test_mode=is_test_mode,
    )


# =========================================================
# CREATE PAYMENT ORDER (GATEWAY + SANDBOX FALLBACK)
# =========================================================

@payments_bp.route("/payment/create-order/<int:project_id>", methods=["POST"])
@limiter.limit("20 per minute")
@login_required
def create_payment_order(project_id: int) -> ResponseReturnValue:
    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role not in ("customer", "client", "admin"):
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Customer access required."}), 403

    if user_role == "admin":
        project = Project.query.get(project_id)
    else:
        project = Project.query.filter_by(id=project_id, customer_id=current_user.id).first()

    if not project:
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Project not found."}), 404

    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
    addon_id = data.get("addon_id")

    # Scope Add-On Flow
    if addon_id is not None:
        try:
            addon_id = int(addon_id)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Invalid add-on parameter."}), 400

        addon = ProjectAddOn.query.filter_by(id=addon_id, project_id=project.id).first()
        if addon is None:
            return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Add-on not found."}), 404
        if addon.status != "Pending Payment":
            return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Add-on is not payable."}), 400

        currency = sanitize_currency(addon.invoice.currency if addon.invoice else project.currency)
        amount_minor = to_minor_units(addon.amount)

        existing_payment = Payment.query.filter_by(addon_id=addon.id, status="Created").first()
        if existing_payment:
            return jsonify({
                "success": True,
                "order_id": existing_payment.razorpay_order_id,
                "amount": amount_minor,
                "currency": currency,
                "key_id": RAZORPAY_KEY_ID,
            })

        order_id = None
        if razorpay_client and "placeholder" not in RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.lower() and RAZORPAY_KEY_ID:
            try:
                order = razorpay_client.order.create(
                    {
                        "amount": amount_minor,
                        "currency": currency,
                        "receipt": f"addon_{addon.id}_inv_{addon.invoice_id}",
                        "notes": {
                            "project_id": str(project.id),
                            "customer_id": str(project.customer_id),
                            "addon_id": str(addon.id),
                        },
                    }
                )
                order_id = _get_order_id(order)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.warning("Remote Razorpay order failed; activating sandbox fallback: %s", str(exc))

        if not order_id:
            order_id = f"order_sim_addon_{addon.id}_{secrets.token_hex(4)}"

        db.session.add(
            _create_payment_record(
                project_id=project.id,
                customer_id=project.customer_id,
                addon_id=addon.id,
                order_id=order_id,
                amount=Decimal(str(addon.amount)),
                currency=currency,
            )
        )
        db.session.commit()

        return jsonify({
            "success": True,
            "order_id": order_id,
            "amount": amount_minor,
            "currency": currency,
            "key_id": RAZORPAY_KEY_ID or "rzp_test_placeholder",
        })

    # Sequential Milestone Payment Flow (50 / 25 / 25)
    paid_payments = Payment.query.filter_by(project_id=project.id, status="Paid", addon_id=None).all()
    paid_count = len(paid_payments)

    if paid_count >= 3:
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "All milestone payments for this project have already been completed."}), 400

    raw_milestone = data.get("milestone")
    try:
        milestone_num = int(raw_milestone) if raw_milestone else (paid_count + 1)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        milestone_num = paid_count + 1

    if milestone_num <= paid_count:
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": f"Milestone {milestone_num} has already been authorized and paid."}), 400

    currency = sanitize_currency(project.currency)
    try:
        total_pkg = get_package_price(project.package, currency, PACKAGE_PRICES)
    except ValueError as exc:
        logger.warning("Cannot price project #%s for checkout: %s", project.id, exc)
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Package price is unconfigured."}), 400

    if milestone_num in (2, 3):
        amount = (total_pkg * Decimal("0.25")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
    elif milestone_num == 1:
        amount = (total_pkg * Decimal("0.50")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
    else:
        amount = total_pkg

    amount_minor = to_minor_units(amount)

    # Reuse existing Created payment if amounts match
    existing_created = Payment.query.filter_by(project_id=project.id, status="Created", addon_id=None).first()
    if existing_created is not None:
        if existing_created.amount == amount and existing_created.currency == currency:
            return jsonify({
                "success": True,
                "order_id": existing_created.razorpay_order_id,
                "amount": to_minor_units(existing_created.amount),
                "currency": existing_created.currency,
                "key_id": RAZORPAY_KEY_ID,
            })
        else:
            # Delete stale created payment record to allow new milestone amount
            db.session.delete(existing_created)
            db.session.flush()

    order_id = None
    if razorpay_client and "placeholder" not in RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.lower() and RAZORPAY_KEY_ID:
        try:
            order = razorpay_client.order.create(
                {
                    "amount": amount_minor,
                    "currency": currency,
                    "receipt": f"proj_{project.id}_m{milestone_num}_{secrets.token_hex(2)}",
                    "notes": {
                        "project_id": str(project.id),
                        "customer_id": str(project.customer_id),
                        "milestone": str(milestone_num),
                    },
                }
            )
            order_id = _get_order_id(order)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("Remote Razorpay order failed; activating sandbox order: %s", str(exc))

    if not order_id:
        order_id = f"order_sim_{project.id}_m{milestone_num}_{secrets.token_hex(4)}"

    db.session.add(
        _create_payment_record(
            project_id=project.id,
            customer_id=project.customer_id,
            order_id=order_id,
            amount=amount,
            currency=currency,
        )
    )
    db.session.commit()

    return jsonify({
        "success": True,
        "order_id": order_id,
        "amount": amount_minor,
        "currency": currency,
        "key_id": RAZORPAY_KEY_ID or "rzp_test_placeholder",
    })


# =========================================================
# CRASH-PROOF VERIFY PAYMENT ROUTE (GATEWAY + SANDBOX)
# =========================================================

@payments_bp.route("/payment/verify", methods=["POST"])
@payments_bp.route("/api/billing/verify-payment", methods=["POST"])
@limiter.limit("30 per minute")
@login_required
def verify_payment() -> ResponseReturnValue:
    db.session.rollback()
    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
    razorpay_order_id = data.get("razorpay_order_id", "").strip()
    razorpay_payment_id = data.get("razorpay_payment_id", "").strip()
    razorpay_signature = data.get("razorpay_signature", "").strip()

    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role not in ("customer", "client", "admin"):
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Customer access required."}), 403

    if not (razorpay_order_id and razorpay_payment_id):
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Missing verification parameters."}), 400

    payment = Payment.query.filter_by(razorpay_order_id=razorpay_order_id).first()
    if not payment:
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Payment record not found."}), 404

    if user_role != "admin" and payment.customer_id != current_user.id:
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Payment record not accessible."}), 404

    if payment.status == "Paid":
        return jsonify({
            "success": True,
            "message": "Payment already verified.",
            "project_id": payment.project_id,
            "addon_id": payment.addon_id,
        })

    is_simulated = razorpay_order_id.startswith("order_sim_") or "placeholder" in RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.lower()

    if not is_simulated and razorpay_client:
        try:
            razorpay_client.utility.verify_payment_signature(
                {
                    "razorpay_order_id": razorpay_order_id,
                    "razorpay_payment_id": razorpay_payment_id,
                    "razorpay_signature": razorpay_signature,
                }
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("Gateway signature verification failed: %s", str(exc))
            return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Invalid payment signature."}), 400

    try:
        payment.razorpay_payment_id = razorpay_payment_id
        payment.status = "Paid"
        payment.paid_at = get_ist_now()

        # Handle Scope Add-on Payment
        if payment.addon_id is not None:
            addon = _mark_addon_payment_paid(payment)
            ActivityLog.log_event(
                project_id=payment.project_id,
                action="PAYMENT_RECEIVED",
                description=f"Scope add-on payment of {format_currency(payment.amount, payment.currency)} verified.",
                user_id=payment.customer_id,
                category="success",
            )
            db.session.commit()
            return jsonify({
                "success": True,
                "message": "Add-on payment verified successfully.",
                "project_id": payment.project_id,
                "addon_id": addon.id,
            })

        # Calculate which milestone was just funded
        paid_count = Payment.query.filter_by(project_id=payment.project_id, status="Paid", addon_id=None).count()
        milestone_index = paid_count

        if payment.project_id:
            project = Project.query.get(payment.project_id)
            if project:
                if milestone_index == 1:
                    # Milestone 1 paid: opens sprint for specialist applications
                    if not project.assigned_professional_id:
                        project.status = "Pending Assignment"
                    else:
                        project.status = "In Progress"
                elif milestone_index in (2, 3):
                    project.status = "In Progress"

            ActivityLog.log_event(
                project_id=payment.project_id,
                action="PAYMENT_RECEIVED",
                description=f"Milestone {milestone_index} payment of {format_currency(payment.amount, payment.currency)} verified and held in escrow.",
                user_id=payment.customer_id,
                category="success",
            )

        talent_share, agency_share, tax_val = compute_financial_split(payment.amount, payment.currency)
        unique_inv_number = f"INV-2026-{payment.project_id or 1:04d}-M{milestone_index}-{secrets.token_hex(2).upper()}"

        new_inv = Invoice()
        new_inv.invoice_number = unique_inv_number
        new_inv.project_id = payment.project_id
        new_inv.customer_id = payment.customer_id
        new_inv.gross_amount = payment.amount
        new_inv.currency = payment.currency
        new_inv.talent_payout = talent_share
        new_inv.agency_profit = agency_share
        new_inv.tax_amount = tax_val
        new_inv.status = "Paid"
        new_inv.payout_status = "Pending Approval"
        new_inv.razorpay_order_id = razorpay_order_id
        db.session.add(new_inv)

        if payment.project_id:
            Milestone.query.filter_by(project_id=payment.project_id, status="pending").update(
                {"status": "funded"}, synchronize_session=False
            )

        db.session.commit()
        return jsonify({
            "success": True,
            "message": f"Milestone {milestone_index} payment verified successfully.",
            "project_id": payment.project_id,
        })

    except Exception as exc:
        db.session.rollback()
        logger.error("Database write failure in verify_payment: %s", str(exc), exc_info=True)
        return jsonify({"success": False, "message": f"Database write failure: {str(exc)}"}), 500

@payments_bp.route("/payment/simulate-test-payment/<int:project_id>", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def simulate_test_payment(project_id: int) -> ResponseReturnValue:
    """Instantly fund next milestone in development and redirect directly to project workbench."""
    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role not in ("customer", "client", "admin"):
        flash("Customer access required.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

    if user_role == "admin":
        project = Project.query.get_or_404(project_id)
    else:
        project = Project.query.filter_by(id=project_id, customer_id=current_user.id).first_or_404()

    paid_payments = Payment.query.filter_by(project_id=project.id, status="Paid", addon_id=None).all()
    paid_count = len(paid_payments)

    if paid_count >= 3:
        flash("All 3 milestones have already been authorized and settled.", "info")
        return redirect(url_for("customer.project_details", project_id=project.id))

    next_milestone = paid_count + 1
    currency = sanitize_currency(project.currency)
    total_pkg = get_package_price(project.package, currency, PACKAGE_PRICES)

    if next_milestone == 1:
        amount = (total_pkg * Decimal("0.50")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
    else:
        amount = (total_pkg * Decimal("0.25")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))

    payment = _create_payment_record(
        project_id=project.id,
        customer_id=project.customer_id,
        order_id=f"order_sim_{project.id}_m{next_milestone}_{secrets.token_hex(4)}",
        amount=amount,
        currency=currency,
    )
    payment.status = "Paid"
    payment.paid_at = get_ist_now()
    payment.razorpay_payment_id = f"pay_sim_m{next_milestone}_{secrets.token_hex(6)}"
    db.session.add(payment)

    if next_milestone == 1 and not project.assigned_professional_id:
        project.status = "Pending Assignment"
    else:
        project.status = "In Progress"

    talent_share, agency_share, tax_val = compute_financial_split(amount, currency)
    new_inv = Invoice()
    new_inv.invoice_number = f"INV-2026-{project.id:04d}-M{next_milestone}-{secrets.token_hex(2).upper()}"
    new_inv.project_id = project.id
    new_inv.customer_id = project.customer_id
    new_inv.gross_amount = amount
    new_inv.currency = currency
    new_inv.talent_payout = talent_share
    new_inv.agency_profit = agency_share
    new_inv.tax_amount = tax_val
    new_inv.status = "Paid"
    new_inv.payout_status = "Pending Approval"
    new_inv.razorpay_order_id = payment.razorpay_order_id
    db.session.add(new_inv)

    Milestone.query.filter_by(project_id=project.id, status="pending").update(
        {"status": "funded"}, synchronize_session=False
    )

    ActivityLog.log_event(
        project_id=project.id,
        action="PAYMENT_RECEIVED",
        description=f"Milestone {next_milestone} deposit of {format_currency(amount, currency)} verified and escrow held.",
        user_id=current_user.id,
        category="success",
    )

    db.session.commit()
    flash(f"Milestone {next_milestone} deposit of {format_currency(amount, currency)} successfully authorized! Escrow held.", "success")
    return redirect(url_for("customer.project_details", project_id=project.id))


# =========================================================
# ASYNC RAZORPAY WEBHOOKS
# =========================================================

@payments_bp.route("/webhook", methods=["POST"])
@payments_bp.route("/api/billing/webhook", methods=["POST"])
@payments_bp.route("/subscription/webhook", methods=["POST"])
@csrf.exempt
def razorpay_webhook() -> ResponseReturnValue:
    webhook_secret = os.environ.get("RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET")
    received_sig = request.headers.get("X-Razorpay-Signature")

    if not webhook_secret or not received_sig:
        return jsonify({"error": "Missing signature"}), 400

    raw_body = request.get_data()
    expected_sig = hmac.new(webhook_secret.encode("utf-8"), raw_body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_sig, received_sig):
        return jsonify({"error": "Signature mismatch"}), 403

    event_payload = request.get_json(silent=True)
    if not isinstance(event_payload, dict):
        return jsonify({"error": "Invalid webhook payload"}), 400

    if event_payload.get("event") == "payment.captured":
        entity = event_payload.get("payload", {}).get("payment", {}).get("entity", {})
        pid = entity.get("id")
        oid = entity.get("order_id")

        existing = Payment.query.filter_by(razorpay_payment_id=pid).first()
        if existing and existing.status == "Paid":
            return jsonify({"status": "ignored"}), 200

        order_payment = Payment.query.filter_by(razorpay_order_id=oid).first()
        if order_payment:
            order_payment.razorpay_payment_id = pid
            order_payment.status = "Paid"
            order_payment.paid_at = get_ist_now()

            if order_payment.addon_id is not None:
                _mark_addon_payment_paid(order_payment)
            elif order_payment.project_id:
                Project.query.filter_by(id=order_payment.project_id).update({"status": "In Progress"})

            db.session.commit()

    return jsonify({"status": "success"}), 200

# SPECIALIST DASHBOARD (EARNINGS & SPRINTS HUB)
# =========================================================

@professional_bp.route("/professional/dashboard")
@login_required
def professional_dashboard() -> ResponseReturnValue:
    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role != "professional":
        if user_role == "admin":
            return redirect(url_for("admin.admin_dashboard"))
        return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

    profile = ProfessionalProfile.query.filter_by(user_id=current_user.id).first()
    if not profile:
        profile = ProfessionalProfile()
        profile.user_id = current_user.id
        db.session.add(profile)
        db.session.commit()

    # Sync verification flag if profile was marked verified by admin
    if profile.verification_status == "Verified" and not current_user.is_verified:
        current_user.is_verified = True
        current_user.verification_status = "Verified"
        db.session.commit()

    # 1. Assigned Projects (Active Workspaces)
    my_applications = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(professional_id=current_user.id).all()
    assigned_projects = [app.project for app in my_applications if app.status == "Assigned" and app.project]
    my_applied_ids = [app.project_id for app in my_applications]

    completed_project_ids = [project.id for project in assigned_projects if project.status == "Completed"]
    redeemable_invoices: list[Invoice] = []
    if completed_project_ids:
        redeemable_invoices = (
            Invoice.query.filter(
                Invoice.project_id.in_(completed_project_ids),
                Invoice.status.ilike("Paid"),
                Invoice.payout_status.in_(("Pending Approval", "Requested", "Processing", "Settled")),
            )
            .order_by(Invoice.created_at.desc())
            .all()
        )

    # 2. Available Projects (Open Sprints)
    # RULE: Only projects where Milestone 1 (50% deposit) has actually been PAID appear!
    paid_project_ids = [
        p.project_id for p in Payment.query.filter(Payment.status.ilike("Paid")).all()
    ]

    open_projects = (
        Project.query.filter(
            Project.id.in_(paid_project_ids),              # Must have confirmed deposit
            Project.assigned_professional_id.is_(None),    # Not yet assigned
            Project.status != "Completed",
        )
        .order_by(Project.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )

    user_skills = set(profile.get_skills_list())
    matched_projects = []

    for proj in open_projects:
        proj_skills = set(proj.get_required_skills_list())
        overlap = user_skills.intersection(proj_skills) if (user_skills and proj_skills) else set()
        matched_projects.append({
            "project": proj,
            "overlap_skills": list(overlap),
            "match_count": len(overlap),
            "is_matched": bool(overlap) or not proj_skills,
        })

    # Sort matching projects to the top
    matched_projects.sort(key=lambda item: item["match_count"], reverse=True)
    available_projects = [item["project"] for item in matched_projects]

    # 3. Financial Ledger & Two-Stage Escrow Balances
    total_earned: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
    pending_payout: dict[str, Decimal] = {}

    for project in assigned_projects:
        currency = sanitize_currency(project.currency)
        gross = get_package_price(project.package, currency, PACKAGE_PRICES)
        talent_payout, _, _ = compute_financial_split(gross, currency)

        if project.status == "Completed":
            total_earned[currency] = total_earned.get(currency, Decimal("0.00")) + talent_payout
        elif project.status in {"In Progress", "Submitted", "Revision", "Assigned"}:
            pending_payout[currency] = pending_payout.get(currency, Decimal("0.00")) + talent_payout

    completed_sprints = sum(1 for p in assigned_projects if p.status == "Completed")
    active_sprints = sum(1 for p in assigned_projects if p.status in ["In Progress", "Submitted", "Revision", "Assigned"])

    # Recent Withdrawal Requests
    withdrawal_history = (
        WithdrawalRequest.query.filter_by(user_id=current_user.id)
        .order_by(WithdrawalRequest.requested_at.desc())
        .limit(10)
        .all()
    )

    completion_score = 85
    try:
        completion_score = calculate_professional_profile_completion(profile)
    except Exception:
        completion_score = 85

    return render_template(
        "professional_dashboard.html",
        profile=profile,
        assigned_projects=assigned_projects,
        available_projects=available_projects,
        matched_projects=matched_projects,
        redeemable_invoices=redeemable_invoices,
        my_applied_ids=my_applied_ids,
        total_earned=total_earned,
        pending_payout=pending_payout,
        pending_balance=profile.pending_balance,
        available_balance=profile.available_balance,
        withdrawal_history=withdrawal_history,
        completed_sprints=completed_sprints,
        active_sprints=active_sprints,
        completion_score=completion_score,
        package_prices=PACKAGE_PRICES,
        international_package_prices=INTERNATIONAL_PACKAGE_PRICES,
    )

@professional_bp.route("/professional/projects")
@login_required
def professional_projects() -> ResponseReturnValue:
    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role not in ("professional", "admin"):
        return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

    profile = ProfessionalProfile.query.filter_by(user_id=current_user.id).first()
    user_skills = set(profile.get_skills_list()) if profile else set()

    # RULE: Only projects where Milestone 1 (50% deposit) has actually been PAID appear!
    paid_project_ids = [
        p.project_id for p in Payment.query.filter(Payment.status.ilike("Paid")).all()
    ]

    open_projects = (
        Project.query.filter(
            Project.id.in_(paid_project_ids),              # Must have confirmed deposit
            Project.assigned_professional_id.is_(None),    # Not yet assigned
            Project.status != "Completed",
        )
        .order_by(Project.created_at.desc())
        .all()
    )
    
    my_applications = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(
        professional_id=current_user.id
    ).all()
    my_applied_ids = [app.project_id for app in my_applications]

    scored_projects = []
    for proj in open_projects:
        proj_skills = set(proj.get_required_skills_list())
        overlap = user_skills.intersection(proj_skills) if (user_skills and proj_skills) else set()
        scored_projects.append({
            "project": proj,
            "matched_skills": list(overlap),
            "match_count": len(overlap),
            "already_applied": proj.id in my_applied_ids,
        })

    # Sort matching projects to the top
    scored_projects.sort(key=lambda x: x["match_count"], reverse=True)

    return render_template(
        "professional_projects.html",
        projects=[item["project"] for item in scored_projects],
        scored_projects=scored_projects,
        my_applied_ids=my_applied_ids,
        profile=profile,
    )

@professional_bp.route("/professional/project/<int:project_id>/apply", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def apply_for_project(project_id: int) -> ResponseReturnValue:
    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role != "professional":
        flash("Specialist access required.", "danger")
        return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

    profile = ProfessionalProfile.query.filter_by(user_id=current_user.id).first()
    is_user_verified = bool(
        current_user.is_verified or (profile and profile.verification_status == "Verified")
    )

    # KYC Verification Gate
    if not is_user_verified:
        flash("Your specialist account is currently pending Admin KYC verification. Once verified by Admin, you can apply for sprints.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    project = Project.query.get_or_404(project_id)

    existing = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(
        project_id=project.id, professional_id=current_user.id
    ).first()

    if existing:
        flash(f"You have already applied for Sprint #{project.id}.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    proposal = request.form.get("proposal", "").strip()
    proposed_rate_str = request.form.get("proposed_rate", "").strip()
    estimated_days_str = request.form.get("estimated_days", "").strip()

    proposed_rate = None
    if proposed_rate_str:
        try:
            proposed_rate = Decimal(proposed_rate_str)
        except Exception:
            proposed_rate = None

    estimated_days = None
    if estimated_days_str and estimated_days_str.isdigit():
        estimated_days = int(estimated_days_str)

    app = ProfessionalProjectApplication()
    app.project_id = project.id
    app.professional_id = current_user.id
    app.proposal = proposal or "Interested in delivering this sprint with standard scope."
    app.proposed_rate = proposed_rate
    app.estimated_days = estimated_days
    app.status = "Applied"
    app.created_at = get_ist_now()

    db.session.add(app)

    # Notify Admins about the new application
    admins = User.query.filter_by(role="admin").all()
    for admin in admins:
        notif = Notification()
        notif.user_id = admin.id
        notif.title = f"New Specialist Application: Project #{project.id}"
        notif.message = f"{current_user.name} applied for '{project.package} - {project.service}'."
        notif.link = url_for("admin.admin_applications")
        db.session.add(notif)

    db.session.commit()

    flash(f"Application registered for Project #{project.id}. Agency administrator will review and assign.", "success")
    return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    return render_template(
        "professional_project_workspace.html",

@professional_bp.route("/professional/project/<int:project_id>/submit", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def submit_deliverable(project_id: int) -> ResponseReturnValue:
    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role not in ("professional", "admin"):
        flash("Specialist authorization required.", "danger")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    project = Project.query.get_or_404(project_id)

    if user_role != "admin" and not ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(
        project_id=project.id,
        professional_id=current_user.id,
        status="Assigned",
    ).first():
        flash("You are not assigned to this project.", "danger")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    live_url = request.form.get("live_url", "").strip()
    preview_url = request.form.get("preview_url", "").strip()
    source_url = request.form.get("source_url", "").strip()
    notes = request.form.get("completion_notes", "").strip()

    if not notes:
        flash("Please provide completion notes explaining what was built.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_project_workspace", project_id=project.id))

    try:
        attachment_url = save_project_upload(
            request.files.get("deliverable_file"),
            {"zip", "pdf", "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif"},
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        flash(str(exc), "danger")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_project_workspace", project_id=project.id))

    if attachment_url:
        notes += f"\n\nAttached Deliverable File: {attachment_url}"

    last_delivery = (
        ProjectDelivery.query.filter_by(project_id=project.id)
        .order_by(ProjectDelivery.submission_number.desc())
        .first()
    )
    next_num = (last_delivery.submission_number + 1) if last_delivery else 1

    delivery = ProjectDelivery()
    delivery.project_id = project.id
    delivery.professional_id = current_user.id
    delivery.submission_number = next_num
    delivery.live_url = live_url
    delivery.preview_url = preview_url
    delivery.source_url = source_url
    delivery.completion_notes = notes
    delivery.status = "Submitted"
    delivery.submitted_at = get_ist_now()

    db.session.add(delivery)

    project.status = "Submitted"
    summary = notes[:60] + ("..." if len(notes) > 60 else "")

    ActivityLog.log_event(
        project_id=project.id,
        action="DELIVERABLE_SUBMITTED",
        description=f"Specialist submitted deliverable #{next_num}: {summary}",
        user_id=current_user.id,
        category="accent",
    )
    if attachment_url:
        ActivityLog.log_event(
            project_id=project.id,
            action="DOCUMENT_UPLOADED",
            description="Specialist uploaded a deliverable file.",
            user_id=current_user.id,
            category="info",
        )

    # Notify all agency admins that a deliverable/staging URL has been submitted
    admins = User.query.filter_by(role="admin").all()
    for admin in admins:
        admin_notif = Notification()
        admin_notif.user_id = admin.id
        admin_notif.title = f"Deliverable Submitted: Project #{project.id}"
        admin_notif.message = f"{current_user.name} submitted a staging URL for '{project.service}'. Review required."
        admin_notif.link = url_for("admin.admin_project_review")
        db.session.add(admin_notif)
        
    db.session.commit()

    try:
        from app.services.whatsapp import notify_deliverable_ready
        client_phone = getattr(project.customer.customer_profile, "phone", None) if project.customer else None
        client_name = getattr(project.customer, "name", "Client") if project.customer else "Client"
        if client_phone:
            preview = preview_url or live_url or "https://yourdomain.com"
            notify_deliverable_ready(project.id, project.service, preview, client_phone, client_name)
    except Exception as e:
        flash(f"Deliverable submitted. (WhatsApp notification skipped: {str(e)})", "info")

    flash(f"Milestone deliverable #{next_num} submitted to the Review Gate.", "success")
    return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))


# =========================================================
# ESCROW WALLET REDEMPTION & WITHDRAWAL (UPI / BANK TRANSFER)
# =========================================================

@professional_bp.route("/professional/wallet/withdraw", methods=["POST"])
@login_required
def withdraw_funds() -> ResponseReturnValue:
    user_role = getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower()
    if user_role != "professional":
        flash("Specialist access required.", "danger")
        return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

    profile = ProfessionalProfile.query.filter_by(user_id=current_user.id).first()
    if not profile:
        flash("Profile not found.", "danger")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    try:
        amount = Decimal(request.form.get("amount", "0").strip())
    except Exception:
        flash("Please enter a valid numeric amount.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    if amount <= Decimal("0.00"):
        flash("Withdrawal amount must be greater than zero.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    current_avail = Decimal(str(profile.available_balance or 0))
    if amount > current_avail:
        flash(f"Requested amount (₹{amount}) exceeds available redeemable balance (₹{current_avail}).", "danger")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    payout_mode = request.form.get("payout_mode", "UPI").strip().upper()
    upi_id = request.form.get("upi_id", "").strip() or profile.upi_id
    bank_account = request.form.get("bank_account_number", "").strip() or profile.bank_account_number
    bank_ifsc = request.form.get("bank_ifsc", "").strip().upper() or profile.bank_ifsc
    beneficiary_name = request.form.get("bank_beneficiary_name", "").strip() or profile.bank_beneficiary_name or current_user.name

    if payout_mode == "UPI" and not upi_id:
        flash("Please provide a valid UPI ID (e.g. name@oksbi).", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    if payout_mode == "BANK_TRANSFER" and (not bank_account or not bank_ifsc):
        flash("Please provide complete bank account number and IFSC code.", "warning")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

    # 1. Deduct immediately from available balance to prevent double redemption
    profile.available_balance = current_avail - amount

    # 2. Save / update profile default banking info
    if upi_id:
        profile.upi_id = upi_id
    if bank_account:
        profile.bank_account_number = bank_account
    if bank_ifsc:
        profile.bank_ifsc = bank_ifsc
    if beneficiary_name:
        profile.bank_beneficiary_name = beneficiary_name

    # 3. Create Withdrawal Request
    req = WithdrawalRequest()
    req.user_id = current_user.id
    req.amount = amount
    req.currency = "INR"
    req.payout_mode = payout_mode
    req.upi_id = upi_id if payout_mode == "UPI" else None
    req.bank_account_number = bank_account if payout_mode == "BANK_TRANSFER" else None
    req.bank_ifsc = bank_ifsc if payout_mode == "BANK_TRANSFER" else None
    req.bank_beneficiary_name = beneficiary_name if payout_mode == "BANK_TRANSFER" else None
    req.status = "Pending"
    req.requested_at = get_ist_now()

    db.session.add(req)

    # 4. Log immutable wallet transaction
    tx = WalletTransaction()
    tx.user_id = current_user.id
    tx.amount = amount
    tx.currency = "INR"
    tx.transaction_type = "WITHDRAWAL_DEBIT"
    tx.reference_type = "WITHDRAWAL"
    tx.description = f"Requested redemption of ₹{amount} via {payout_mode}."
    tx.created_at = get_ist_now()
    db.session.add(tx)

    # 5. Notify all admins
    admins = User.query.filter_by(role="admin").all()
    for admin in admins:
        notif = Notification()
        notif.user_id = admin.id
        notif.title = f"New Payout Withdrawal Request: ₹{amount}"
        notif.message = f"{current_user.name} requested ₹{amount} redemption via {payout_mode}."
        notif.link = url_for("admin.admin_transactions")
        db.session.add(notif)

    db.session.commit()

    flash(f"Redemption request for ₹{amount} submitted. Admin will process transfer to your {payout_mode}.", "success")
    return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_dashboard"))

        profile.skills = request.form.get("skills", "").strip()
        profile.technologies = request.form.get("technologies", "").strip()
        profile.skill_level = request.form.get("skill_level", "").strip()
        profile.project_types = request.form.get("project_types", "").strip()

        profile.portfolio = request.form.get("portfolio", "").strip()
        profile.github = request.form.get("github", "").strip()
        profile.linkedin = request.form.get("linkedin", "").strip()

        profile.education = request.form.get("education", "").strip()
        profile.certifications = request.form.get("certifications", "").strip()
        profile.work_experience = request.form.get("work_experience", "").strip()
        profile.availability = request.form.get("availability", "Available (Full-Time)").strip()
        profile.current_workload = request.form.get("current_workload", "").strip()

        profile.profile_completed = True
        db.session.commit()
        flash("Comprehensive specialist profile & banking coordinates saved successfully.", "success")
        return redirect(url_for("professional.professional_profile"))

    return render_template("professional_profile.html", profile=profile)

@professional_bp.route("/professional/api/project/<int:project_id>/messages")
@login_required
def api_get_professional_messages(project_id: int):
    project = Project.query.get_or_404(project_id)
    is_assigned = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(
        project_id=project.id, professional_id=current_user.id, status="Assigned"
    ).first()
    if not is_assigned and getattr(current_user, "role", "").lower() != "admin":
        return jsonify({"error": "Unauthorized"}), 403

    messages = ChatMessage.query.filter_by(project_id=project.id).order_by(ChatMessage.created_at.asc()).all()
    data = [{
        "id": m.id,
        "sender_name": m.sender.name if m.sender else "Agency Team",
        "message": m.message,
        "time": m.created_at.strftime("%d %b %I:%M %p"),
        "is_me": m.sender_id == current_user.id
    } for m in messages]
    return jsonify({"success": True, "messages": data})

def is_valid_http_url(value: str | None) -> bool:
    """Validate that a supplied URL uses HTTP or HTTPS."""
    if not value:
        return False

    try:
        parsed = urlparse(value.strip())
        return parsed.scheme in ("http", "https") and bool(parsed.netloc)
    except Exception:
        return False

# USER MODEL (WITH ADMIN KYC VERIFICATION)
# =========================================================

class User(UserMixin, db.Model):
    __tablename__ = "user"

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    full_name = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=True)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    password = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    role = db.Column(db.String(30), default="customer", nullable=False)

    # Ignore Pylance override warning for Flask-Login compatibility
    is_active = db.Column(db.Boolean, default=True, nullable=False)  # type: ignore[override]

    # Admin KYC Verification Gate
    is_verified = db.Column(db.Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    verification_status = db.Column(db.String(30), default="Pending", nullable=False)  # Pending, Verified, Rejected
    verified_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=True)
    rejection_reason = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)

    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, server_default=db.func.now(), nullable=False)
    email_verified_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=True)
    session_version = db.Column(db.Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

    def set_password(self, password: str) -> None:
        """Hash and store the given plain-text password."""
        self.password = generate_password_hash(password)

    def check_password(self, password: str) -> bool:
        """Return True if the given plain-text password matches the stored hash."""
        return check_password_hash(self.password, password)

    # Relationships
    projects = db.relationship("Project", backref="customer", foreign_keys="Project.customer_id", lazy=True)
    assigned_projects = db.relationship(
        "Project", backref="assigned_professional", foreign_keys="Project.assigned_professional_id", lazy=True
    )
    professional_profile = db.relationship(
        "ProfessionalProfile",
        backref="user",
        uselist=False,
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
    )
    customer_profile = db.relationship(
        "CustomerProfile",
        backref="user",
        uselist=False,
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
    )
    businesses = db.relationship(
        "Business",
        back_populates="customer",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
        lazy=True,
    )
    withdrawal_requests = db.relationship(
        "WithdrawalRequest",
        back_populates="specialist",
        lazy=True,
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
    )
    wallet_transactions = db.relationship(
        "WalletTransaction",
        back_populates="user",
        lazy=True,
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
    )

# PROFESSIONAL PROFILE MODEL (WITH TWO-STAGE ESCROW WALLET)

class ProfessionalProfile(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = "professional_profile"

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer, db.ForeignKey("user.id"), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True
    )
    expertise = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False, default="")
    experience = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False, default="")
    about = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    phone = db.Column(db.String(30), nullable=True)
    location = db.Column(db.String(150), nullable=True)
    skills = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True) # Comma-separated or JSON list
    technologies = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    skill_level = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=True)
    project_types = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    portfolio = db.Column(db.String(500), nullable=True)
    github = db.Column(db.String(300), nullable=True)
    linkedin = db.Column(db.String(300), nullable=True)
    education = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    certifications = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    work_experience = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    availability = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=True)
    current_workload = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=True)

    # Two-Stage Escrow Ledger
    pending_balance = db.Column(db.Numeric(12, 2), default=0.00, nullable=False)   # Locked in-flight balance
    available_balance = db.Column(db.Numeric(12, 2), default=0.00, nullable=False) # Confirmed, ready for withdrawal

    # Payout & Banking Coordinates
    upi_id = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=True)
    bank_account_number = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=True)
    bank_ifsc = db.Column(db.String(20), nullable=True)
    bank_beneficiary_name = db.Column(db.String(120), nullable=True)
    pan_number = db.Column(db.String(20), nullable=True)

    verification_status = db.Column(db.String(30), default="Pending", nullable=False)
    verification_notes = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    profile_completed = db.Column(db.Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, server_default=db.func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at = db.Column(
        db.DateTime, server_default=db.func.now(), onupdate=db.func.now(), nullable=False
    )

    def get_skills_list(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return standardized list of clean lowercase skills."""
        if not self.skills:
            return []
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(self.skills)
            if isinstance(parsed, list):
                return [str(s).strip().lower() for s in parsed if str(s).strip()]
        except Exception:
            pass
        # Fallback to splitting commas or spaces
        tokens = re.split(r"[,|\n/]+", self.skills)
        return [t.strip().lower() for t in tokens if t.strip()]

    def get_performance_metrics(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        assigned_projects = (
            db.session.query(Project)
            .join(
                ProfessionalProjectApplication,
                ProfessionalProjectApplication.project_id == Project.id,
            )
            .filter(
                ProfessionalProjectApplication.professional_id == self.user_id,
                ProfessionalProjectApplication.status == "Assigned",
            )
            .all()
        )
        projects_by_id = {project.id: project for project in assigned_projects}
        project_ids = set(projects_by_id)
        completed_ids = {
            project.id for project in assigned_projects if project.status == "Completed"
        }

        deliveries = (
            ProjectDelivery.query.filter(
                ProjectDelivery.professional_id == self.user_id,
                ProjectDelivery.project_id.in_(project_ids),
            )
            .order_by(
                ProjectDelivery.project_id,
                ProjectDelivery.submission_number,
                ProjectDelivery.id,
            )
            .all()
            if project_ids
            else []
        )
        latest_deliveries = {}
        revision_count = 0
        for delivery in deliveries:
            latest_deliveries[delivery.project_id] = delivery
            if delivery.status == "Revision":
                revision_count += 1

        reviews = (
            Review.query.filter(Review.project_id.in_(completed_ids)).all()
            if completed_ids
            else []
        )
        ratings = [
            review.rating
            for review in reviews
            if review.rating is not None and 1 <= review.rating <= 5
        ]

        deadlines = {}
        if completed_ids:
            milestones = Milestone.query.filter(
                Milestone.project_id.in_(completed_ids),
                Milestone.due_date.isnot(None),
            ).all()
            for milestone in milestones:
                current_deadline = deadlines.get(milestone.project_id)
                if current_deadline is None or milestone.due_date > current_deadline:
                    deadlines[milestone.project_id] = milestone.due_date

        measurable_sprints = [
            project_id
            for project_id in completed_ids
            if project_id in deadlines and latest_deliveries.get(project_id) is not None
        ]
        on_time_sprints = sum(
            latest_deliveries[project_id].submitted_at <= deadlines[project_id]
            for project_id in measurable_sprints
        )
        early_sprints = sum(
            latest_deliveries[project_id].submitted_at < deadlines[project_id]
            for project_id in measurable_sprints
        )
        completed_count = len(completed_ids)
        assigned_count = len(project_ids)

        return {
            "completed_sprints": completed_count,
            "active_sprints": sum(
                project.status in {"Assigned", "In Progress", "Submitted", "Revision"}
                for project in projects_by_id.values()
            ),
            "completion_rate": (
                completed_count / assigned_count * 100 if assigned_count else None
            ),
            "on_time_rate": (
                on_time_sprints / len(measurable_sprints) * 100
                if measurable_sprints
                else None
            ),
            "average_rating": sum(ratings) / len(ratings) if ratings else None,
            "revision_count": revision_count,
            "early_sprints": early_sprints,
        }

    def get_completed_sprints_count(self) -> int:
        return self.get_performance_metrics()["completed_sprints"]

    def get_performance_rating(self) -> float | None:
        return self.get_performance_metrics()["average_rating"]

    def get_on_time_delivery_rate(self) -> float | None:
        return self.get_performance_metrics()["on_time_rate"]

    def get_badges(self, metrics: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        metrics = metrics or self.get_performance_metrics()
        badges = []
        rating = metrics["average_rating"]
        if rating is not None and rating >= 4.8 and metrics["revision_count"] == 0:
            badges.append({
                "name": "Top Rated ⭐",
                "color": "badge-emerald",
            })
        if metrics["early_sprints"] > 0:
            badges.append({
                "name": "Speed Demon ⚡",
                "color": "badge-indigo",
            })
        if metrics["completion_rate"] is not None and metrics["completion_rate"] == 100:
            badges.append({
                "name": "Reliable 🎯",
                "color": "badge-emerald",
            })
        if self.verification_status == "Verified":
            badges.append({
                "name": "Verified Pro 🛡️",
                "color": "badge-emerald",
            })
        return badges


# =========================================================
# PROJECT MODEL (WITH SKILL-MATCHING & WORKSPACE LINKING)
# =========================================================

class Project(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = "project"

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    customer_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer, db.ForeignKey("user.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    business_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer, db.ForeignKey("business.id"), nullable=True, index=True
    )
    business = db.relationship("Business", back_populates="projects")
    service = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    package = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    currency = db.Column(db.String(3), nullable=False, default="INR")
    requirements = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    
    # Skill-Matching Tags (JSON string or comma-separated)
    required_skills = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)

    # Status State Machine:
    # 'Pending Assignment' (Open for Bids) -> 'Assigned' -> 'In Progress' -> 'Submitted' -> 'Completed'
    status = db.Column(db.String(50), default="Pending Assignment", nullable=False)
    
    assigned_professional_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer, db.ForeignKey("user.id"), nullable=True, index=True
    )
    
    revision_comment = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    payment_reminder_sent_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=True)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, server_default=db.func.now(), nullable=False)

    milestones = db.relationship(
        "Milestone",
        backref="project",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
        lazy=True,
    )

    def get_required_skills_list(self) -> list[str]:
        """Return standardized list of clean lowercase project skills."""
        if not self.required_skills:
            return []
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(self.required_skills)
            if isinstance(parsed, list):
                return [str(s).strip().lower() for s in parsed if str(s).strip()]
        except Exception:
            pass
        tokens = re.split(r"[,|\n/]+", self.required_skills)
        return [t.strip().lower() for t in tokens if t.strip()]

class ActivityLog(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = "activity_logs"
    __table_args__ = (
        db.Index("ix_activity_logs_project_created_at", "project_id", "created_at"),
    )

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    project_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer, db.ForeignKey("project.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    user_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer, db.ForeignKey("user.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True, index=True
    )
    action = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    category = db.Column(db.String(30), default="info", nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=get_ist_now, nullable=False)

    project = db.relationship("Project", backref=db.backref("activity_logs", cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy=True))
    actor = db.relationship("User", backref="activity_logs", foreign_keys=[user_id])

    @property
    def event_type(self) -> str:
        """Backwards compatibility alias for action."""
        return self.action

    @classmethod
    def log_event(
        cls,
        project_id: int | None = None,
        action: str | None = None,
        description: str | None = None,
        user_id: int | None = None,
        category: str = "info",
        **kwargs,
    ) -> "ActivityLog":
        """Factory helper method for logging activity events across blueprints."""
        log = cls()
        log.project_id = project_id
        log.user_id = user_id
        log.action = action or "ACTIVITY"
        log.description = description or ""
        log.category = category or "info"
        db.session.add(log)
        return log


class StripeWebhookEvent(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = "stripe_webhook_event"

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    event_id = db.Column(
        db.String(100), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True
    )
    event_type = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    project_id = db.Column(
        db.Integer, db.ForeignKey("project.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=True, index=True
    )
    processed_at = db.Column(
        db.DateTime, nullable=False, default=get_ist_now
    )
    payload = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)

    project = db.relationship("Project", backref="stripe_webhook_events")

    @classmethod
    def is_processed(cls, event_id: str) -> bool:
        return db.session.query(cls).filter_by(event_id=event_id).first() is not None

    @classmethod
    def mark_processed(
        cls,
        event_id: str,
        event_type: str,
        project_id: int | None = None,
        payload: str | None = None,
    ) -> "StripeWebhookEvent":
        event = cls()
        event.event_id = event_id
        event.event_type = event_type
        event.project_id = project_id
        event.payload = payload
        db.session.add(event)
        return event

# PROFILE & EXPERTISE HELPERS
# =========================================================

def calculate_professional_profile_completion(profile: ProfessionalProfile | None) -> int:
    if not profile:
        return 0
    fields = [
        profile.expertise, profile.experience, profile.about, profile.phone,
        profile.location, profile.skills, profile.technologies, profile.skill_level,
        profile.project_types, profile.portfolio, profile.github, profile.linkedin,
        profile.education, profile.certifications, profile.work_experience,
        profile.availability, profile.current_workload
    ]
    completed = sum(1 for f in fields if f and str(f).strip())
    total = len(fields)
    return round((completed / total) * 100) if total else 0


def calculate_customer_profile_completion(profile: CustomerProfile | None) -> int:
    if not profile:
        return 0
    fields = [
        profile.phone, profile.location, profile.business_name, profile.business_type,
        profile.website, profile.social_links, profile.business_description,
        profile.target_audience, profile.business_goals, profile.preferred_budget
    ]
    completed = sum(1 for f in fields if f and str(f).strip())
    total = len(fields)
    return round((completed / total) * 100) if total else 0


def get_latest_project_delivery(project_id: int) -> ProjectDelivery | None:
    return (
        ProjectDelivery.query.filter_by(project_id=project_id)
        .order_by(ProjectDelivery.submission_number.desc())
        .first()
    )

    )

        if user_id is not None:
            self.user_id = user_id
        if title is not None:
            self.title = title
        if message is not None:
            self.message = message
        if link is not None:
            self.link = link

            self.project_id = project_id
        if raised_by_user_id is not None:
            self.raised_by_user_id = raised_by_user_id
        if reason is not None:
            self.reason = reason
        self.status = status

@public_bp.route("/api/free-audit", methods=["POST"])
@csrf.exempt
def free_audit():
    if request.is_json:
        data = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
        business_url = data.get("business_url", "").strip()
        phone = data.get("phone", "").strip()
        email = data.get("email", "").strip()
    else:
        business_url = request.form.get("business_url", "").strip()
        phone = request.form.get("phone", "").strip()
        email = request.form.get("email", "").strip()

    if not business_url:
        if request.is_json:
            return jsonify({"success": False, "message": "Website URL or business name is required."}), 400
        flash("Please enter a valid website URL or business name.", "error")
        return redirect(url_for("public.index") + "#audit")

    current_app.logger.info(f"Audit requested for {business_url} (Phone: {phone}, Email: {email})")

    if request.is_json:
        return jsonify({
            "success": True,
            "message": "Audit requested successfully! Our team will contact you shortly."
        }), 200

    flash("Audit requested successfully! Our team is analyzing your site and will reach out shortly.", "success")
    return redirect(url_for("public.index") + "#audit")

--- FILE: .\app\services\email.py ---
"""Transactional SMTP and Console Email Delivery Engine for AgencyOS."""

import logging
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

from flask import current_app

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class EmailDeliveryError(Exception):
    """Raised when email delivery cannot be completed safely."""


def _build_message(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> EmailMessage:
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["To"] = to
    message["From"] = current_app.config.get(
        "MAIL_DEFAULT_SENDER", "no-reply@agencyos.local"
    )
    message["Subject"] = subject
    message.set_content(body)
    return message


def send_email(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> None:
    """Send an email using the configured backend.

    The console backend records messages only during tests and never logs
    message bodies, tokens, or recovery links.
    """
    backend = current_app.config.get("MAIL_BACKEND", "console")
    suppress = current_app.config.get("MAIL_SUPPRESS_SEND", False)

    if suppress:
        return

    if backend == "console":
        if current_app.config.get("TESTING"):
            current_app.config.setdefault("TEST_EMAILS", []).append(
                {
                    "to": to,
                    "subject": subject,
                    "body": body,
                }
            )
        else:
            logger.info("Email queued for %s", to)
        return

    if backend != "smtp":
        raise EmailDeliveryError(f"Unsupported mail backend: {backend}")

    server = current_app.config.get("MAIL_SERVER", "")
    port = current_app.config.get("MAIL_PORT", 587)
    use_tls = current_app.config.get("MAIL_USE_TLS", True)
    username = current_app.config.get("MAIL_USERNAME", "")
    password = current_app.config.get("MAIL_PASSWORD", "")
    sender = current_app.config.get(
        "MAIL_DEFAULT_SENDER", "no-reply@agencyos.local"
    )

    if not server or not sender:
        raise EmailDeliveryError("SMTP mail is not fully configured.")

    try:
        with smtplib.SMTP(server, port, timeout=10) as smtp:
            if use_tls:
                smtp.starttls()
            if username:
                smtp.login(username, password)
            smtp.send_message(
                _build_message(to, subject, body),
                from_addr=sender,
                to_addrs=[to],
            )
    except (OSError, smtplib.SMTPException) as exc:
        logger.error("Email delivery failed: %s", type(exc).__name__)
        raise EmailDeliveryError("Email delivery failed.") from exc

--- FILE: .\app\services\payouts.py ---
"""AgencyOS RazorpayX Payouts Service.

Executes direct fund disbursements to specialist UPI IDs or Bank accounts via RazorpayX API,
with automatic sandbox simulation fallback for local development.
"""

import base64
import json
import logging
import os
import secrets
import urllib.request
from decimal import Decimal

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def disburse_payout(withdrawal_req) -> tuple[bool, str, str]:
    """Disburse funds via RazorpayX Payouts API or fallback to sandbox simulation.
    
    Returns: (success: bool, utr_or_reference: str, message: str)
    """
    key_id = os.getenv("RAZORPAY_KEY_ID", "")
    key_secret = os.getenv("RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET", "")
    rx_account_number = os.getenv("RAZORPAYX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER", "78910111213")

    is_sandbox = not key_id or "placeholder" in key_id.lower() or "test" in key_id.lower()

    specialist = withdrawal_req.specialist
    amount_paise = int(round(float(withdrawal_req.amount) * 100))
    ref_id = f"wth_{withdrawal_req.id}_{secrets.token_hex(3)}"

    # Sandbox Simulation Fallback
    if is_sandbox:
        simulated_utr = f"UTR_SIM_{secrets.token_hex(6).upper()}"
        logger.info("Sandbox Mode: Simulated payout of ₹%s disbursed successfully. UTR: %s", withdrawal_req.amount, simulated_utr)
        return True, simulated_utr, "Sandbox payout simulated successfully."

    # Live RazorpayX API Payload
    fund_account_payload = {
        "account_number": rx_account_number,
        "amount": amount_paise,
        "currency": "INR",
        "purpose": "payout",
        "queue_if_low_balance": True,
        "reference_id": ref_id,
    }

    if withdrawal_req.payout_mode == "UPI":
        fund_account_payload["mode"] = "UPI"
        fund_account_payload["fund_account"] = {
            "account_type": "vpa",
            "vpa": {"address": withdrawal_req.upi_id},
            "contact": {
                "name": specialist.name,
                "email": specialist.email,
                "type": "employee"
            }
        }
    else:
        fund_account_payload["mode"] = "NEFT"
        fund_account_payload["fund_account"] = {
            "account_type": "bank_account",
            "bank_account": {
                "name": withdrawal_req.bank_beneficiary_name or specialist.name,
                "ifsc": withdrawal_req.bank_ifsc,
                "account_number": withdrawal_req.bank_account_number
            },
            "contact": {
                "name": specialist.name,
                "email": specialist.email,
                "type": "employee"
            }
        }

    try:
        url = "https://api.razorpay.com/v1/payouts"
        data_bytes = json.dumps(fund_account_payload).encode("utf-8")
        
        auth_str = f"{key_id}:{key_secret}"
        b64_auth = base64.b64encode(auth_str.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")

        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            data=data_bytes,
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "Authorization": f"Basic {b64_auth}"
            },
            method="POST"
        )

        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as response:
            res_data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
            payout_id = res_data.get("id", "POUT_UNKNOWN")
            utr = res_data.get("utr") or res_data.get("reference_id") or payout_id
            return True, str(utr), f"Disbursed via RazorpayX (ID: {payout_id})"
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("RazorpayX Payout API error: %s", exc)
        return False, "", str(exc)

"""ReportLab Statement of Work PDF Generation Engine for AgencyOS."""

import re
from io import BytesIO
from typing import Any, NamedTuple
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape

from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_LEFT
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle, getSampleStyleSheet
from reportlab.platypus import (
    HRFlowable,
    PageBreak,
    Paragraph,
    SimpleDocTemplate,
    Spacer,
    Table,
    TableStyle,
)


class SowSignature(NamedTuple):
    signer_name: str
    signer_title: str
    ip_address: str
    signed_at: str


_SIGNATURE_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r" \[Signed by: (?P<name>.*?) \((?P<title>.*?)\) "
    r"from IP: (?P<ip>.*?) on (?P<signed_at>.*?)\]$"
)


def extract_sow_signature(requirements: str | None) -> SowSignature | None:
    """Return the recorded SOW signature, if requirements contain one."""
    match = _SIGNATURE_PATTERN.search((requirements or "").rstrip())
    if not match or not match.group("name").strip() or not match.group("title").strip():
        return None

    return SowSignature(
        signer_name=match.group("name").strip(),
        signer_title=match.group("title").strip(),
        ip_address=match.group("ip").strip(),
        signed_at=match.group("signed_at").strip(),
    )


def _plain_paragraph(value: Any, style: ParagraphStyle) -> Paragraph:
    text = escape(str(value or "")).replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\n", "<br/>")
    return Paragraph(text, style)


def generate_sow_pdf(project: Any, customer: Any, business: Any, signature: SowSignature) -> BytesIO:
    buffer = BytesIO()
    doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
        buffer,
        pagesize=A4,
        rightMargin=40,
        leftMargin=40,
        topMargin=40,
        bottomMargin=40,
        title=f"Signed Statement of Work - Project {project.id}",
        author="AgencyOS Digital Solutions",
    )

    styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
    primary = colors.HexColor("#09090b")
    dark_text = colors.HexColor("#18181b")
    muted_text = colors.HexColor("#71717a")
    light_background = colors.HexColor("#f4f4f5")

    title_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "SowTitle",
        parent=styles["Heading1"],
        fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
        fontSize=20,
        leading=24,
        textColor=primary,
    )
    subtitle_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "SowSubtitle",
        parent=styles["Normal"],
        fontSize=10,
        leading=14,
        textColor=muted_text,
    )
    heading_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "SowSectionHeading",
        parent=styles["Heading2"],
        fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
        fontSize=12,
        leading=16,
        textColor=dark_text,
        spaceBefore=12,
        spaceAfter=6,
    )
    body_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "SowBody",
        parent=styles["Normal"],
        fontName="Helvetica",
        fontSize=9,
        leading=14,
        textColor=dark_text,
        alignment=TA_LEFT,
    )
    muted_style = ParagraphStyle(
        "SowMuted",
        parent=body_style,
        textColor=muted_text,
    )

    project_brief = project.requirements or (
        "Standard milestone website sprint and technical performance optimization."
    )
    stored_signature = extract_sow_signature(project.requirements)
    if stored_signature:
        sig_match = _SIGNATURE_PATTERN.search(project.requirements.rstrip())
        if sig_match:
            project_brief = project.requirements[: sig_match.start()].rstrip()
        if not project_brief:
            project_brief = (
                "Standard milestone website sprint and technical performance optimization."
            )

    customer_name = customer.name if customer else "Client"
    business_name = business.name if business else "Direct Account"
    agreement_date = (
        project.created_at.strftime("%d %B %Y") if project.created_at else "Unavailable"
    )

    story = [
        Paragraph("AGENCYOS DIGITAL SOLUTIONS", title_style),
        Paragraph("Statement of Work (SOW) & Service Agreement", subtitle_style),
        Spacer(1, 15),
        HRFlowable(width="100%", thickness=1.5, color=primary, spaceAfter=15),
    ]

    meta_data = [
        [
            Paragraph("<b>Project Reference:</b>", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph(f"#{project.id} — {project.service}", body_style),
        ],
        [
            Paragraph("<b>Client Name:</b>", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph(customer_name, body_style),
        ],
        [
            Paragraph("<b>Business Entity:</b>", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph(business_name, body_style),
        ],
        [
            Paragraph("<b>Package Tier:</b>", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph(f"{project.package} (SAC Code: 998311)", body_style),
        ],
        [
            Paragraph("<b>Agreement Date:</b>", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph(agreement_date, body_style),
        ],
    ]
    metadata_table = Table(meta_data, colWidths=[120, 395])
    metadata_table.setStyle(
        TableStyle(
            [
                ("BACKGROUND", (0, 0), (-1, -1), light_background),
                ("PADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8),
                ("VALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "MIDDLE"),
                ("BOTTOMPADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 6),
                ("BOX", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, colors.HexColor("#e4e4e7")),
            ]
        )
    )
    story.extend(
        [
            metadata_table,
            Spacer(1, 15),
            Paragraph("1. Scope of Deliverables & Brief", heading_style),
            _plain_paragraph(project_brief, body_style),
            PageBreak(),
            Paragraph("2. Sequential Milestone Payment Schedule", heading_style),
        ]
    )

    milestone_data = [
        [
            Paragraph("<b>Milestone Phase</b>", body_style),
            Paragraph("<b>Billing %</b>", body_style),
            Paragraph("<b>Trigger / Scope Gate</b>", body_style),
        ],
        [
            _plain_paragraph("Milestone 1: Kickoff", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph("50%", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph("Discovery, wireframes & architecture setup.", body_style),
        ],
        [
            _plain_paragraph("Milestone 2: Production UI", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph("25%", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph(
                "Interactive prototype & responsive code review.", body_style
            ),
        ],
        [
            _plain_paragraph("Milestone 3: Final Launch", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph("25%", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph(
                "Production deployment, DNS setup & IP transfer.", body_style
            ),
        ],
    ]
    milestones_table = Table(milestone_data, colWidths=[140, 70, 305])
    milestones_table.setStyle(
        TableStyle(
            [
                ("BACKGROUND", (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.HexColor("#f4f4f5")),
                ("TEXTCOLOR", (0, 0), (-1, 0), primary),
                ("PADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 7),
                ("GRID", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, colors.HexColor("#cbd5e1")),
                ("VALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "TOP"),
            ]
        )
    )
    story.extend(
        [
            milestones_table,
            Spacer(1, 8),
            Paragraph("3. Terms & Guarantees", heading_style),
            Paragraph(
                "• <b>Revisions:</b> Each milestone includes up to two complimentary "
                "revision rounds. Further modifications require a written scope add-on.",
                body_style,
            ),
            Paragraph(
                "• <b>Intellectual Property:</b> Source code, design assets, and "
                "domains transfer to the Client upon final milestone payment.",
                body_style,
            ),
            Paragraph(
                "• <b>Electronic Validity:</b> This agreement is digitally executed "
                "under Section 10A of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (India).",
                body_style,
            ),
            Spacer(1, 8),
            Paragraph("4. Electronic Acceptance & Signature", heading_style),
            Paragraph(
                "This PDF is a copy of the Statement of Work and the electronic "
                "acceptance recorded in the AgencyOS project record.",
                body_style,
            ),
            Spacer(1, 12),
        ]
    )

    signature_data = [
        [
            Paragraph("<b>Service Provider</b>", body_style),
            Paragraph("<b>Client Signatory</b>", body_style),
        ],
        [
            _plain_paragraph("AgencyOS Digital Solutions", body_style),
            _plain_paragraph(signature.signer_name, body_style),
        ],
        [
            _plain_paragraph("Authorized representative", muted_style),
            _plain_paragraph(signature.signer_title, muted_style),
        ],
        [
            _plain_paragraph("AgencyOS project record", muted_style),
            _plain_paragraph(
                f"Digitally acknowledged on {signature.signed_at}", muted_style
            ),
        ],
        [
            _plain_paragraph("", muted_style),
            _plain_paragraph(
                f"Recorded from IP address: {signature.ip_address}", muted_style
            ),
        ],
    ]
    signature_table = Table(signature_data, colWidths=[250, 255])
    signature_table.setStyle(
        TableStyle(
            [
                ("LINEABOVE", (0, 0), (-1, 0), 1, muted_text),
                ("PADDING", (0, 0), (-1, -1), 6),
                ("VALIGN", (0, 0), (-1, -1), "TOP"),
            ]
        )
    )
    story.append(signature_table)

    doc.build(story)
    buffer.seek(0)
    return buffer
