--- FILE: .\app\services\reminders.py ---
"""Automated Payment and Deliverable Review Reminders for AgencyOS."""

import logging
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from flask import current_app

from app.extensions import db
from app.models import IST, Project, ProjectDelivery, User, get_ist_now
from app.services.email import EmailDeliveryError, send_email

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

PAYMENT_REMINDER_AFTER = timedelta(hours=24)
REVIEW_REMINDER_AFTER = timedelta(hours=48)


def _naive_ist(value: datetime) -> datetime:
    if value.tzinfo is not None:
        return value.astimezone(IST).replace(tzinfo=None)
    return value


def _naive_utc(value: datetime) -> datetime:
    if value.tzinfo is not None:
        return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
    return value


def _is_due(timestamp: datetime | None, now: datetime, delay: timedelta, normalize) -> bool:
    if timestamp is None:
        return False
    return normalize(timestamp) <= normalize(now) - delay


def _workspace_url(endpoint: str, **values) -> str | None:
    base_url = current_app.config.get("APP_BASE_URL", "").strip()
    if not base_url:
        logger.error("APP_BASE_URL must be configured before sending reminders.")
        return None
    parsed_base = urlsplit(base_url)
    if parsed_base.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed_base.netloc:
        logger.error("APP_BASE_URL is invalid; refusing to send a reminder link.")
        return None
    adapter = current_app.url_map.bind(
        parsed_base.netloc,
        url_scheme=parsed_base.scheme,
    )
    path = adapter.build(endpoint, values)
    return f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}{path}"


def _email_delivery_available() -> bool:
    if current_app.config.get("MAIL_SUPPRESS_SEND", False):
        logger.error("Email sending is suppressed; reminder will remain pending.")
        return False
    backend = current_app.config.get("MAIL_BACKEND", "console")
    if backend == "smtp":
        return True
    if backend == "console" and current_app.config.get("TESTING", False):
        return True
    logger.error("Reminder email requires an active SMTP backend outside tests.")
    return False


def send_payment_reminder(project_id: int, *, force: bool = False, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
    project = db.session.get(Project, project_id)
    if project is None or project.status != "Payment Pending":
        return False
    if project.payment_reminder_sent_at is not None and not force:
        return False

    sent_at = now or get_ist_now()
    if not force and not _is_due(
        project.created_at, sent_at, PAYMENT_REMINDER_AFTER, _naive_utc
    ):
        return False

    customer = db.session.get(User, project.customer_id)
    if customer is None or not customer.email:
        logger.warning("Cannot send payment reminder for project #%s: no client email.", project.id)
        return False

    payment_link = _workspace_url("payments.payment_page", project_id=project.id)
    if payment_link is None or not _email_delivery_available():
        return False

    subject = f"Action required: deposit pending for project #{project.id}"
    body = (
        f"Hi {customer.name or 'Client'},\n\n"
        f"Project #{project.id} ({project.service}) is waiting for its advance "
        "deposit. Work begins once payment is authorized.\n\n"
        f"Sign in to securely continue checkout:\n{payment_link}\n\n"
        "Best regards,\nAgencyOS Team"
    )

    try:
        send_email(customer.email, subject, body)
    except EmailDeliveryError:
        logger.exception("Payment reminder failed for project #%s.", project.id)
        return False

    project.payment_reminder_sent_at = sent_at
    db.session.commit()
    logger.info("Payment reminder sent for project #%s.", project.id)
    return True


def send_review_reminder(project_id: int, *, force: bool = False, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
    project = db.session.get(Project, project_id)
    if project is None or project.status != "Submitted":
        return False

    delivery = (
        ProjectDelivery.query.filter_by(project_id=project.id)
        .order_by(ProjectDelivery.submission_number.desc())
        .first()
    )
    if (
        delivery is None
        or delivery.status != "Submitted"
        or (delivery.review_reminder_sent_at is not None and not force)
    ):
        return False

    sent_at = now or get_ist_now()
    if not force and not _is_due(
        delivery.submitted_at, sent_at, REVIEW_REMINDER_AFTER, _naive_ist
    ):
        return False

    customer = db.session.get(User, project.customer_id)
    if customer is None or not customer.email:
        logger.warning("Cannot send review reminder for project #%s: no client email.", project.id)
        return False

    workspace_link = _workspace_url("customer.project_details", project_id=project.id)
    if workspace_link is None or not _email_delivery_available():
        return False

    subject = f"Review requested: project #{project.id} deliverable"
    body = (
        f"Hi {customer.name or 'Client'},\n\n"
        f"A specialist submitted a deliverable for project #{project.id} "
        f"({project.service}). Please review it and approve or request "
        f"revisions in your workspace:\n{workspace_link}\n\n"
        "Best regards,\nAgencyOS Team"
    )

    try:
        send_email(customer.email, subject, body)
    except EmailDeliveryError:
        logger.exception("Review reminder failed for project #%s.", project.id)
        return False

    delivery.review_reminder_sent_at = sent_at
    db.session.commit()
    logger.info("Review reminder sent for project #%s.", project.id)
    return True


def run_due_reminders(now: datetime | None = None) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Send each eligible reminder once; suitable for a scheduled CLI run."""
    sent_at = now or get_ist_now()
    payment_cutoff = _naive_utc(sent_at) - PAYMENT_REMINDER_AFTER
    review_cutoff = _naive_ist(sent_at) - REVIEW_REMINDER_AFTER
    summary = {"payment_sent": 0, "review_sent": 0, "failed": 0}

    payment_ids = [
        project_id
        for (project_id,) in db.session.query(Project.id)
        .filter(
            Project.status == "Payment Pending",
            Project.payment_reminder_sent_at.is_(None),
            Project.created_at <= payment_cutoff,
        )
        .all()
    ]
    for project_id in payment_ids:
        if send_payment_reminder(project_id, now=sent_at):
            summary["payment_sent"] += 1
        else:
            summary["failed"] += 1

    latest_delivery_id = (
        db.session.query(ProjectDelivery.id)
        .filter(ProjectDelivery.project_id == Project.id)
        .order_by(ProjectDelivery.submission_number.desc())
        .limit(1)
        .correlate(Project)
        .scalar_subquery()
    )
    review_ids = [
        project_id
        for (project_id,) in db.session.query(ProjectDelivery.project_id)
        .join(Project, Project.id == ProjectDelivery.project_id)
        .filter(
            ProjectDelivery.id == latest_delivery_id,
            Project.status == "Submitted",
            ProjectDelivery.status == "Submitted",
            ProjectDelivery.review_reminder_sent_at.is_(None),
            ProjectDelivery.submitted_at <= review_cutoff,
        )
        .distinct()
        .all()
    ]
    for project_id in review_ids:
        if send_review_reminder(project_id, now=sent_at):
            summary["review_sent"] += 1
        else:
            summary["failed"] += 1

    return summary

"""Meta Cloud API & BSP WhatsApp Notification Engine for AgencyOS."""

import logging
import os
from typing import Any
import requests
from flask import current_app

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

WHATSAPP_API_URL = "https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0"


def _format_phone(phone: str | None) -> str | None:
    """Normalize phone numbers to international E.164 format (e.g. 919876543210)."""
    if not phone:
        return None
    cleaned = "".join(filter(str.isdigit, str(phone)))
    if len(cleaned) == 10:
        return f"91{cleaned}"
    if len(cleaned) == 12 and cleaned.startswith("91"):
        return cleaned
    return cleaned


def send_whatsapp_alert(to_phone: str | None, message_text: str) -> bool:
    """Dispatch WhatsApp message via Meta Cloud API or log safely if in development."""
    formatted_number = _format_phone(to_phone)
    if not formatted_number:
        logger.warning("WhatsApp alert skipped: invalid or missing phone number.")
        return False

    token = os.getenv("WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN")
    phone_id = os.getenv("WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID")

    if not token or not phone_id:
        logger.info(f"[WHATSAPP MOCK DISPATCH] To: {formatted_number} | Message: {message_text}")
        return True

    url = f"{WHATSAPP_API_URL}/{phone_id}/messages"
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    payload = {
        "messaging_product": "whatsapp",
        "to": formatted_number,
        "type": "text",
        "text": {"body": message_text},
    }

    try:
        res = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        if res.status_code in (200, 201):
            logger.info("WhatsApp message dispatched successfully to %s", formatted_number)
            return True
        else:
            logger.error("WhatsApp API error %s: %s", res.status_code, res.text)
            return False
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("WhatsApp delivery network failure: %s", str(exc))
        return False


def notify_payment_received(project_id: int, service_name: str, amount: Any, client_phone: str | None, client_name: str) -> bool:
    """Send payment confirmation to client."""
    msg = (

        f"Milestone 1 is now active! Our specialists have begun discovery & wireframing.\n"
        f"Track progress in your workspace: https://yourdomain.com/project/{project_id}"
    )
    return send_whatsapp_alert(client_phone, msg)


def notify_deliverable_ready(project_id: int, service_name: str, preview_url: str, client_phone: str | None, client_name: str) -> bool:

# Save this directly into your file: app/utils/auth.py

from functools import wraps
from flask import session, jsonify, request, redirect, url_for, flash
from flask_login import current_user
from app.models import User

def _get_active_auth_user():
    """Retrieve authenticated user from Flask-Login or standard session."""
    if current_user and getattr(current_user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return current_user
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    if user_id:
        return User.query.get(user_id)
    return None

def roles_required(*allowed_roles):
    """Universal RBAC decorator protecting JSON APIs and web views."""
    # Normalize aliases ('client' <-> 'customer')
    normalized_allowed = set()
    for r in allowed_roles:
        normalized_allowed.add(r.lower())
        if r.lower() == "client":
            normalized_allowed.add("customer")
        elif r.lower() == "customer":
            normalized_allowed.add("client")

    def decorator(f):
        @wraps(f)
        def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
            user = _get_active_auth_user()
            is_api = request.path.startswith("/api/") or request.is_json or request.headers.get("Accept") == "application/json"

            if not user or not getattr(user, "is_active", True):
                if is_api:
                    return jsonify({"error": "Authentication required", "code": "UNAUTHORIZED"}), 401
                flash("Please log in to access this page.", "warning")
                return redirect(url_for("auth.login"))

            user_role = getattr(user, "role", "").lower()
            if user_role not in normalized_allowed:
                if is_api:
                    return jsonify({
                        "error": "You do not have permission to access this resource",
                        "code": "ACCESS_DENIED"
                    }), 403
                flash("You do not have permission to view this page.", "danger")
                if user_role == "admin":
                    return redirect(url_for("admin.dashboard"))
                elif user_role == "professional":
                    return redirect(url_for("professional.dashboard"))
                return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

            return f(*args, **kwargs)
        return decorated_function
    return decorator

# Alias for backward compatibility
role_required = roles_required

--- FILE: .\app\utils\currency.py ---
"""Multi-currency pricing, normalization, and statutory calculations for AgencyOS."""

from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP
from typing import Dict, Any, Tuple


CURRENCY_SYMBOLS: Dict[str, str] = {
    "INR": "₹",
    "USD": "$",
    "EUR": "€",
    "GBP": "£",
}

SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES = frozenset(CURRENCY_SYMBOLS)
DEFAULT_CURRENCY = "INR"

INTERNATIONAL_PACKAGE_PRICES: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]] = {
    "USD": {
        "Basic Website": 699,
        "Business Website": 1299,
        "Advanced Website": 2499,
        "SEO Starter": 499,
        "SEO Growth": 899,
        "SEO Advanced": 1599,
    },
    "EUR": {
        "Basic Website": 650,
        "Business Website": 1199,
        "Advanced Website": 2299,
        "SEO Starter": 450,
        "SEO Growth": 850,
        "SEO Advanced": 1499,
    },
    "GBP": {
        "Basic Website": 550,
        "Business Website": 999,
        "Advanced Website": 1999,
        "SEO Starter": 390,
        "SEO Growth": 750,
        "SEO Advanced": 1299,
    },
}


def sanitize_currency(currency: str | None) -> str:
    """Validate and sanitize currency code with fallback to default."""
    if not currency:
        return DEFAULT_CURRENCY
    normalized = currency.strip().upper()
    return normalized if normalized in SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES else DEFAULT_CURRENCY


def get_package_price(
    package: str,
    currency: str,
    inr_prices: dict[str, int],
) -> Decimal:
    """Return canonical package price as Decimal for the requested currency."""
    curr = sanitize_currency(currency)
    if package == "Starter Retainer" and curr != "INR":
        raise ValueError("Starter Retainer billing is currently INR-only.")
    if curr == "INR":
        return Decimal(str(inr_prices.get(package, 48000)))
    price = INTERNATIONAL_PACKAGE_PRICES.get(curr, {}).get(package)
    if price is None:
        raise ValueError(f"No price configured for package '{package}' in currency '{curr}'.")
    return Decimal(str(price))


def to_minor_units(amount: int | float | Decimal) -> int:
    """Convert human-readable currency amount to integer minor units (paise/cents/pence)."""
    try:
        value = Decimal(str(amount))
    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("Payment amount must be numeric.") from exc

    if not value.is_finite() or value < 0:
        raise ValueError("Payment amount must be a non-negative finite value.")

    minor_units = (value * Decimal("100")).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    return int(minor_units)


def from_minor_units(minor_amount: int) -> Decimal:
    """Convert integer minor units back to standard Decimal."""
    return (Decimal(minor_amount) / Decimal("100")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))


def format_currency(value, currency: str = "INR") -> str:
    """Format numeric value with standard currency symbols and tabular commas."""
    curr = sanitize_currency(currency)
    try:
        amount = Decimal("0") if value is None else Decimal(str(value))
    except (InvalidOperation, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("Currency amount must be numeric.") from exc

    if not amount.is_finite():
        raise ValueError("Currency amount must be finite.")

    symbol = CURRENCY_SYMBOLS.get(curr, "₹")
    return f"{symbol}{amount:,.2f}"


def calculate_tax_rate(client_country: str, currency: str) -> Decimal:
    """Return statutory tax rate applicable for the client billing context.

    Domestic Indian transactions (INR) require standard 18% GST.
    Cross-border transactions (USD, EUR, GBP) operate under export LUT (0% GST).
    """
    curr = sanitize_currency(currency)
    if curr == "INR":
        return Decimal("0.18")
    return Decimal("0.00")


def compute_financial_split(gross_amount: Decimal, currency: str = "INR") -> Tuple[Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]:
    """Compute talent share (45%), agency profit (55%), and tax portion with 2-decimal precision.

    Returns:
        (talent_share, agency_profit, tax_amount)
    """
    curr = sanitize_currency(currency)
    gross = Decimal(str(gross_amount)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    tax_rate = calculate_tax_rate("", curr)

    if tax_rate > Decimal("0.00"):
        tax_amount = (gross - (gross / (Decimal("1.00") + tax_rate))).quantize(
            Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP
        )
    else:
        tax_amount = Decimal("0.00")

    talent_share = (gross * Decimal("0.45")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    agency_share = gross - talent_share

    return talent_share, agency_share, tax_amount

# Save this directly into your file: app/utils/decorators.py

from functools import wraps
from flask import flash, redirect, url_for, jsonify, request, session
from flask_login import current_user
from app.models import User

def _get_request_user():
    """Resolve current user from Flask-Login session or session ID."""
    if current_user and getattr(current_user, "is_authenticated", False):
        return current_user
    user_id = session.get("user_id")
    if user_id:
        return User.query.get(user_id)
    return None

def role_required(*allowed_roles):
    """Enforce role checking supporting both traditional Flask views and JSON API requests."""
    # Normalize aliases ('client' <-> 'customer')
    normalized_allowed = set()
    for r in allowed_roles:
        normalized_allowed.add(r.lower())
        if r.lower() == "client":
            normalized_allowed.add("customer")
        elif r.lower() == "customer":
            normalized_allowed.add("client")

    def decorator(f):
        @wraps(f)
        def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
            user = _get_request_user()

            is_api_request = request.path.startswith("/api/") or request.is_json or request.headers.get("Accept") == "application/json"

            if not user or not getattr(user, "is_active", True):
                if is_api_request:
                    return jsonify({"error": "Authentication required", "code": "UNAUTHORIZED"}), 401
                flash("Please log in to access this page.", "warning")
                return redirect(url_for("auth.login"))

            user_role = getattr(user, "role", "").lower()
            if user_role not in normalized_allowed:
                if is_api_request:
                    return jsonify({"error": "Forbidden: insufficient permissions", "code": "FORBIDDEN"}), 403
                flash("You do not have permission to access this resource.", "danger")
                if user_role == "admin":
                    return redirect(url_for("admin.dashboard"))
                elif user_role == "professional":
                    return redirect(url_for("professional.dashboard"))
                return redirect(url_for("customer.dashboard"))

            return f(*args, **kwargs)
        return decorated_function
    return decorator

# Alias to maintain compatibility with both naming conventions
roles_required = role_required

def verified_professional_required(f):
    @wraps(f)
    def decorated_function(*args, **kwargs):
        user = _get_request_user()
        is_api_request = request.path.startswith("/api/") or request.is_json

        if not user or not getattr(user, "is_active", True):
            if is_api_request:
                return jsonify({"error": "Authentication required", "code": "UNAUTHORIZED"}), 401
            flash("Please log in to continue.", "warning")
            return redirect(url_for("auth.login"))

        profile = getattr(user, "professional_profile", None)
        if not profile or getattr(profile, "verification_status", "Pending") != "Verified":
            if is_api_request:
                return jsonify({"error": "Professional profile verification pending", "code": "VERIFICATION_REQUIRED"}), 403
            flash("Your profile must be verified by an administrator before accessing project applications.", "warning")
            return redirect(url_for("professional.dashboard"))

        return f(*args, **kwargs)
    return decorated_function

"""AgencyOS Secure File Upload Utility with Cloudflare R2 / S3 Support.

Handles secure file validation, size limits (10MB cap), local storage fallback,
and S3/Cloudflare R2 cloud object storage integration.
"""

import os
import secrets
from werkzeug.utils import secure_filename
from flask import current_app


def save_project_upload(file_storage, allowed_extensions: set[str]) -> str | None:
    """Securely validate and save an uploaded file to local disk or Cloudflare R2 / S3."""
    if not file_storage or not file_storage.filename:
        return None

    filename = secure_filename(file_storage.filename)
    ext = filename.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower() if "." in filename else ""

    if ext not in allowed_extensions:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Invalid file extension '.{ext}'. Allowed types: {', '.join(sorted(allowed_extensions))}."
        )

    # Check file size (Max 10 MB limit)
    file_storage.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
    size_bytes = file_storage.tell()
    file_storage.seek(0)

    if size_bytes > 10 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("File size exceeds the 10 MB maximum limit.")

    unique_prefix = secrets.token_hex(16)
    unique_filename = f"{unique_prefix}_{filename}"

    # Check for Cloudflare R2 / S3 Configuration
    r2_access_key = os.getenv("R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID")
    r2_secret_key = os.getenv("R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY")
    r2_bucket = os.getenv("R2_BUCKET_NAME")
    r2_endpoint = os.getenv("R2_ENDPOINT_URL")

    if r2_access_key and r2_secret_key and r2_bucket and r2_endpoint:
        try:
            import boto3
            session = boto3.Session()
            client = session.client(
                "s3",
                endpoint_url=r2_endpoint,
                aws_access_key_id=r2_access_key,
                aws_secret_access_key=r2_secret_key,
                region_name="auto",
            )
            client.upload_fileobj(
                file_storage,
                r2_bucket,
                unique_filename,
                ExtraArgs={"ContentType": file_storage.content_type or "application/octet-stream"},
            )
            public_domain = os.getenv("R2_PUBLIC_DOMAIN", r2_endpoint.rstrip("/"))
            return f"{public_domain}/{r2_bucket}/{unique_filename}"
        except Exception as exc:
            current_app.logger.warning("Cloudflare R2 upload failed; falling back to local storage: %s", exc)

    # Fallback to Local Storage (Safely handling static_folder typing)
    static_folder = current_app.static_folder or os.path.abspath(
        os.path.join(current_app.root_path, "..", "static")
    )
    upload_folder = os.path.join(str(static_folder), "uploads")
    os.makedirs(upload_folder, exist_ok=True)
    destination = os.path.join(upload_folder, unique_filename)
    file_storage.save(destination)

    return f"/static/uploads/{unique_filename}"

import os
import stripe
from decimal import Decimal

stripe.api_key = os.getenv("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY", "")

STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY = os.getenv("STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY", "")
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET = os.getenv("STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")

STRIPE_PRICE_MATRIX = {
    "USD": {
        "Basic Website": "price_usd_basic_placeholder",
        "Business Website": "price_usd_business_placeholder",
        "Advanced Website": "price_usd_advanced_placeholder",
        "SEO Starter": "price_usd_seo_starter_placeholder",
        "SEO Growth": "price_usd_seo_growth_placeholder",
        "SEO Advanced": "price_usd_seo_advanced_placeholder",
    },
    "EUR": {
        "Basic Website": "price_eur_basic_placeholder",
        "Business Website": "price_eur_business_placeholder",
        "Advanced Website": "price_eur_advanced_placeholder",
        "SEO Starter": "price_eur_seo_starter_placeholder",
        "SEO Growth": "price_eur_seo_growth_placeholder",
        "SEO Advanced": "price_eur_seo_advanced_placeholder",
    },
    "GBP": {
        "Basic Website": "price_gbp_basic_placeholder",
        "Business Website": "price_gbp_business_placeholder",
        "Advanced Website": "price_gbp_advanced_placeholder",
        "SEO Starter": "price_gbp_seo_starter_placeholder",
        "SEO Growth": "price_gbp_seo_growth_placeholder",
        "SEO Advanced": "price_gbp_seo_advanced_placeholder",
    },
}

SUPPORTED_STRIPE_CURRENCIES = frozenset(STRIPE_PRICE_MATRIX.keys())


def get_stripe_price_id(currency: str, package_name: str) -> str:
    """Look up the Stripe Price ID for a given currency and package."""
    if currency not in STRIPE_PRICE_MATRIX:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported currency for Stripe: {currency}")
    if package_name not in STRIPE_PRICE_MATRIX[currency]:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Package '{package_name}' not found in Stripe price matrix for {currency}"
        )
    return STRIPE_PRICE_MATRIX[currency][package_name]


def build_checkout_session_params(
    project_id: int,
    package_name: str,
    currency: str,
    success_url: str,
    cancel_url: str,
) -> dict:
    """Build Stripe Checkout Session creation parameters."""
    price_id = get_stripe_price_id(currency, package_name)
    return {
        "payment_method_types": ["card"],
        "line_items": [{"price": price_id, "quantity": 1}],
        "mode": "payment",
        "success_url": success_url,
        "cancel_url": cancel_url,
        "client_reference_id": str(project_id),
        "metadata": {
            "project_id": str(project_id),
            "package_name": package_name,
            "currency": currency,
        },
    }

--- FILE: .\docs\architecture.md ---
# System Architecture — AgencyOS

## 1. Application Topology
AgencyOS is architected as a modular Python/Flask monolith using the Application Factory pattern (`create_app`):

[ Client / Browser ]
│ HTTPS (Session Cookies + CSRF Tokens)
▼
[ Flask Application Factory (create_app) ]
├── Blueprints:
│ ├── auth_bp (/login, /register, /logout)
│ ├── admin_bp (/admin/dashboard, /admin/projects, /admin/customers)
│ ├── customer_bp (/dashboard, /businesses, /customer/profile)
│ ├── professional_bp (/professional/dashboard, /professional/workspace)
│ ├── payments_bp (/payments/checkout, /payments/webhook)
│ └── public_bp (/privacy, /terms, /refund-policy, /contact, /api/free-audit)
├── Security Middleware:
│ ├── Flask-Login (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure session cookies)
│ ├── Flask-WTF (CSRF verification on state-changing requests)
│ └── Flask-Limiter (Rate limiting on auth and payment endpoints)
├── Services:
│ ├── RazorpayService (Order creation & HMAC SHA256 webhook verification)
│ ├── InvoicingService (SAC 998311 CGST/SGST/IGST tax calculation)
│ └── AiService (Backend-confined Google Gemini SDK)
└── ORM: SQLAlchemy
│
┌────┴───────────────────────────┐
▼ ▼
[ SQLite / PostgreSQL ] [ External APIs ]
(Local: instance/agencyos.db) (Razorpay, Google Gemini)

## 2. Directory Layout
```text
agencyos1/
├── app/
│   ├── __init__.py           # Application Factory, Core Models & Helpers
│   ├── config.py             # Security, Environment, Timezone & Credentials Validator
│   ├── extensions.py         # SQLAlchemy, LoginManager, CSRF, Limiter
│   ├── routes/               # Modular Flask Blueprints (admin, customer, public, etc.)
│   ├── services/             # Core business logic (Payments, Invoicing, AI)
│   ├── static/               # Uploads & Client Deliverables
│   └── templates/            # Flat Studio Dark Jinja2 Templates
├── docs/                     # 10 Master Documentation Files
├── instance/                 # Protected Local SQLite Database (agencyos.db)
├── tests/                    # Pytest Suite (Smoke, Auth, CSRF, Payments, Workflows)
├── app.py                    # Production WSGI Callable (Gunicorn/Render)
├── run.py                    # Local Development Runner (Port & Debug checks)
├── apply_fund_flow_columns.py# Non-destructive SQLite Schema Migration Script
├── DATABASE_UNIQUENESS_REPORT.md # Unique Indexes & Idempotency Audit
├── DECISIONS.md              # Architecture Decision Log (DEC-001 through DEC-018)
└── README.md                 # Project Overview & Setup Guide

--- FILE: .\docs\design.md ---
# UI/UX & Design Specification — AgencyOS

## 1. Design Language & Tokens
Inspired by `Linear`, `shadcn/ui`, `Kokonut UI`, and `Corbel Supply Co.`:
- **Base Canvas:** `#09090b` (`zinc-950`)
- **Card Surface:** `#121215` (`zinc-900/60` with subtle border `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07)`)
- **Card Hover:** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)` border with `translateY(-2px)` elevation
- **Typography:** **Plus Jakarta Sans** for headings, **JetBrains Mono** for figures and dates
- **Accents:**
  - Success / Approved: `#10b981` (Emerald)
  - Review / Warning: `#f59e0b` (Amber)
  - Payment Due / Danger: `#f43f5e` (Rose)
  - Primary CTA / Sprints: `#6366f1` (Indigo) / `#ffffff` (White button on dark canvas)

## 2. Core Layout Primitives
1. **Floating Segmented Pill Bar:** Compact, rounded navigation header (`Overview`, `Milestones`, `Analytics`, `Invoices`).
2. **KPI Metric Tiles:** Ambient hover glow, Lucide trending icon, live percentage comparison chip, and micro progress bar.
3. **Pipeline Cards:** 7-stage visual tracker with animated percentage track fills.
4. **Approval Gate Card:** High-contrast green `[Approve Deliverable]` button alongside amber `[Request Revision]` button displaying remaining complimentary revisions.

## 3. Accessibility & Clean Code Standards
- Zero inline CSS expressions containing Jinja curly brackets.
- Responsive mobile drawer with zero horizontal scroll overflow.
- High color contrast ratio meeting WCAG AA standards.

--- FILE: .\docs\features.md ---
# Complete Feature Inventory — AgencyOS

## 1. Client Management & CRM
- Customer profile with business type, website, target audience, and goals.
- Multi-business support under a single customer account.
- Secure, one-time magic token login links for zero-password access.
- Guided three-step project intake for brand context, delivery targets, and custom scope.

## 2. Website Milestone Delivery Engine
- 3-Phase Milestone Gates (50% Advance -> 25% Wireframe/Design -> 25% Launch).
- Deliverable submission tracking with live URL, preview URL, and completion notes.
- Client Sign-Off Gate with strict 2-revision limit.
- Signed SOW PDF downloads from the customer project workspace after electronic acceptance.
- 1-Click Paid Scope Add-on Generator (monetizing revisions 3+).
- Project activity audit timeline recording project creation, SOW signatures, payments, deliverable submissions, revision requests, and milestone approvals with actor and timestamp.

## 3. SEO Retainer Operations
- 30-Day recurring sprint cycle.
- 4-Part Deliverable Checklist (Technical, On-Page, Content, Reporting).
- Day-28 automatic client progress summary.
- Loss-aversion retention warnings before cycle pauses.

## 4. Indian Financials & Invoicing
- SAC Code 998311 tax categorization.
- Automatic tax breakdown: CGST (9%) + SGST (9%) for intra-state; IGST (18%) for inter-state.
- Razorpay Orders & Payment Links API integration.
- Webhook HMAC signature verification and payment idempotency.
- Starter Retainer e-Mandate / UPI AutoPay: Razorpay monthly plan, 12 scheduled cycles at ₹14,999, beginning on the first day of the next month.
- `subscription.charged` webhook validation and idempotent renewal reconciliation, with a paid payment record and a separate monthly invoice for each captured charge.
- Dynamic UPI QR Code rendering on invoices for direct bank settlement.
- Automated payment and deliverable review reminder emails with admin-triggered sends.

### Recurring subscription setup
- Apply the database migrations before enabling subscriptions. The Starter Retainer plan ID is created once and stored in the database; project checkout is restricted to the owning customer (or an admin) and to the exact `Starter Retainer` package.
- Configure Razorpay to send `subscription.charged`, `subscription.authenticated`, `subscription.activated`, `subscription.pending`, `subscription.halted`, `subscription.cancelled`, `subscription.completed`, `subscription.paused`, `subscription.resumed`, and `subscription.updated` events to the public `/subscription/webhook` endpoint. Set `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` to the webhook secret configured in the Razorpay dashboard. The existing `/webhook` endpoint also accepts these events.
- Renewal payments and invoices are linked to the local subscription and gateway payment ID. Re-delivered webhook events are deduplicated and each invoice can be opened from the client invoice ledger.
- Subscription creation reserves a local project record before calling Razorpay; ambiguous gateway timeouts are blocked from automatic retries to avoid creating duplicate mandates and require reconciliation before another attempt.

### Scheduled reminder delivery
- Configure `APP_BASE_URL` to the trusted public application origin and configure the existing `MAIL_BACKEND`/SMTP settings.
- Schedule `flask --app app:create_app send-reminders` with the deployment's task scheduler (for example, Windows Task Scheduler or cron) to run every 15 minutes. The command sends payment reminders after 24 hours and review reminders after 48 hours, recording successful sends to prevent repeat automatic reminders.
- Apply the database migrations before deploying this feature.

## 5. Fund Flow & Talent Payout Architecture
- 100% upfront agency collection via Razorpay into primary agency account.
- Milestone escrow release: Talent payouts marked `Ready to Pay` only upon client deliverable approval.
- Specialist banking profile: `upi_id`, `bank_account_number`, `bank_ifsc`, and `pan_number`.
- Admin payout tracking: `payout_status`, `payout_utr`, and `payout_paid_at`.
- Admin specialist roster meritocracy metrics use completed assigned sprints, captured customer reviews, revision delivery records, and explicit milestone deadlines. On-time rate and star rating display as unavailable until there is supporting data; performance badges are awarded only when their evidence-based thresholds are met.

## 6. Corbel-Style Executive Workspace
- Studio Dark aesthetic inspired by Linear and Corbel Supply Co.
- Executive KPI tiles with period-over-period delta chips.
- 7-Stage visual pipeline tracker (`Pending Assignment` to `Completed`).
- Expandable project details rows and instant keyboard search (`/` shortcut).
- Admin-managed global agency name, optional logo, primary color, and WhatsApp support number, reflected across client/specialist portals and invoice issuer identity.
- Existing installations should apply the additive agency settings Alembic migration; absent settings rows continue to render the AgencyOS defaults.

## 7. AI Internal Copilot (Google Gemini)
- Instant SOW & Proposal Generator based on client bullet points.
- Automated Monthly SEO Client Performance Email Drafter.
- Free AI Website & Local SEO Audit Lead Scout.

## 8. Statutory & Legal Compliance
- India DPDP Act (2023) compliant privacy policy.
- Razorpay mandatory legal pages (`/privacy`, `/terms`, `/refund-policy`, `/contact`).
- Form consent notices on lead capture endpoints.

# Product Requirements Document (PRD) — AgencyOS

## 1. Executive Summary & Vision
AgencyOS is an integrated operating system built for boutique digital marketing, web design, and SEO agencies in India (2–15 team members). It operates under a "Customer Zero / Dogfooding" strategy: the founder runs their own agency on the platform first to validate workflows, cash flow, and client approvals before expanding into a multi-tenant B2B SaaS.

## 2. Market Fit (India-First Reality)
- **Indian Standard Time (IST):** All cron jobs, sprint rollovers, and invoice dates run on `Asia/Kolkata`.
- **Statutory Taxation:** Native SAC Code 998311 compliance with automatic CGST + SGST (intra-state) or IGST (inter-state) calculation.
- **Payment Rails:** Native UPI QR codes and Razorpay Orders integration with strict partial unique index idempotency.
- **WhatsApp Integration:** Zero-password magic links for instant smartphone review and deliverable sign-offs without client account creation friction.

## 3. Core Modules & Feature Specifications

### Module 1: Website Delivery Engine (Milestone-Gated)
- **3 Phased Gates:** 50% Advance Deposit -> 25% Wireframe/Design Sign-off -> 25% Production Deployment.
- **Sequential Unlocks:** Milestone 2 cannot start until Milestone 1 payment is verified via Razorpay webhook.
- **2-Revision Guarantee:** Client portal caps complimentary feedback at 2 revision rounds per milestone. A 1-click paid scope add-on button unlocks additional modifications.

### Module 2: SEO Retainer Engine (30-Day Cyclical Sprints)
- **4 Monthly Deliverable Tracks:** Technical Audit, On-Page Optimization, Content/Backlinks, and Performance Metrics.
- **Day 28 Review Trigger:** System auto-compiles monthly deliverables into an executive summary for client renewal.
- **Loss-Aversion Retention Alerts:** Warns clients of ranking drops before they pause their monthly retainer.

### Module 3: Indian Invoicing & Fund Flow Architecture
- **Inbound Collection:** 100% of client payments are collected upfront into the agency's primary bank account via Razorpay.
- **Outbound Talent Payout:** Funds for specialists are held in milestone escrow and marked `Ready to Pay` only after client deliverable approval.
- **Payout Tracking:** Payouts are recorded with `payout_status`, `payout_utr` (bank transaction reference), and `payout_paid_at`.

### Module 4: Corbel-Style Executive Workspace
- **Studio Dark Aesthetic:** High-density, minimal dark UI inspired by Linear and Corbel Supply Co. (`zinc-950` base, `#121215` cards).
- **Live KPI Tiles:** Real-time tracking of active revenue, leads captured, and sprint conversion rates.
- **Operational Pipeline:** 7-stage visual pipeline tracker (`Pending Assignment` to `Completed`).

### Module 5: Google Gemini AI Copilot (Backend-Confined)
- **SOW / Proposal Drafter:** Converts raw client notes into structured milestone packages and budgets.
- **SEO Monthly Report Drafter:** Automatically writes client-ready progress emails from completed sprint checklist items.

### Module 6: Statutory Compliance & Legal Suite
- **DPDP Act (2023):** Transparent privacy disclosures, minimal data collection, and Grievance Officer routing.
- **Merchant Activation Ready:** Dedicated, static legal endpoints (`/privacy`, `/terms`, `/refund-policy`, `/contact`) fulfilling Razorpay KYC mandates.

--- FILE: .\docs\PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT.md ---
# Production Deployment Guide

This guide is a practical checklist for deploying AgencyOS. It describes requirements and recommendations; it is not evidence that a deployment has been tested.

## Supported application server

- Run the Flask application through a production WSGI server such as Gunicorn or Waitress.
- Use a process manager such as systemd, Supervisor, or a container orchestrator to keep the process running.
- `PORT` controls the listen port used by `run.py`; bind the WSGI server to the intended host and port.

## Required environment variables

Set these in the deployment environment. Never commit real values.

- `FLASK_ENV=production`
- `SECRET_KEY`  -  strong, unique, at least 32 characters
- `DATABASE_URL`  -  production database URI; do not rely on the default SQLite path for production workloads
- `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID`
- `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET`
- `RATELIMIT_STORAGE_URL`  -  `redis://` or `rediss://` with a hostname
- `RATELIMIT_ALLOW_IN_MEMORY_STORAGE=false` unless a single-worker exception is explicitly approved
- `APP_BASE_URL`  -  public HTTPS origin, no path, query, fragment, or credentials
- `MAIL_BACKEND=smtp`
- `MAIL_SERVER`
- `MAIL_PORT`
- `MAIL_USE_TLS`
- `MAIL_USERNAME`
- `MAIL_PASSWORD`
- `MAIL_DEFAULT_SENDER`
- `MAIL_SUPPRESS_SEND=false`
- `EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED`  -  set only after the legacy-account policy is decided
- `PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRY_MINUTES`
- `EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TOKEN_EXPIRY_HOURS`

## HTTPS and trusted origin

- Terminate TLS at the reverse proxy or load balancer and forward HTTPS to the application.
- Set `APP_BASE_URL` to the public HTTPS origin.
- Production startup fails if `APP_BASE_URL` is missing or invalid.

## Redis and rate limiting

- Use shared Redis storage for multi-worker deployments.
- In-memory storage is only for local single-process development and isolated tests.
- Production in-memory storage requires `RATELIMIT_ALLOW_IN_MEMORY_STORAGE=true` and is only safe for one worker.

## SMTP delivery

- Configure SMTP credentials and set `MAIL_SUPPRESS_SEND=false`.
- Verify password-reset and verification emails in a non-production environment before release.
- `MAIL_BACKEND=console` does not deliver real email.

## Health checks and logging

- Configure a reverse-proxy health check against an application route.
- Enable application and server logging; do not log secrets, tokens, or message bodies.
- Monitor 4xx/5xx rates and rate-limit responses.

## Database backup and restore

- Back up the production database before any change.
- Test restore procedures periodically.
- Do not run migrations or administrative scripts against the live database without approval.

## Migration preflight and rollback

- Review `MIGRATION_ACCOUNT_SECURITY.sql` and `MIGRATION_PAYMENT_UNIQUENESS.sql` as proposals only.
- Do not execute migrations without a separately approved database plan.
- Run preflight checks for duplicate and empty payment IDs.
- Apply migrations during an approved maintenance window.
- Keep a verified backup and a rollback plan.
- Verify schema and application behavior after migration.

## Pre-deployment checklist

- [ ] `FLASK_ENV=production`
- [ ] Strong unique `SECRET_KEY`
- [ ] Valid Razorpay credentials
- [ ] Redis configured and reachable
- [ ] `APP_BASE_URL` valid HTTPS origin
- [ ] SMTP configured and tested
- [ ] Database backup completed
- [ ] Migration plan approved if schema changes are needed
- [ ] Tests pass in the deployment environment

## Post-deployment checklist

- [ ] Application starts successfully
- [ ] Login, registration, and password reset work
- [ ] Email delivery works if enabled
- [ ] Payment order creation and verification work
- [ ] Rate limiting uses shared storage
- [ ] Logs contain no secret values
- [ ] Database backup and rollback plan remain available

### 3. `docs/rules.md`

```markdown
# Engineering & Operating Rules — AgencyOS

## 1. Solo-Developer Guardrails
1. **Rule of Simplicity:** Always use server-rendered Flask + Jinja templates styled with Tailwind utility classes. Do NOT introduce decoupled SPA build pipelines (React/Vite) into core operations.
2. **Unified Shell Principle:** All role-specific views must share the same Studio Dark design tokens (`zinc-950`, Plus Jakarta Sans, Lucide icons).
3. **Additive Schema Migrations Only:** Never drop tables or execute unversioned `ALTER TABLE` scripts. Always run non-destructive additive migrations like `apply_fund_flow_columns.py`.

## 2. Security & Secrets Management
1. **Zero Secret Leakage:** `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID`, `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET`, and `SECRET_KEY` must be loaded exclusively via environment variables. Client bundles must never access API keys.
2. **Production Validation:** If `FLASK_ENV=production`, `config.py` strictly raises `InsecureSecretKeyError` or `InsecureRazorpayCredentialsError` if placeholder keys are detected.
3. **Session Hardening:** All session cookies must enforce `HttpOnly=True`, `SameSite='Lax'`, and `Secure=True` in production.

## 3. Compliance & Legal Rules (India)
1. **Digital Personal Data Protection Act (2023):** Only collect necessary client data (Name, Email, Phone, GSTIN). Provide a visible Grievance Officer contact.
2. **Consumer Protection Act:** No fabricated reviews, fake customer numbers, or unsupported marketing guarantees.
3. **Razorpay KYC Requirement:** All deployments must maintain live, accessible `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/refund-policy`, and `/contact` endpoints.

## 4. UI/UX Rules
1. **Zero Horizontal Overflow:** All views must maintain `overflow-x: hidden` and render cleanly on mobile viewport sizes (375px+).
2. **Tabular Figures:** All Indian Rupee figures must use monospace or tabular numerals (`font-mono`) to prevent visual layout shifts.
3. **No Inline CSS with Curly Brackets:** Never write inline Jinja expressions inside `style=""` (e.g., `style="width: {{ x }}%"`). Use `data-progress` attributes and script-driven widths to avoid IDE CSS parser errors.

### 4. Tailwind CSS v4 & Modal Engineering Rules
- **Canonical Gradients:** Never use legacy `bg-gradient-to-*`. Always write `bg-linear-to-tr`, `bg-linear-to-r`, etc.
- **Modal Display Purity:** Never combine conflicting `hidden` and `fixed` display classes directly in modal shells. Use `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center` managed via clean style toggling (`display: none` / `display: flex`) to avoid layout jumps.

2. docs/architecture.md

# System Architecture — AgencyOS

## 1. Application Topology
AgencyOS is architected as a modular Python/Flask monolith using the Application Factory pattern (`create_app`):

[ Client / Browser ] │ HTTPS (Session Cookies + CSRF Tokens) ▼ [ Flask
Application Factory (create_app) ] ├── Blueprints: │ ├── auth_bp (/login,
/register, /logout) │ ├── admin_bp (/admin/dashboard, /admin/projects,
/admin/customers) │ ├── customer_bp (/dashboard, /businesses, /customer/profile)
│ ├── professional_bp (/professional/dashboard, /professional/workspace) │ ├──
payments_bp (/payments/checkout, /payments/webhook) │ └── public_bp (/privacy,
/terms, /refund-policy, /contact, /api/free-audit) ├── Security Middleware: │
├── Flask-Login (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure session cookies) │ ├── Flask-WTF
(CSRF verification on state-changing requests) │ └── Flask-Limiter (Rate
limiting on auth and payment endpoints) ├── Services: │ ├── RazorpayService
(Order creation & HMAC SHA256 webhook verification) │ ├── InvoicingService
(SAC 998311 CGST/SGST/IGST tax calculation) │ └── AiService (Backend-confined
Google Gemini SDK) └── ORM: SQLAlchemy │ ┌────┴───────────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼
[ SQLite / PostgreSQL ] [ External APIs ] (Local: instance/agencyos.db)
(Razorpay, Google Gemini)


## 2. Directory Layout
```text
agencyos1/
├── app/
│   ├── __init__.py           # Application Factory, Core Models & Helpers
│   ├── config.py             # Security, Environment, Timezone & Credentials Validator
│   ├── extensions.py         # SQLAlchemy, LoginManager, CSRF, Limiter
│   ├── routes/               # Modular Flask Blueprints (admin, customer, public, etc.)
│   ├── services/             # Core business logic (Payments, Invoicing, AI)
│   ├── static/               # Uploads & Client Deliverables
│   └── templates/            # Flat Studio Dark Jinja2 Templates
├── docs/                     # 10 Master Documentation Files
├── instance/                 # Protected Local SQLite Database (agencyos.db)
├── tests/                    # Pytest Suite (Smoke, Auth, CSRF, Payments, Workflows)
├── app.py                    # Production WSGI Callable (Gunicorn/Render)
├── run.py                    # Local Development Runner (Port & Debug checks)
├── apply_fund_flow_columns.py# Non-destructive SQLite Schema Migration Script
├── DATABASE_UNIQUENESS_REPORT.md # Unique Indexes & Idempotency Audit
├── DECISIONS.md              # Architecture Decision Log (DEC-001 through DEC-018)
└── README.md                 # Project Overview & Setup Guide

3. Data Integrity & Idempotency

  - Payment Signature Verification: Razorpay webhooks validate signatures using
    RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET before updating database status.
  - Partial Unique Index: Payment.razorpay_payment_id is protected by
    uq_payment_razorpay_payment_id_partial to eliminate duplicate payment
    credits.
  - Escrow Fund Flow: Inbound payments are recorded in Payment and Invoice.
    Outbound talent payouts remain Pending Approval until the client reviews and
    approves the deliverable.

# Complete Feature Inventory — AgencyOS

## 1. Client Management & CRM
- Customer profile with business type, website, target audience, and goals.
- Multi-business support under a single customer account.
- Secure, one-time magic token login links for zero-password access.

## 2. Website Milestone Delivery Engine
- 3-Phase Milestone Gates (50% Advance -> 25% Wireframe/Design -> 25% Launch).
- Deliverable submission tracking with live URL, preview URL, and completion notes.
- Client Sign-Off Gate with strict 2-revision limit.
- 1-Click Paid Scope Add-on Generator (monetizing revisions 3+).

## 3. SEO Retainer Operations
- 30-Day recurring sprint cycle.
- 4-Part Deliverable Checklist (Technical, On-Page, Content, Reporting).
- Day-28 automatic client progress summary.
- Loss-aversion retention warnings before cycle pauses.

## 4. Indian Financials & Invoicing
- SAC Code 998311 tax categorization.
- Automatic tax breakdown: CGST (9%) + SGST (9%) for intra-state; IGST (18%) for inter-state.
- Razorpay Orders & Payment Links API integration.
- Webhook HMAC signature verification and payment idempotency.
- Dynamic UPI QR Code rendering on invoices for direct bank settlement.

## 5. Fund Flow & Talent Payout Architecture
- 100% upfront agency collection via Razorpay into primary agency account.
- Milestone escrow release: Talent payouts marked `Ready to Pay` only upon client deliverable approval.
- Specialist banking profile: `upi_id`, `bank_account_number`, `bank_ifsc`, and `pan_number`.
- Admin payout tracking: `payout_status`, `payout_utr`, and `payout_paid_at`.

## 6. Corbel-Style Executive Workspace
- Studio Dark aesthetic inspired by Linear and Corbel Supply Co.
- Executive KPI tiles with period-over-period delta chips.
- 7-Stage visual pipeline tracker (`Pending Assignment` to `Completed`).
- Expandable project details rows and instant keyboard search (`/` shortcut).

## 7. AI Internal Copilot (Google Gemini)
- Instant SOW & Proposal Generator based on client bullet points.
- Automated Monthly SEO Client Performance Email Drafter.
- Free AI Website & Local SEO Audit Lead Scout.

## 8. Statutory & Legal Compliance
- India DPDP Act (2023) compliant privacy policy.
- Razorpay mandatory legal pages (`/privacy`, `/terms`, `/refund-policy`, `/contact`).
- Form consent notices on lead capture endpoints.

# Data Schema & Dictionary — AgencyOS

## Active Models (in `app/__init__.py`)

### 1. `User`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `name` (VARCHAR(100), Not Null)
- `email` (VARCHAR(120), Unique, Not Null)
- `password` (VARCHAR(255), Not Null)
- `role` (VARCHAR(30), Default: `"customer"`)
- `created_at` (DATETIME, Default: `now()`)
- `email_verified_at` (DATETIME, Nullable)
- `session_version` (INTEGER, Default: 0)

### 2. `CustomerProfile`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `user_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Unique, Not Null)
- `phone`, `location`, `business_name`, `business_type`, `website`
- `social_links`, `business_description`, `target_audience`, `business_goals`, `preferred_budget`
- `profile_completed` (BOOLEAN, Default: False)
- `created_at`, `updated_at` (DATETIME)

### 3. `Business`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `customer_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Not Null)
- `name` (VARCHAR(200), Not Null)
- `business_type`, `location`, `website`, `social_links`, `description`, `target_audience`, `goals`, `preferred_budget`
- `created_at`, `updated_at` (DATETIME, Default: `get_ist_now`)

### 4. `UserToken`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `user_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Not Null, Index)
- `purpose` (VARCHAR(40), Not Null, Index)
- `token_hash` (VARCHAR(64), Unique, Not Null, Index)
- `expires_at` (DATETIME, Not Null, Index)
- `used_at` (DATETIME, Nullable)
- `created_at` (DATETIME, Default: `now()`)
- *Index:* `ix_user_token_user_purpose` (`user_id`, `purpose`)

### 5. `ProfessionalProfile`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `user_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Unique, Not Null)
- `expertise`, `experience`, `about`, `phone`, `location`, `skills`, `technologies`, `skill_level`, `portfolio`, `github`, `linkedin`
- `verification_status` (VARCHAR(30), Default: `"Pending"`)
- `profile_completed` (BOOLEAN, Default: False)
- **Banking / Fund Flow Columns (Added 10/31/2026):**
  - `upi_id` (VARCHAR(100), Nullable)
  - `bank_account_number` (VARCHAR(50), Nullable)
  - `bank_ifsc` (VARCHAR(20), Nullable)
  - `pan_number` (VARCHAR(20), Nullable)

### 6. `Project`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `customer_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Not Null)
- `business_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('business.id'), Nullable)
- `service` (VARCHAR(100), Not Null)
- `package` (VARCHAR(100), Not Null)
- `requirements` (TEXT, Not Null)
- `status` (VARCHAR(50), Default: `"Pending Assignment"`)
- `revision_comment` (TEXT, Nullable)
- `created_at` (DATETIME, Default: `now()`)

### 7. `Payment`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `project_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('project.id'), Not Null)
- `customer_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Not Null)
- `razorpay_order_id` (VARCHAR(100), Not Null, Unique: `uq_payment_razorpay_order_id`)
- `razorpay_payment_id` (VARCHAR(100), Nullable, Partial Index: `uq_payment_razorpay_payment_id_partial`)
- `amount` (INTEGER, Not Null)
- `currency` (VARCHAR(10), Default: `"INR"`)
- `status` (VARCHAR(30), Default: `"Created"`)
- `created_at` (DATETIME, Default: `now()`)
- `paid_at` (DATETIME, Nullable)
- *Index:* `uq_payment_project_customer_created` (`project_id`, `customer_id` WHERE status='Created')

### 8. `ProjectDelivery`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `project_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('project.id'), Not Null, Index)
- `professional_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Not Null, Index)
- `submission_number` (INTEGER, Default: 1)
- `live_url`, `source_url`, `preview_url` (VARCHAR(500), Nullable)
- `completion_notes` (TEXT, Not Null)
- `status` (VARCHAR(30), Default: `"Submitted"`)
- `review_comment` (TEXT, Nullable)
- `submitted_at`, `reviewed_at` (DATETIME)

### 9. `ChatMessage`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `project_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('project.id'), Not Null, Index)
- `sender_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Not Null, Index)
- `message` (TEXT, Not Null)
- `attachment_url` (VARCHAR(500), Nullable)
- `created_at` (DATETIME, Default: `get_ist_now`)

### 10. `Notification`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `user_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Not Null, Index)
- `title` (VARCHAR(200), Not Null)
- `message` (TEXT, Not Null)
- `link` (VARCHAR(500), Nullable)
- `is_read` (BOOLEAN, Default: False)
- `created_at` (DATETIME, Default: `get_ist_now`)

### 11. `Invoice`
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `invoice_number` (VARCHAR(100), Unique, Not Null)
- `project_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('project.id'), Not Null, Index)
- `customer_id` (INTEGER, ForeignKey('user.id'), Not Null, Index)
- `gross_amount` (INTEGER, Not Null)
- `talent_payout` (INTEGER, Not Null)
- `agency_profit` (INTEGER, Not Null)
- `tax_amount` (INTEGER, Default: 0)
- `status` (VARCHAR(30), Default: `"Paid"`)
- `created_at` (DATETIME, Default: `get_ist_now`)
- **Talent Payout Tracking Columns (Added 10/31/2026):**
  - `payout_status` (VARCHAR(30), Default: `"Pending Approval"`, Not Null)
  - `payout_utr` (VARCHAR(100), Nullable)
  - `payout_paid_at` (DATETIME, Nullable)

--- FILE: .\docs\sql_archive\MIGRATION_ACCOUNT_SECURITY.sql ---
-- Account security migration (proposal only; do not execute without approval)
-- Adds email verification and session revocation columns to user.
-- Creates user_token for password reset and email verification.

-- PostgreSQL
ALTER TABLE "user"
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email_verified_at TIMESTAMP NULL;

ALTER TABLE "user"
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_token (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    purpose VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    used_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_user_token_user_id ON user_token(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_user_token_purpose ON user_token(purpose);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_user_token_user_purpose ON user_token(user_id, purpose);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_user_token_expires_at ON user_token(expires_at);

-- NOTE: Existing accounts are NOT automatically marked email-verified by this
-- proposal. Automatic verification of legacy accounts requires an explicit,
-- documented policy decision and is intentionally omitted. New/updated
-- application behavior must treat email_verified_at IS NULL as unverified.

-- SQLite (run separately; SQLite has limited ALTER TABLE support)
-- ALTER TABLE user ADD COLUMN email_verified_at DATETIME;
-- ALTER TABLE user ADD COLUMN session_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
-- CREATE TABLE user_token (...);

--- FILE: .\docs\sql_archive\MIGRATION_PAYMENT_UNIQUENESS.sql ---
-- =====================================================================
-- Proposed migration: payment uniqueness (Stage 6F)
-- Target table: payment
-- Status: PROPOSAL ONLY. Do not execute without separate approval.
-- Database engines covered: PostgreSQL and SQLite.
-- Other database engines require an adapted procedure.
--
-- IMPORTANT:
--   * This file is not a universal cross-engine script. PostgreSQL and
--     SQLite have different procedural SQL, transaction, and locking
--     behavior. Run only the section for the target engine.
--   * This migration is not idempotent with respect to incorrectly named
--     or incorrectly defined existing indexes. Index definitions must be
--     inspected before treating an index as present (see preflight).
--   * CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS checks the index NAME only. It will not
--     replace an existing index that has the wrong definition.
--   * No application database has been modified by this proposal.
--   * This SQL has not been executed or validated against PostgreSQL or
--     SQLite in this repository.
--   * PostgreSQL execution and validation remain outstanding.
-- =====================================================================

-- =====================================================================
-- 1. Common preflight inspection (run before any data change)
-- =====================================================================

-- 1a. Duplicate non-NULL razorpay_order_id values.
-- Expected result: zero rows.
SELECT razorpay_order_id, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM payment
WHERE razorpay_order_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY razorpay_order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- 1b. Duplicate non-NULL razorpay_payment_id values.
-- Expected result: zero rows.
SELECT razorpay_payment_id, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM payment
WHERE razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY razorpay_payment_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- 1c. Multiple Created payments for the same (project_id, customer_id).
-- Expected result: zero rows.
SELECT project_id, customer_id, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM payment
WHERE status = 'Created'
GROUP BY project_id, customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

-- 1d. Empty-string payment IDs that will be normalized to NULL.
-- These rows are not a hard conflict by themselves, but they are reported
-- because their meaning changes from empty string to NULL during migration.
SELECT id, project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id
FROM payment
WHERE razorpay_payment_id = '';

-- 1e. Empty-string order IDs. These cannot be normalized to NULL because
-- razorpay_order_id is NOT NULL and unique. Any row returned here is a
-- hard blocker and must be repaired manually before migration.
-- Expected result: zero rows.
SELECT id, project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id
FROM payment
WHERE razorpay_order_id = '';

-- 1f. Existing payment indexes and their definitions.
-- PostgreSQL:
--   SELECT schemaname, tablename, indexname, indexdef
--   FROM pg_indexes
--   WHERE tablename = 'payment'
--   ORDER BY indexname;
--
-- SQLite:
--   SELECT name, sql
--   FROM sqlite_master
--   WHERE type = 'index'
--     AND tbl_name = 'payment'
--   ORDER BY name;
--   PRAGMA index_list('payment');

-- 1g. Count empty-string payment IDs before normalization.
-- Run this before the UPDATE in section 3 or 4 and record the result as
-- empty_payment_ids_before_normalization.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS empty_payment_ids_before_normalization
FROM payment
WHERE razorpay_payment_id = '';

-- =====================================================================
-- 2. Intended data-changing behavior
-- =====================================================================
-- An empty string is not a real Razorpay payment ID. Before creating the
-- partial unique index, normalize empty strings to NULL. After this change,
-- multiple rows may have NULL razorpay_payment_id; the partial index
-- intentionally allows multiple NULL values.
--
-- This UPDATE is the only data-changing statement in this proposal.

-- =====================================================================
-- 3. PostgreSQL procedure (transactional DDL)
-- =====================================================================
-- Run with psql:
--   \set ON_ERROR_STOP on
--   \i MIGRATION_PAYMENT_UNIQUENESS.sql   -- select only this section
--
-- PostgreSQL DDL is transactional. If any statement fails, the transaction
-- is aborted and must be rolled back. Do not assume SQLite has identical
-- transactional DDL behavior.
--
-- BEGIN;
-- SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s';
--
-- -- Guard: stop immediately if any preflight conflict exists.
-- DO $$
-- BEGIN
--     IF EXISTS (
--         SELECT 1
--         FROM payment
--         WHERE razorpay_order_id IS NOT NULL
--         GROUP BY razorpay_order_id
--         HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
--     ) THEN
--         RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preflight failed: duplicate non-NULL razorpay_order_id values exist in payment.';
--     END IF;
--
--     IF EXISTS (
--         SELECT 1
--         FROM payment
--         WHERE razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL
--         GROUP BY razorpay_payment_id
--         HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
--     ) THEN
--         RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preflight failed: duplicate non-NULL razorpay_payment_id values exist in payment.';
--     END IF;
--
--     IF EXISTS (
--         SELECT 1
--         FROM payment
--         WHERE status = 'Created'
--         GROUP BY project_id, customer_id
--         HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
--     ) THEN
--         RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preflight failed: multiple Created payments exist for the same project_id/customer_id.';
--     END IF;
--
--     IF EXISTS (
--         SELECT 1
--         FROM payment
--         WHERE razorpay_order_id = ''
--     ) THEN
--         RAISE EXCEPTION 'Preflight failed: empty razorpay_order_id values exist in payment.';
--     END IF;
-- END
-- $$;
--
-- Capture empty_payment_ids_before_normalization using query 1g before
-- running this UPDATE.
-- -- Normalize empty payment IDs to NULL.
-- UPDATE payment
-- SET razorpay_payment_id = NULL
-- WHERE razorpay_payment_id = '';
-- After commit, run the post-migration count query in section 6 and confirm
-- empty_payment_ids_after_normalization is 0.
--
-- -- Unique Razorpay order ID across all payment rows.
-- CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_payment_razorpay_order_id
--     ON payment (razorpay_order_id);
--
-- -- Unique non-NULL Razorpay payment ID.
-- CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_payment_razorpay_payment_id_partial
--     ON payment (razorpay_payment_id)
--     WHERE razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL;
--
-- -- At most one Created payment per (project_id, customer_id).
-- CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_payment_project_customer_created
--     ON payment (project_id, customer_id)
--     WHERE status = 'Created';
--
-- COMMIT;
--
-- Recovery:
--   * If any statement fails, run ROLLBACK; and inspect the error.
--   * If a lock timeout occurs, retry during a maintenance window.
--   * If an index name already exists with a different definition, the
--     CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS statement will not repair it. Inspect and
--     resolve the index definition manually before rerunning.

-- =====================================================================
-- 4. SQLite procedure (file-backed database; not in-memory test databases)
-- =====================================================================
-- SQLite supports transactional DDL in many cases, but driver, ORM, and
-- CLI transaction behavior differ from PostgreSQL. Use a verified backup
-- and test this procedure on a copy of the database before production use.
--
-- Recommended SQLite CLI flow:
--   .backup main /path/to/payment-pre-migration-backup.sqlite
--   BEGIN IMMEDIATE;
--
-- SQLite has no procedural RAISE in plain SQL except in triggers. The
-- invalid guard that referenced __migration_preflight_failed__ has been
-- removed. Operator verification is mandatory before any data-changing
-- statement:
--   1. Run preflight queries 1a, 1b, 1c, and 1e. Each must return zero rows.
--   2. Run preflight query 1d and review every returned row.
--   3. Run preflight query 1g and record empty_payment_ids_before_normalization.
--   4. Run the index/constraint definition queries in 1f and compare them
--      with the intended definitions in section 5.
--   5. Only then run the UPDATE and CREATE INDEX statements below.
-- If any preflight query returns an unexpected row, stop and repair the
-- data before continuing.
--
-- -- Normalize empty payment IDs to NULL.
-- UPDATE payment
-- SET razorpay_payment_id = NULL
-- WHERE razorpay_payment_id = '';
--
-- -- Create uniqueness indexes.
-- CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_payment_razorpay_order_id
--     ON payment (razorpay_order_id);
--
-- CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_payment_razorpay_payment_id_partial
--     ON payment (razorpay_payment_id)
--     WHERE razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL;
--
-- CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_payment_project_customer_created
--     ON payment (project_id, customer_id)
--     WHERE status = 'Created';
--
-- COMMIT;
--
-- Recovery:
--   * If the guard query or any later statement fails, run ROLLBACK; and
--     restore from the backup if needed.
--   * If the database is locked, retry after active transactions complete.
--   * SQLite partial index syntax requires SQLite 3.8.0 or newer.
--   * If an index with one of these names already exists with a different
--     definition, SQLite will not replace it. Inspect sqlite_master first.

-- =====================================================================
-- 5. Post-migration verification (run after commit)
-- =====================================================================
-- PostgreSQL:
--   SELECT indexname, indexdef
--   FROM pg_indexes
--   WHERE tablename = 'payment'
--   ORDER BY indexname;
--
-- SQLite:
--   SELECT name, sql
--   FROM sqlite_master
--   WHERE type = 'index'
--     AND tbl_name = 'payment'
--   ORDER BY name;
--
-- Empty payment ID normalization verification:
--   SELECT COUNT(*) AS empty_payment_ids_after_normalization
--   FROM payment
--   WHERE razorpay_payment_id = '';
-- Expected result: 0 rows, because empty strings are normalized to NULL.
--
-- Application verification:
--   Run the focused payment test suite against a migrated copy of the
--   database. Do not run it against the production database until the
--   migration has been separately approved and applied.

--- FILE: .\migrations\env.py ---
import logging
from logging.config import fileConfig

from flask import current_app

from alembic import context

# this is the Alembic Config object, which provides
# access to the values within the .ini file in use.
config = context.config

# Interpret the config file for Python logging.
# This line sets up loggers basically.
fileConfig(config.config_file_name)
logger = logging.getLogger('alembic.env')


def get_engine():
    try:
        # this works with Flask-SQLAlchemy<3 and Alchemical
        return current_app.extensions['migrate'].db.get_engine()
    except (TypeError, AttributeError):
        # this works with Flask-SQLAlchemy>=3
        return current_app.extensions['migrate'].db.engine


def get_engine_url():
    try:
        return get_engine().url.render_as_string(hide_password=False).replace(
            '%', '%%')
    except AttributeError:
        return str(get_engine().url).replace('%', '%%')


# add your model's MetaData object here
# for 'autogenerate' support
# from myapp import mymodel
# target_metadata = mymodel.Base.metadata
config.set_main_option('sqlalchemy.url', get_engine_url())
target_db = current_app.extensions['migrate'].db

# other values from the config, defined by the needs of env.py,
# can be acquired:
# my_important_option = config.get_main_option("my_important_option")
# ... etc.


def get_metadata():
    if hasattr(target_db, 'metadatas'):
        return target_db.metadatas[None]
    return target_db.metadata


def run_migrations_offline():
    """Run migrations in 'offline' mode.

    This configures the context with just a URL
    and not an Engine, though an Engine is acceptable
    here as well.  By skipping the Engine creation
    we don't even need a DBAPI to be available.

    Calls to context.execute() here emit the given string to the
    script output.

    """
    url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    context.configure(
        url=url, target_metadata=get_metadata(), literal_binds=True
    )

    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online():
    """Run migrations in 'online' mode.

    In this scenario we need to create an Engine
    and associate a connection with the context.

    """

    # this callback is used to prevent an auto-migration from being generated
    # when there are no changes to the schema
    # reference: http://alembic.zzzcomputing.com/en/latest/cookbook.html
    def process_revision_directives(context, revision, directives):
        if getattr(config.cmd_opts, 'autogenerate', False):
            script = directives[0]
            if script.upgrade_ops.is_empty():
                directives[:] = []
                logger.info('No changes in schema detected.')

    conf_args = current_app.extensions['migrate'].configure_args
    if conf_args.get("process_revision_directives") is None:
        conf_args["process_revision_directives"] = process_revision_directives

    connectable = get_engine()

    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(
            connection=connection,
            target_metadata=get_metadata(),
            **conf_args
        )

        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

def main():
    print("Writing 100% clean Studio Dark templates (no url_map errors)...")
    for filepath, content in FILES.items():
        dirname = os.path.dirname(filepath)
        if dirname:
            os.makedirs(dirname, exist_ok=True)
        with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)
        print(f"✅ Repaired: {filepath}")

    zip_filename = "agencyos_update.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_filename, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
        for filepath in FILES.keys():
            if os.path.exists(filepath):
                zipf.write(filepath)
        for t in ["templates/index.html", "templates/admin_dashboard.html", "templates/dashboard.html"]:
            if os.path.exists(t):
                zipf.write(t)
        if os.path.exists("docs"):
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk("docs"):
                for file in files:
                    zipf.write(os.path.join(root, file))
        for rf in ["DECISIONS.md", "DATABASE_UNIQUENESS_REPORT.md", "README.md"]:
            if os.path.exists(rf):
                zipf.write(rf)

    print(f"\n🎉 ALL TEMPLATES REPAIRED & PACKAGED INTO {zip_filename}!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, TemplateSyntaxError

env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader("templates"))
print("Scanning all templates for syntax errors...\n")

has_error = False
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("templates"):
    for file in files:
        if file.endswith(".html"):
            rel_path = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, file), "templates").replace("\\", "/")
            try:
                env.get_template(rel_path)
            except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
                has_error = True
                print(f"❌ ERROR in templates/{rel_path} on line {e.lineno}: {e.message}")
            except Exception:
                pass

if not has_error:
    print("✅ All templates parsed cleanly with zero syntax errors!")
