--- FILE: .\scripts\recover_agencyos_source.py ---
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Selective recovery of AgencyOS source data into a disposable target copy."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


ORIGINAL_PATHS = {
    Path(r"D:\AgencyOS\instance\agencyos.db").resolve(),
    Path(r"D:\AgencyOS1\instance\agencyos.db").resolve(),
}
BACKUP_ROOT = Path(r"D:\AgencyOS1_recovery_backups").resolve()
PROTECTED_DIRECTORIES = {
    Path(r"D:\AgencyOS\instance").resolve(),
    Path(r"D:\AgencyOS1\instance").resolve(),
    BACKUP_ROOT,
}

EXPECTED_TABLES = [
    "user", "customer_profile", "professional_profile", "business", "project",
    "professional_project_application", "project_delivery", "payment",
    "chat_message", "invoice", "notification",
]
CORE_TABLES = [
    "user", "customer_profile", "professional_profile", "business", "project",
    "professional_project_application", "project_delivery", "payment",
]
OPTIONAL_TABLES = ["chat_message", "invoice", "notification"]
IMPORT_ORDER = [
    "user", "customer_profile", "professional_profile", "business", "project",
    "professional_project_application", "project_delivery", "payment",
    "chat_message", "invoice", "notification",
]
DEFAULT_MIGRATION_TIMESTAMP = "2026-10-27 00:00:00"


def q(identifier):
    return '"' + str(identifier).replace('"', '""') + '"'


def fail(message):
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def parse_timestamp(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value
    text = str(value).strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace(" ", "T", 1))
        except ValueError:
            return None


def resolve_path(value):
    return Path(value).expanduser().resolve()


def is_protected(path):
    if path in ORIGINAL_PATHS:
        return True, "one of the original AgencyOS databases"
    for protected_dir in PROTECTED_DIRECTORIES:
        try:
            path.relative_to(protected_dir)
            return True, "inside a protected original or backup directory"
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return False, ""


def table_names(conn):
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'"
    ).fetchall()
    return {r[0] for r in rows}


def table_info(conn, table):
    return conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({q(table)})").fetchall()


def col_names(conn, table):
    return [r[1] for r in table_info(conn, table)]


def pk_column(conn, table):
    for row in table_info(conn, table):
        if row[5]:
            return row[1]
    return "id"


def normalize_colinfo(conn, table):
    return [(r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5]) for r in table_info(conn, table)]


def fetch_rows(conn, table):
    columns = col_names(conn, table)
    sql = "SELECT " + ", ".join(q(c) for c in columns) + " FROM " + q(table)
    rows = conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
    return columns, [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in rows]


def count_rows(conn, table):
    return conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {q(table)}").fetchone()[0]


def string_length_limit(column_type):
    match = re.search(r"\((\d+)\)", column_type or "")
    if not match:
        return None
    return int(match.group(1))


def validate_row(table, columns_info, row):
    info_by_name = {r[1]: r for r in columns_info}
    for col, value in row.items():
        r = info_by_name.get(col)
        if r is None:
            continue
        _cid, _name, col_type, notnull, dflt_value, _pk = r
        if notnull and value is None and dflt_value is None:
            fail(f"Required field {table}.{col} is NULL")
        limit = string_length_limit(col_type)
        if limit is not None and value is not None:
            if len(str(value)) > limit:
                fail(
                    f"String length exceeds limit for {table}.{col}: "
                    f"{len(str(value))} > {limit}"
                )


def enable_foreign_keys(conn, label):
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    value = conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys").fetchone()[0]
    if value != 1:
        fail(f"Could not enable foreign-key enforcement on {label} database")
def verify_schema(source_conn, target_conn):
    source_tables = table_names(source_conn)
    target_tables = table_names(target_conn)

    missing_source = [t for t in EXPECTED_TABLES if t not in source_tables]
    if missing_source:
        fail(f"Source database missing expected tables: {missing_source}")

    missing_core = [t for t in CORE_TABLES if t not in target_tables]
    if missing_core:
        fail(f"Target database missing required tables: {missing_core}")

    for table in OPTIONAL_TABLES:
        if table in source_tables and table not in target_tables:
            if count_rows(source_conn, table) > 0:
                fail(f"Source has rows in {table}, but target does not have that table")

    common_tables = sorted(source_tables & target_tables)
    for table in common_tables:
        source_cols = normalize_colinfo(source_conn, table)
        target_cols = normalize_colinfo(target_conn, table)
        source_names = {c[0] for c in source_cols}
        target_names = {c[0] for c in target_cols}
        if not source_names.issubset(target_names):
            fail(
                f"Target missing source columns for table {table}: "
                f"{sorted(source_names - target_names)}"
            )

        source_fks = sorted(source_conn.execute(
            f"PRAGMA foreign_key_list({q(table)})"
        ).fetchall())
        target_fks = sorted(target_conn.execute(
            f"PRAGMA foreign_key_list({q(table)})"
        ).fetchall())

        def fk_key(row):
            # row: (id, seq, table, from, to, on_update, on_delete, match)
            return (row[2], row[3], row[4], row[5], row[6], row[7])

        source_fk_keys = {fk_key(r) for r in source_fks}
        target_fk_keys = {fk_key(r) for r in target_fks}
        if not source_fk_keys.issubset(target_fk_keys):
            fail(f"Foreign-key schema mismatch for table {table}")


def check_primary_key_collisions(source_conn, target_conn):
    source_tables = table_names(source_conn)
    target_tables = table_names(target_conn)
    for table in IMPORT_ORDER:
        if table not in source_tables or table not in target_tables:
            continue
        if table == "user":
            continue
        if count_rows(source_conn, table) == 0:
            continue
        pk = pk_column(source_conn, table)
        source_ids = [r[0] for r in source_conn.execute(
            f"SELECT {q(pk)} FROM {q(table)}"
        ).fetchall()]
        if not source_ids:
            continue
        placeholders = ", ".join("?" for _ in source_ids)
        existing = target_conn.execute(
            f"SELECT {q(pk)} FROM {q(table)} WHERE {q(pk)} IN ({placeholders})",
            source_ids,
        ).fetchall()
        if existing:
            fail(
                f"Unexpected primary-key collision or prior recovery in {table}: "
                f"{len(existing)} matching primary key(s)"
            )
def check_payment_uniqueness(source_conn, target_conn):
    duplicate_orders = source_conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT razorpay_order_id, COUNT(*) AS c
        FROM payment
        WHERE razorpay_order_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY razorpay_order_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        """
    ).fetchall()
    if duplicate_orders:
        fail("Source has duplicate non-NULL razorpay_order_id values")

    duplicate_payments = source_conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT razorpay_payment_id, COUNT(*) AS c
        FROM payment
        WHERE razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY razorpay_payment_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        """
    ).fetchall()
    if duplicate_payments:
        fail("Source has duplicate non-NULL razorpay_payment_id values")

    duplicate_created = source_conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT project_id, customer_id, COUNT(*) AS c
        FROM payment
        WHERE status = 'Created'
        GROUP BY project_id, customer_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        """
    ).fetchall()
    if duplicate_created:
        fail("Source has multiple Created payments for the same project/customer")

    empty_order_ids = source_conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment WHERE razorpay_order_id = ''"
    ).fetchone()[0]
    if empty_order_ids:
        fail("Source has empty-string razorpay_order_id values")

    empty_payment_ids = source_conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment WHERE razorpay_payment_id = ''"
    ).fetchone()[0]

    if count_rows(target_conn, "payment") > 0:
        source_orders = [r[0] for r in source_conn.execute(
            "SELECT razorpay_order_id FROM payment"
        ).fetchall()]
        target_orders = {r[0] for r in target_conn.execute(
            "SELECT razorpay_order_id FROM payment"
        ).fetchall()}
        if [v for v in source_orders if v in target_orders]:
            fail("Source payment order IDs already exist in target")

        source_payment_ids = [r[0] for r in source_conn.execute(
            "SELECT razorpay_payment_id FROM payment WHERE razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL"
        ).fetchall()]
        target_payment_ids = {r[0] for r in target_conn.execute(
            "SELECT razorpay_payment_id FROM payment WHERE razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL"
        ).fetchall()}
        if [v for v in source_payment_ids if v in target_payment_ids]:
            fail("Source payment IDs already exist in target")

    return empty_payment_ids
def build_user_id_map(source_conn, target_conn):
    source_user_ids = [r[0] for r in source_conn.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM user ORDER BY id"
    ).fetchall()]
    target_user_ids = [r[0] for r in target_conn.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM user ORDER BY id"
    ).fetchall()]
    target_user_set = set(target_user_ids)

    for source_id in source_user_ids:
        if source_id in target_user_set and source_id != 1:
            fail(f"Unexpected user primary-key collision: {source_id}")

    used_ids = set(target_user_ids)
    user_id_map = {}
    max_id = max(target_user_ids + source_user_ids) if (target_user_ids or source_user_ids) else 0

    for source_id in sorted(source_user_ids):
        if source_id in used_ids:
            candidate = max_id + 1
            while candidate in used_ids:
                candidate += 1
            user_id_map[source_id] = candidate
            used_ids.add(candidate)
            max_id = max(max_id, candidate)
        else:
            user_id_map[source_id] = source_id
            used_ids.add(source_id)

    return user_id_map
    columns, projects = fetch_rows(source_conn, "project")
    normalized_count = 0
    related_count = 0
    fallback_count = 0
    for project in projects:
        if project.get("created_at") is not None:
            continue
        project_id = project["id"]
        candidates = []
        queries = [
            "SELECT created_at FROM payment WHERE project_id = ? AND created_at IS NOT NULL",
            "SELECT paid_at FROM payment WHERE project_id = ? AND paid_at IS NOT NULL",
            "SELECT created_at FROM professional_project_application WHERE project_id = ? AND created_at IS NOT NULL",
            "SELECT submitted_at FROM project_delivery WHERE project_id = ? AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL",
            "SELECT reviewed_at FROM project_delivery WHERE project_id = ? AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL",
        ]
        for sql in queries:
            for (value,) in source_conn.execute(sql, (project_id,)).fetchall():
                parsed = parse_timestamp(value)
                if parsed is not None:
                    candidates.append((value, parsed))

        if candidates:
            earliest_value, _ = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item[1])
            project["created_at"] = earliest_value
            related_count += 1
        else:
            project["created_at"] = migration_timestamp
            fallback_count += 1
        normalized_count += 1

    return normalized_count, related_count, fallback_count, projects
def compute_sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def verify_source_hash(path, expected_hash):
    actual_hash = compute_sha256(path)
    if actual_hash.lower() != str(expected_hash).lower():
        fail(
            "Source SHA-256 mismatch: "
            f"expected {expected_hash}, got {actual_hash}"
        )
    return actual_hash


def capture_admin_baseline(conn):
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, name, email, role, password FROM user WHERE id = 1"
    ).fetchone()


def check_email_collisions(source_conn, target_conn):
    source_rows = source_conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, email FROM user"
    ).fetchall()
    target_rows = target_conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, email FROM user"
    ).fetchall()

    source_emails = {
        str(row[1]).strip().lower()
        for row in source_rows
        if row[1] is not None
    }
    target_emails = {
        str(row[1]).strip().lower()
        for row in target_rows
        if row[1] is not None
    }
    collisions = sorted(source_emails & target_emails)
    if collisions:
        fail(
            "Case-insensitive email collision between source and target: "
            + ", ".join(collisions)
        )

    seen = set()
    duplicates = set()
    for row in source_rows:
        if row[1] is None:
            continue
        email = str(row[1]).strip().lower()
        if email in seen:
            duplicates.add(email)
        seen.add(email)
    if duplicates:
        print(
            "WARNING: source contains duplicate email addresses: "
            + ", ".join(sorted(duplicates))
        )


def check_optional_tables(source_conn, target_conn):
    source_tables = table_names(source_conn)
    for table in OPTIONAL_TABLES:
        if table in source_tables and count_rows(source_conn, table) > 0:
            fail(
                f"Optional table {table} contains "
                f"{count_rows(source_conn, table)} source row(s), but "
                "foreign-key remapping is not implemented"
            )


def validate_imported_users(source_conn, target_conn, user_id_map, admin_baseline):
    admin_row = target_conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, name, email, role, password FROM user WHERE id = 1"
    ).fetchone()
    if admin_row != admin_baseline:
        fail("Target admin user (id=1) was not preserved exactly")

    for old_id, new_id in user_id_map.items():
        source_password = source_conn.execute(
            "SELECT password FROM user WHERE id = ?", (old_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        target_password = target_conn.execute(
            "SELECT password FROM user WHERE id = ?", (new_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if source_password is None or target_password is None:
            fail(f"Missing user row while validating password hash for {old_id} -> {new_id}")
        if source_password[0] != target_password[0]:
            fail(f"Password hash mismatch for imported user {old_id} -> {new_id}")


def validate_imported_payments(source_conn, target_conn, user_id_map):
    cols, source_rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, "payment")
    for source_row in source_rows:
        target_row = target_conn.execute(
            "SELECT " + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + " FROM payment WHERE id = ?",
            (source_row["id"],),
        ).fetchone()
        if target_row is None:
            fail(f"Imported payment {source_row['id']} is missing")
        target_values = dict(zip(cols, target_row))

        if target_values["project_id"] != source_row["project_id"]:
            fail(f"project_id mismatch for payment {source_row['id']}")
        expected_customer_id = user_id_map[source_row["customer_id"]]
        if target_values["customer_id"] != expected_customer_id:
            fail(f"customer_id mismatch for payment {source_row['id']}")

        for column in cols:
            if column in ("project_id", "customer_id"):
                continue
            if target_values[column] != source_row[column]:
                fail(f"{column} mismatch for payment {source_row['id']}")


def normalize_project_timestamps(source_conn, migration_timestamp):
    columns, projects = fetch_rows(source_conn, "project")
    normalized_count = 0
    related_count = 0
    fallback_count = 0
    for project in projects:
        if project.get("created_at") is not None:
            continue
        project_id = project["id"]
        candidates = []
        queries = [
            "SELECT created_at FROM payment WHERE project_id = ? AND created_at IS NOT NULL",
            "SELECT paid_at FROM payment WHERE project_id = ? AND paid_at IS NOT NULL",
            "SELECT created_at FROM professional_project_application WHERE project_id = ? AND created_at IS NOT NULL",
            "SELECT submitted_at FROM project_delivery WHERE project_id = ? AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL",
            "SELECT reviewed_at FROM project_delivery WHERE project_id = ? AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL",
        ]
        for sql in queries:
            for (value,) in source_conn.execute(sql, (project_id,)).fetchall():
                parsed = parse_timestamp(value)
                if parsed is not None:
                    candidates.append((value, parsed))

        if candidates:
            earliest_value, _ = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item[1])
            project["created_at"] = earliest_value
            related_count += 1
        else:
            project["created_at"] = migration_timestamp
            fallback_count += 1
        normalized_count += 1

    return normalized_count, related_count, fallback_count, projects


def run_migration(source_path, target_path, migration_timestamp, expected_source_sha256=None):
    source_conn = sqlite3.connect(str(source_path))
    target_conn = sqlite3.connect(str(target_path))
    try:
        enable_foreign_keys(source_conn, "source")
        enable_foreign_keys(target_conn, "target")
        verify_schema(source_conn, target_conn)

        # The expected hash, when supplied, is captured by the operator from the
        # immutable source copy immediately after that copy is created. Checking it
        # here detects changes before any target writes, but it cannot by itself
        # prevent concurrent mutation of a live source file.
        if expected_source_sha256 is not None:
            verify_source_hash(source_path, expected_source_sha256)

        source_tables = table_names(source_conn)
        target_tables = table_names(target_conn)

        check_primary_key_collisions(source_conn, target_conn)
        empty_payment_ids = check_payment_uniqueness(source_conn, target_conn)
        check_email_collisions(source_conn, target_conn)
        check_optional_tables(source_conn, target_conn)

        user_id_map = build_user_id_map(source_conn, target_conn)

        normalized_count, related_count, fallback_count, normalized_projects = normalize_project_timestamps(
            source_conn, migration_timestamp
        )
        normalized_project_by_id = {p["id"]: p for p in normalized_projects}

        target_before_counts = {
            t: count_rows(target_conn, t) for t in target_tables
        }
        source_counts = {
            t: count_rows(source_conn, t) for t in source_tables
        }

        admin_baseline = capture_admin_baseline(target_conn)

        target_conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        inserted_counts = {t: 0 for t in IMPORT_ORDER}

        # user
        src_columns, src_users = fetch_rows(source_conn, "user")
        info = table_info(source_conn, "user")
        for row in src_users:
            validate_row("user", info, row)
            new_row = dict(row)
            new_row["id"] = user_id_map[row["id"]]
            target_conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO user (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in src_columns) + ") "
                "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in src_columns) + ")",
                [new_row[c] for c in src_columns],
            )
            inserted_counts["user"] += 1

        validate_imported_users(source_conn, target_conn, user_id_map, admin_baseline)

        if "customer_profile" in source_tables and count_rows(source_conn, "customer_profile") > 0:
            cols, rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, "customer_profile")
            info = table_info(source_conn, "customer_profile")
            for row in rows:
                validate_row("customer_profile", info, row)
                new_row = dict(row)
                new_row["user_id"] = user_id_map[row["user_id"]]
                target_conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO customer_profile (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + ") "
                    "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in cols) + ")",
                    [new_row[c] for c in cols],
                )
                inserted_counts["customer_profile"] += 1

        # professional_profile
        if "professional_profile" in source_tables and count_rows(source_conn, "professional_profile") > 0:
            cols, rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, "professional_profile")
            info = table_info(source_conn, "professional_profile")
            for row in rows:
                validate_row("professional_profile", info, row)
                new_row = dict(row)
                new_row["user_id"] = user_id_map[row["user_id"]]
                target_conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO professional_profile (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + ") "
                    "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in cols) + ")",
                    [new_row[c] for c in cols],
                )
                inserted_counts["professional_profile"] += 1

        # business
        if "business" in source_tables and count_rows(source_conn, "business") > 0:
            cols, rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, "business")
            info = table_info(source_conn, "business")
            for row in rows:
                validate_row("business", info, row)
                new_row = dict(row)
                new_row["customer_id"] = user_id_map[row["customer_id"]]
                target_conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO business (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + ") "
                    "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in cols) + ")",
                    [new_row[c] for c in cols],
                )
                inserted_counts["business"] += 1
        # project
        if "project" in source_tables and count_rows(source_conn, "project") > 0:
            cols, rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, "project")
            info = table_info(source_conn, "project")
            for row in rows:
                validate_row("project", info, row)
                new_row = dict(row)
                new_row["customer_id"] = user_id_map[row["customer_id"]]
                if row["id"] in normalized_project_by_id:
                    new_row["created_at"] = normalized_project_by_id[row["id"]]["created_at"]
                target_conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO project (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + ") "
                    "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in cols) + ")",
                    [new_row[c] for c in cols],
                )
                inserted_counts["project"] += 1

        # professional_project_application
        if "professional_project_application" in source_tables and count_rows(source_conn, "professional_project_application") > 0:
            cols, rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, "professional_project_application")
            info = table_info(source_conn, "professional_project_application")
            for row in rows:
                validate_row("professional_project_application", info, row)
                new_row = dict(row)
                new_row["professional_id"] = user_id_map[row["professional_id"]]
                target_conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO professional_project_application (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + ") "
                    "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in cols) + ")",
                    [new_row[c] for c in cols],
                )
                inserted_counts["professional_project_application"] += 1

        # project_delivery
        if "project_delivery" in source_tables and count_rows(source_conn, "project_delivery") > 0:
            cols, rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, "project_delivery")
            info = table_info(source_conn, "project_delivery")
            for row in rows:
                validate_row("project_delivery", info, row)
                new_row = dict(row)
                new_row["professional_id"] = user_id_map[row["professional_id"]]
                target_conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO project_delivery (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + ") "
                    "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in cols) + ")",
                    [new_row[c] for c in cols],
                )
                inserted_counts["project_delivery"] += 1

        # payment
        if "payment" in source_tables and count_rows(source_conn, "payment") > 0:
            cols, rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, "payment")
            info = table_info(source_conn, "payment")
            for row in rows:
                validate_row("payment", info, row)
                new_row = dict(row)
                new_row["customer_id"] = user_id_map[row["customer_id"]]
                target_conn.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO payment (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + ") "
                    "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in cols) + ")",
                    [new_row[c] for c in cols],
                )
                inserted_counts["payment"] += 1

        validate_imported_payments(source_conn, target_conn, user_id_map)

        for table in ["chat_message", "invoice", "notification"]:
            if table in source_tables and table in target_tables and count_rows(source_conn, table) > 0:
                cols, rows = fetch_rows(source_conn, table)
                info = table_info(source_conn, table)
                for row in rows:
                    validate_row(table, info, row)
                    target_conn.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO " + q(table) + " (" + ", ".join(q(c) for c in cols) + ") "
                        "VALUES (" + ", ".join("?" for _ in cols) + ")",
                        [row[c] for c in cols],
                    )
                    inserted_counts[table] += 1
        # Validate foreign keys before commit.
        fk_issues = target_conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()
        if fk_issues:
            fail(f"Foreign-key check failed: {fk_issues}")

        # Also validate user id 1 preserved.
        admin_row = target_conn.execute("SELECT id, role FROM user WHERE id = 1").fetchone()
        if not admin_row or admin_row[1] != "admin":
            fail("Target admin user with id 1 and role 'admin' was not preserved")

        target_conn.commit()

        target_after_counts = {
            t: count_rows(target_conn, t) for t in target_tables
        }

        summary = {
            "user_id_map": user_id_map,
            "normalized_projects": normalized_count,
            "normalized_related": related_count,
            "normalized_fallback": fallback_count,
            "empty_payment_ids": empty_payment_ids,
            "inserted_counts": inserted_counts,
            "source_counts": source_counts,
            "target_before_counts": target_before_counts,
            "target_after_counts": target_after_counts,
        }
        return summary
    except Exception as exc:
        try:
            target_conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass
        if isinstance(exc, RuntimeError):
            raise
        raise RuntimeError(str(exc)) from exc
    finally:
        try:
            source_conn.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            target_conn.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
def parse_args():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Recover AgencyOS source data into a disposable target copy."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--source-copy", required=True, help="Path to disposable source copy")
    parser.add_argument("--target-copy", required=True, help="Path to disposable target copy")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--confirm-disposable-target",
        action="store_true",
        required=True,
        help="Explicit confirmation that target is disposable",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--expected-source-sha256",
        default=None,
        help="Expected SHA-256 of the immutable source copy",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--migration-timestamp",
        default=DEFAULT_MIGRATION_TIMESTAMP,
        help="Fallback timestamp for projects without related timestamps",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def main():
    args = parse_args()

    source_path = resolve_path(args.source_copy)
    target_path = resolve_path(args.target_copy)

    if not source_path.is_file():
        print("ERROR: source copy does not exist or is not a file")
        return 1
    if not target_path.is_file():
        print("ERROR: target copy does not exist or is not a file")
        return 1

    protected, reason = is_protected(source_path)
    if protected:
        print(f"ERROR: source path is {reason}; refusing to run")
        return 1
    protected, reason = is_protected(target_path)
    if protected:
        print(f"ERROR: target path is {reason}; refusing to run")
        return 1
    if source_path == target_path:
        print("ERROR: source and target paths resolve to the same file")
        return 1

    try:
        summary = run_migration(
            source_path,
            target_path,
            args.migration_timestamp,
            args.expected_source_sha256,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"ERROR: recovery failed and target was rolled back: {exc}")
        return 1

    print("Recovery completed successfully.")
    print("User ID mapping:")
    for old_id, new_id in sorted(summary["user_id_map"].items()):
        print(f"  {old_id} -> {new_id}")
    print(
        "Normalized project created_at values: "
        f"{summary['normalized_projects']} "
        f"(related_timestamp={summary['normalized_related']}, "
        f"migration_timestamp={summary['normalized_fallback']})"
    )
    print(f"Empty payment IDs preserved: {summary['empty_payment_ids']}")
    print("Inserted counts:")
    for table in IMPORT_ORDER:
        print(f"  {table}: {summary['inserted_counts'].get(table, 0)}")
    print("Source counts:")
    for table, value in sorted(summary["source_counts"].items()):
        print(f"  {table}: {value}")
    print("Target counts before:")
    for table, value in sorted(summary["target_before_counts"].items()):
        print(f"  {table}: {value}")
    print("Target counts after:")
    for table, value in sorted(summary["target_after_counts"].items()):
        print(f"  {table}: {value}")
    print("Foreign-key check: 0 issues")
    print("Target admin id 1: preserved")
    print("Payment uniqueness preflight: passed")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

    <p class="text-xs text-zinc-400 mb-6">Are you sure you want to end your current active session?</p>
    <form method="POST" action="{{ url_for('logout') }}" class="space-y-3">
      <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="{{ csrf_token() }}">
      <button type="submit" class="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white font-bold text-xs transition">Confirm Sign Out</button>
      <a href="{{ url_for('dashboard') }}" class="block w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 font-bold text-xs transition">Cancel</a>
    </form>
  </div>
</body></html>"""


def main():
    print("=" * 65)
    print("Overhauling ALL Remaining Templates (Studio Dark Architecture)")
    print("=" * 65)

    # 1. Write each template cleanly
    for filepath, content in TEMPLATES.items():
        dirname = os.path.dirname(filepath)
        if dirname:
            os.makedirs(dirname, exist_ok=True)
        with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)
        print(f"✅ Upgraded: {filepath}")

    # 2. Automatically verify syntax using Jinja2
    print("\nVerifying template syntax...")
    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader("templates"))
    errors = 0
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk("templates"):
        for file in files:
            if file.endswith(".html"):
                rel_path = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(root, file), "templates").replace("\\", "/")
                try:
                    env.get_template(rel_path)
                except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
                    print(f"❌ Syntax Error in templates/{rel_path} line {e.lineno}: {e.message}")
                    errors += 1
                except Exception:
                    pass

    if errors == 0:
        print("🎉 ZERO SYNTAX ERRORS! All templates parsed cleanly.")
    else:
        print(f"⚠️ {errors} syntax warnings found.")

    # 3. Update agencyos_update.zip
    zip_filename = "agencyos_update.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_filename, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk("templates"):
            for file in files:
                zipf.write(os.path.join(root, file))
        if os.path.exists("docs"):
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk("docs"):
                for file in files:
                    zipf.write(os.path.join(root, file))
        for rf in ["DECISIONS.md", "DATABASE_UNIQUENESS_REPORT.md", "README.md"]:
            if os.path.exists(rf):
                zipf.write(rf)

    print(f"\n📦 Full project archive updated at: {os.path.abspath(zip_filename)}")
    print("=" * 65)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

/* ============================================================
   DOM READY
============================================================ */

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    // Close modal when clicking outside its content
    document.querySelectorAll(".modal-overlay").forEach(modal => {

        modal.addEventListener("click", (event) => {

            if (event.target === modal) {
                modal.classList.remove("show");
                document.body.classList.remove("modal-open");
            }

        });

    });


    // Close modals with Escape key
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {

        if (event.key === "Escape") {
            closeService();
            closeLogin();
        }

    });

});


/* ============================================================
   MOBILE MENU
============================================================ */

function toggleMobileMenu() {

    const menu = document.getElementById("mobile-menu");

    if (!menu) {
        return;
    }

    menu.classList.toggle("show");
}


function closeMobileMenu() {

    const menu = document.getElementById("mobile-menu");

    if (!menu) {
        return;
    }

    menu.classList.remove("show");
}

    }
}

    }

/* ============================================================
   SERVICE MODAL
============================================================ */

function openService(slug) {

    const modal = document.getElementById("service-modal");
    const content = document.getElementById("service-modal-content");

    if (!modal || !content) {
        return;
    }

    const service = servicesData.find(
        service => service.slug === slug
    );

    if (!service) {

        content.innerHTML = `
            <div class="modal-service-header">
                <h2>Service not found</h2>
                <p>
                    We could not load the requested service.
                </p>
            </div>
        `;

        modal.classList.add("show");
        document.body.classList.add("modal-open");

        return;
    }


    let packagesHTML = "";

    service.packages.forEach((pkg, index) => {

        const featuresHTML = pkg.features
            .map(feature => `
                <span class="package-feature">
                    ${feature}
                </span>
            `)
            .join("");


        packagesHTML += `
            <div class="package-item">

                <div class="package-top">

                    <h3>
                        ${pkg.name}
                    </h3>

                    <span class="package-price">
                        ₹${formatPrice(pkg.price)}
                    </span>

                </div>

                <p>
                    ${pkg.description}
                </p>

                <div class="package-features">
                    ${featuresHTML}
                </div>

                <button
                    class="btn btn-primary full-width package-select-button"
                    onclick="selectPackage(
                        '${service.slug}',
                        ${pkg.id}
                    )"
                    style="margin-top: 15px;"
                >
                    Select Package
                </button>

            </div>
        `;

    });
    content.innerHTML = `

        <div class="modal-service-header">

            <div class="modal-service-icon">
                ${service.icon}
            </div>

            <h2>
                ${service.name}
            </h2>

            <p>
                ${service.short_description}
            </p>

        </div>


        <div class="package-list">

            ${packagesHTML}

        </div>

    `;


    modal.classList.add("show");

    document.body.classList.add("modal-open");
}


/* ============================================================
   CLOSE SERVICE MODAL
============================================================ */

function closeService() {

    const modal = document.getElementById("service-modal");

    if (!modal) {
        return;
    }

    modal.classList.remove("show");

    document.body.classList.remove("modal-open");
}


/* ============================================================
   PACKAGE SELECTION
============================================================ */

function selectPackage(serviceSlug, packageId) {

    const service = servicesData.find(
        service => service.slug === serviceSlug
    );

    if (!service) {
        return;
    }


    const selectedPackage = service.packages.find(
        pkg => pkg.id === packageId
    );

    if (!selectedPackage) {
        return;
    }


    /*
       We are not creating an order yet.

       In the next development phase this button will lead to:

       Package
          ↓
       Customer Login
          ↓
       Requirements Form
          ↓
       Order
          ↓
       Payment
    */


    closeService();

    showNotification(
        `${selectedPackage.name} selected`
    );
}


/* ============================================================
   LOGIN MODAL
============================================================ */
function openLogin() {

    closeMobileMenu();

    const modal = document.getElementById("login-modal");

    if (!modal) {
        return;
    }

    modal.classList.add("show");

    document.body.classList.add("modal-open");
}

    if (!modal) {
        return;
    }

    modal.classList.remove("show");

    document.body.classList.remove("modal-open");
}


/* ============================================================
   COMING SOON
============================================================ */

function showComingSoon() {

    showNotification(
        "Customer accounts will be available in the next phase."
    );

}


/* ============================================================
   NOTIFICATION
============================================================ */

function showNotification(message) {

    // Remove an existing notification
    const existing = document.querySelector(".agency-notification");

    if (existing) {
        existing.remove();
    }


    const notification = document.createElement("div");

    notification.className = "agency-notification";

    notification.innerHTML = `
        <span class="notification-icon">✓</span>
        <span>${message}</span>
    `;


    document.body.appendChild(notification);


    // Small animation
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        notification.classList.add("visible");
    });


    // Automatically remove
    setTimeout(() => {

        notification.classList.remove("visible");

        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.remove();
        }, 250);

    }, 2800);

}


/* ============================================================
   PRICE FORMATTER
============================================================ */

function formatPrice(price) {

    return Number(price).toLocaleString("en-IN");

}

    <!-- =========================================================
         GLOBAL JAVASCRIPT
         ========================================================= -->

    <script>

        (function () {

            "use strict";


            const body =
                document.body;

            const sidebarToggle =
                document.getElementById(
                    "adminSidebarToggle"
                );

            const sidebarToggleIcon =
                document.getElementById(
                    "adminSidebarToggleIcon"
                );

            const mobileMenu =
                document.getElementById(
                    "adminMobileMenu"
                );

            const sidebarOverlay =
                document.getElementById(
                    "adminSidebarOverlay"
                );

            const backToTop =
                document.getElementById(
                    "adminBackToTop"
                );


            const SIDEBAR_STORAGE_KEY =
                "agencyos_admin_sidebar_collapsed";


            /* =====================================================
               SIDEBAR STORAGE
               ===================================================== */

            function getStoredSidebarState() {

                try {

                    return (
                        localStorage.getItem(
                            SIDEBAR_STORAGE_KEY
                        ) === "true"
                    );

                } catch (error) {

                    return false;

                }

            }


            function saveSidebarState(
                collapsed
            ) {

                try {

                    localStorage.setItem(
                        SIDEBAR_STORAGE_KEY,
                        collapsed
                            ? "true"
                            : "false"
                    );

                } catch (error) {}

            }


            /* =====================================================
               SIDEBAR TOGGLE
               ===================================================== */

            function updateSidebarToggle() {

                if (!sidebarToggle) {
                    return;
                }


                const collapsed =
                    body.classList.contains(
                        "sidebar-collapsed"
                    );


                sidebarToggle.setAttribute(
                    "aria-expanded",
                    collapsed
                        ? "false"
                        : "true"
                );


                sidebarToggle.setAttribute(
                    "aria-label",
                    collapsed
                        ? "Open sidebar"
                        : "Close sidebar"
                );


                sidebarToggle.setAttribute(
                    "title",
                    collapsed
                        ? "Open sidebar"
                        : "Close sidebar"
                );


                if (sidebarToggleIcon) {

                    sidebarToggleIcon.textContent =
                        collapsed
                            ? "âž¡"
                            : "â¬…";

                }

            }


            function setSidebarCollapsed(
                collapsed,
                saveState = true
            ) {

                body.classList.toggle(
                    "sidebar-collapsed",
                    collapsed
                );


                updateSidebarToggle();


                if (saveState) {

                    saveSidebarState(
                        collapsed
                    );

                }

            }


            function toggleSidebar() {

                const collapsed =
                    body.classList.contains(
                        "sidebar-collapsed"
                    );


                setSidebarCollapsed(
                    !collapsed
                );

            }


            if (sidebarToggle) {

                sidebarToggle.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    toggleSidebar
                );

            }


            /* =====================================================
               MOBILE SIDEBAR
               ===================================================== */

            function openMobileSidebar() {

                body.classList.add(
                    "mobile-sidebar-open"
                );


                if (mobileMenu) {

                    mobileMenu.setAttribute(
                        "aria-expanded",
                        "true"
                    );

                    mobileMenu.setAttribute(
                        "aria-label",
                        "Close admin menu"
                    );

                    mobileMenu.setAttribute(
                        "title",
                        "Close menu"
                    );

                    mobileMenu.textContent =
                        "âœ•";

                }


                if (sidebarOverlay) {

                    sidebarOverlay.setAttribute(
                        "aria-hidden",
                        "false"
                    );

                }

            }


            function closeMobileSidebar() {

                body.classList.remove(
                    "mobile-sidebar-open"
                );


                if (mobileMenu) {

                    mobileMenu.setAttribute(
                        "aria-expanded",
                        "false"
                    );

                    mobileMenu.setAttribute(
                        "aria-label",
                        "Open admin menu"
                    );

                    mobileMenu.setAttribute(
                        "title",
                        "Open menu"
                    );

                    mobileMenu.textContent =
                        "â˜°";

                }


                if (sidebarOverlay) {

                    sidebarOverlay.setAttribute(
                        "aria-hidden",
                        "true"
                    );

                }

            }


            function toggleMobileSidebar() {

                if (
                    body.classList.contains(
                        "mobile-sidebar-open"
                    )
                ) {

                    closeMobileSidebar();

                } else {

                    openMobileSidebar();

                }

            }


            if (mobileMenu) {

                mobileMenu.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    toggleMobileSidebar
                );

            }


            if (sidebarOverlay) {

                sidebarOverlay.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    closeMobileSidebar
                );

            }


            /* =====================================================
               NAVIGATION
               ===================================================== */

            const navLinks =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".admin-nav-link"
                );


            navLinks.forEach(
                function (link) {

                    link.addEventListener(
                        "click",
                        function () {

                            if (
                                window.innerWidth <= 900
                            ) {

                                closeMobileSidebar();

                            }

                        }
                    );

                }
            );


            /* =====================================================
               RESPONSIVE SIDEBAR
               ===================================================== */

            function handleResize() {

                if (
                    window.innerWidth > 900
                ) {

                    closeMobileSidebar();

                }

            }


            window.addEventListener(
                "resize",
                handleResize
            );


            /* =====================================================
               ACTIVE NAVIGATION
               ===================================================== */

            function detectActiveNavigation() {

                const currentPath =
                    window.location.pathname;


                navLinks.forEach(
                    function (link) {

                        link.classList.remove(
                            "active"
                        );

                    }
                );


                if (
                    currentPath ===
                    "{{ url_for('admin_dashboard') }}"
                ) {

                    activateNav("dashboard");

                    return;

                }


                if (
                    currentPath.startsWith(
                        "/admin/project-management"
                    )
                ) {

                    activateNav(
                        "project-management"
                    );

                    return;

                }


                if (
                    currentPath.startsWith(
                        "/admin/project-review"
                    ) ||
                    currentPath.includes(
                        "/admin/project/"
                    )
                ) {

                    activateNav(
                        "project-review"
                    );

                    return;

                }


                if (
                    currentPath.startsWith(
                        "/admin/customers"
                    )
                ) {

                    activateNav("customers");

                    return;

                }


                if (
                    currentPath.startsWith(
                        "/admin/professionals"
                    )
                ) {

                    activateNav("professionals");

                    return;

                }


                if (
                    currentPath.startsWith(
                        "/admin/applications"
                    )
                ) {

                    activateNav("applications");

                    return;

                }

            }


            function activateNav(
                navigationName
            ) {

                const link =
                    document.querySelector(
                        '[data-admin-nav="' +
                        navigationName +
                        '"]'
                    );


                if (link) {

                    link.classList.add(
                        "active"
                    );

                }

            }


            /* =====================================================
               FLASH CLOSE
               ===================================================== */

            const flashCloseButtons =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".admin-flash-close"
                );


            flashCloseButtons.forEach(
                function (button) {

                    button.addEventListener(
                        "click",
                        function () {

                            const flash =
                                button.closest(
                                    ".admin-flash"
                                );


                            if (!flash) {
                                return;
                            }


                            flash.style.opacity =
                                "0";

                            flash.style.transform =
                                "translateY(-6px)";


                            setTimeout(
                                function () {

                                    flash.remove();

                                },
                                200
                            );

                        }
                    );

                }
            );


            /* =====================================================
               BACK TO TOP
               ===================================================== */

            function updateBackToTop() {

                if (!backToTop) {
                    return;
                }


                if (
                    window.scrollY > 400
                ) {

                    backToTop.classList.add(
                        "visible"
                    );

                } else {

                    backToTop.classList.remove(
                        "visible"
                    );

                }

            }


            if (backToTop) {

                backToTop.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function () {

                        window.scrollTo({

                            top:
                                0,

                            behavior:
                                "smooth"

                        });

                    }
                );

            }


            window.addEventListener(
                "scroll",
                updateBackToTop,
                {
                    passive:
                        true
                }
            );


            /* =====================================================
               ESCAPE KEY
               ===================================================== */

            document.addEventListener(
                "keydown",
                function (event) {

                    if (
                        event.key === "Escape"
                    ) {

                        if (
                            body.classList.contains(
                                "mobile-sidebar-open"
                            )
                        ) {

                            closeMobileSidebar();

                        }

                    }

                }
            );


            /* =====================================================
               INITIAL SIDEBAR STATE
               ===================================================== */

            const storedCollapsed =
                getStoredSidebarState();


            if (
                window.innerWidth > 900
            ) {

                setSidebarCollapsed(
                    storedCollapsed,
                    false
                );

            } else {

                setSidebarCollapsed(
                    true,
                    false
                );

            }


            /* =====================================================
               INITIALIZE
               ===================================================== */

            detectActiveNavigation();

            updateBackToTop();

            updateSidebarToggle();

        })();

    </script>


    {% block extra_js %}{% endblock %}

</body>
</html>

<script>
  function switchCorbelTab(tabId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(function (el) { el.classList.remove('active'); });
    var target = document.getElementById('tab-pane-' + tabId);
    if (target) target.classList.add('active');

    ['overview', 'analytics', 'kanban'].forEach(function (t) {
      var btn = document.getElementById('btn-tab-' + t);
      if (btn) {
        btn.className = (t === tabId)
          ? 'corbel-tab-active px-4 py-1.5 rounded transition cursor-pointer'
          : 'corbel-tab-inactive px-4 py-1.5 rounded transition cursor-pointer';
      }
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // Tab switching
    var tabOverview = document.getElementById('btn-tab-overview');
    var tabAnalytics = document.getElementById('btn-tab-analytics');
    var tabKanban = document.getElementById('btn-tab-kanban');

    if (tabOverview) tabOverview.addEventListener('click', function () { switchCorbelTab('overview'); });
    if (tabAnalytics) tabAnalytics.addEventListener('click', function () { switchCorbelTab('analytics'); });
    if (tabKanban) tabKanban.addEventListener('click', function () { switchCorbelTab('kanban'); });

    // Filter Trigger
    var filterBtn = document.getElementById('applyFiltersBtn');
    if (filterBtn) {
      filterBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var search = document.getElementById('projectSearch').value;
        var status = document.getElementById('statusFilter').value;
        window.location.href = "{{ url_for('admin.admin_dashboard') }}?page=1&status=" + encodeURIComponent(status) + "&search=" + encodeURIComponent(search);
      });
    }

    // Broadcast Modal
    var broadcastModal = document.getElementById('broadcastModal');
    var openBroadcast = document.getElementById('openBroadcastBtn');
    var closeBroadcast = document.getElementById('closeBroadcastBtn');
    var cancelBroadcast = document.getElementById('cancelBroadcastBtn');

    if (openBroadcast) openBroadcast.addEventListener('click', function () { broadcastModal.classList.remove('hidden'); });
    if (closeBroadcast) closeBroadcast.addEventListener('click', function () { broadcastModal.classList.add('hidden'); });
    if (cancelBroadcast) cancelBroadcast.addEventListener('click', function () { broadcastModal.classList.add('hidden'); });

    // AI Modal
    var aiModal = document.getElementById('aiModal');
    var openAi = document.getElementById('openAiBtn');
    var closeAi = document.getElementById('closeAiBtn');

    if (openAi) openAi.addEventListener('click', function () { aiModal.classList.remove('hidden'); });
    if (closeAi) closeAi.addEventListener('click', function () { aiModal.classList.add('hidden'); });

    var aiGenerateBtn = document.getElementById('aiGenerateBtn');
    if (aiGenerateBtn) {
      aiGenerateBtn.addEventListener('click', async function () {
        var client = document.getElementById('aiClientName').value;
        var service = document.getElementById('aiServiceType').value;
        var notes = document.getElementById('aiNotes').value;
        var resultArea = document.getElementById('aiResult');

        if (!notes.trim()) { alert('Enter scope notes or requirements.'); return; }

        aiGenerateBtn.disabled = true;
        aiGenerateBtn.textContent = 'Generating proposal...';
        resultArea.value = 'Connecting to Gemini AI Engine...';

        var formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('csrf_token', '{{ csrf_token() }}');
        formData.append('client_name', client);
        formData.append('service_type', service);
        formData.append('notes', notes);

        try {
          var res = await fetch('/api/ai/generate-scope', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
          var data = await res.json();
          aiGenerateBtn.disabled = false;
          aiGenerateBtn.textContent = 'Generate Proposal Draft ⚡';
          if (data.error) {
            resultArea.value = 'Error: ' + data.error;
          } else {
            resultArea.value = data.scope;
          }
        } catch (err) {
          aiGenerateBtn.disabled = false;
          aiGenerateBtn.textContent = 'Generate Proposal Draft ⚡';
          resultArea.value = 'Network failure: ' + err;
        }
      });
    }

    var copyAiBtn = document.getElementById('copyAiBtn');
    if (copyAiBtn) {
      copyAiBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var text = document.getElementById('aiResult').value;
        if (!text) return;
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        alert('SOW copied to clipboard.');
      });
    }

    // ApexCharts Render
    var gaugeOptions = {
      chart: { type: 'radialBar', height: 200, sparkline: { enabled: true } },
      series: [86],
      colors: ['#f4f4f5'],
      plotOptions: {
        radialBar: {
          startAngle: -90, endAngle: 90,
          track: { background: "#27272a", strokeWidth: '97%' },
          dataLabels: { name: { show: false }, value: { offsetY: -2, fontSize: '24px', fontWeight: 700, color: '#ffffff', formatter: function(val) { return val + '%'; } } }
        }
      },
      stroke: { lineCap: "round" }
    };
    new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#corbelGaugeChart"), gaugeOptions).render();

    var barOptions = {
      chart: { type: 'bar', height: 240, toolbar: { show: false }, background: 'transparent' },
      series: [{ name: 'Escrow Ingested', data: [18000, 24000, 32000, 28000, 42000, 37500] }],
      colors: ['#f4f4f5'],
      plotOptions: { bar: { borderRadius: 4, columnWidth: '35%' } },

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var modal = document.getElementById("proModal");
    var closeBtn = document.getElementById("closeProModalBtn");
    var dismissBtn = document.getElementById("dismissProModalBtn");
    var modalVerifyForm = document.getElementById("modalVerifyForm");
    var modalVerifyBtn = document.getElementById("modalVerifyBtn");

    function closeModal() {
      if (modal) modal.classList.add("hidden");
    }

    if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener("click", closeModal);
    if (dismissBtn) dismissBtn.addEventListener("click", closeModal);

    document.querySelectorAll(".view-pro-btn").forEach(function (button) {
      button.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var ds = this.dataset;
        document.getElementById("modalProName").textContent = ds.proName;
        document.getElementById("modalProEmail").textContent = ds.proEmail;
        document.getElementById("modalProExpertise").textContent = ds.proExpertise;
        document.getElementById("modalProUpi").textContent = ds.proUpi;
        document.getElementById("modalProBank").textContent = ds.proBank;
        document.getElementById("modalProIfsc").textContent = ds.proIfsc;
        document.getElementById("modalProPan").textContent = ds.proPan;
        document.getElementById("modalProSkills").textContent = ds.proSkills;
        document.getElementById("modalProPending").textContent = '₹' + parseFloat(ds.proPending || 0).toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById("modalProAvailable").textContent = '₹' + parseFloat(ds.proAvailable || 0).toFixed(2);
        
        var portLink = document.getElementById("modalProPortfolio");
        portLink.href = ds.proPortfolio;
        portLink.textContent = ds.proPortfolio;

        if (modalVerifyForm) {
          modalVerifyForm.action = "/admin/professionals/" + encodeURIComponent(ds.proId) + "/verify";
        }
        if (modalVerifyBtn) {
          if (ds.proVerified === "true") {
            modalVerifyBtn.classList.add("hidden");
          } else {
            modalVerifyBtn.classList.remove("hidden");
          }
        }

        if (modal) modal.classList.remove("hidden");
      });
    });
  });
</script>
{% endblock %}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    var colorText = document.getElementById("primary_color_text");
    var colorPicker = document.getElementById("primary_color_picker");
    var nameInput = document.getElementById("agency_name");
    var logoInput = document.getElementById("logo_url");
    var previewName = document.getElementById("preview_name");
    var previewMark = document.getElementById("preview_mark");
    var previewAction = document.getElementById("preview_action");
    var previewInitials = document.getElementById("preview_initials");
    var previewLogo = document.getElementById("preview_logo");
    var previewHex = document.getElementById("preview_hex");

    // Initialize colors safely from data attributes
    if (previewMark) {
      var initialBg = previewMark.dataset.bgColor || "#09090b";
      var initialText = previewMark.dataset.textColor || "#ffffff";
      previewMark.style.backgroundColor = initialBg;
      previewMark.style.color = initialText;
    }

    function updateColor(value, source) {
      if (!/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(value)) return;
      var normalized = value.toLowerCase();
      if (previewMark) previewMark.style.backgroundColor = normalized;
      if (previewHex) previewHex.textContent = normalized;
      if (source !== "picker" && colorPicker) colorPicker.value = normalized;
    }

    function updateName() {
      if (!nameInput) return;
      var val = nameInput.value.trim() || "AgencyOS";
      if (previewName) previewName.textContent = val;
      if (previewInitials) previewInitials.textContent = val.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    }

    function updateLogo() {
      if (!logoInput || !previewLogo || !previewInitials) return;
      var url = logoInput.value.trim();
      if (!url || !url.startsWith("http")) {
        previewLogo.removeAttribute("src");
        previewLogo.classList.add("hidden");
        previewInitials.classList.remove("hidden");
        return;
      }
      previewLogo.onload = function () {
        previewLogo.classList.remove("hidden");
        previewInitials.classList.add("hidden");
      };
      previewLogo.onerror = function () {
        previewLogo.classList.add("hidden");
        previewInitials.classList.remove("hidden");
      };
      previewLogo.src = url;
    }

    if (colorText) colorText.addEventListener("input", function () { updateColor(colorText.value.trim(), "text"); });
    if (colorPicker) colorPicker.addEventListener("input", function () {
      colorText.value = colorPicker.value;
      updateColor(colorPicker.value, "picker");
    });
    if (nameInput) nameInput.addEventListener("input", updateName);
    if (logoInput) logoInput.addEventListener("input", updateLogo);

    updateName();
    updateLogo();
  });
</script>
{% endblock %}

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    // 1. Reject Withdrawal Modal
    var rejectModal = document.getElementById("rejectWthModal");
    var rejectForm = document.getElementById("rejectWthForm");

    document.querySelectorAll(".reject-wth-btn").forEach(function (button) {
      button.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var reqId = this.dataset.requestId;
        if (rejectForm) rejectForm.action = "/admin/withdrawals/" + encodeURIComponent(reqId) + "/reject";
        if (rejectModal) rejectModal.classList.remove("hidden");
      });
    });

    var closeReject = document.getElementById("closeRejectWthBtn");
    var cancelReject = document.getElementById("cancelRejectWthBtn");
    if (closeReject) closeReject.addEventListener("click", function() { rejectModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
    if (cancelReject) cancelReject.addEventListener("click", function() { rejectModal.classList.add("hidden"); });

    // 2. Legacy Invoice Payout Modal
    var payoutModal = document.getElementById("payoutModal");
    var payoutForm = document.getElementById("payoutForm");
    var amountDisplay = document.getElementById("modalAmountDisplay");

    document.querySelectorAll(".release-payout-btn").forEach(function (button) {
      button.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var invoiceId = this.dataset.invoiceId;
        var amountStr = this.dataset.amount;
        var currency = this.dataset.currency || "INR";
        var amount = parseFloat(amountStr) || 0;

        if (payoutForm) payoutForm.action = "/admin/invoice/" + encodeURIComponent(invoiceId) + "/release-payout";
        if (amountDisplay) {
          amountDisplay.textContent = new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, {
            style: "currency",
            currency: currency
          }).format(amount);
        }
        if (payoutModal) payoutModal.classList.remove("hidden");
      });
    });

    var closePayout = document.getElementById("closePayoutModalBtn");
    var cancelPayout = document.getElementById("cancelPayoutModalBtn");
    if (closePayout) closePayout.addEventListener("click", function() { payoutModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
    if (cancelPayout) cancelPayout.addEventListener("click", function() { payoutModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
  });
</script>
{% endblock %}

  <!-- Live Chat Auto-Polling Script -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var projectId = "{{ project.id }}";
      var apiEndpoint = "/api/project/" + projectId + "/messages"; // or professional/api/...
      var chatStream = document.getElementById("chatStream");
      var lastMessageCount = 0;

      function pollChat() {
        fetch(apiEndpoint)
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(data => {
            if (data.success && data.messages) {
              if (data.messages.length !== lastMessageCount) {
                lastMessageCount = data.messages.length;
                var html = "";
                data.messages.forEach(function (msg) {
                  var bgClass = msg.is_me ? "bg-zinc-850" : "bg-zinc-950";
                  html += `
                    <div class="p-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 ${bgClass}">
                      <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mb-1">
                        <span class="font-bold text-zinc-300">${msg.sender_name}</span>
                        <span>${msg.time}</span>
                      </div>
                      <p class="text-zinc-200 font-sans text-xs leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">${msg.message}</p>
                    </div>
                  `;
                });
                chatStream.innerHTML = html;
                chatStream.scrollTop = chatStream.scrollHeight;
              }
            }
          })
          .catch(err => console.error("Chat sync error:", err));
      }

      // Poll every 3 seconds for lightning-fast real-time chat
      setInterval(pollChat, 3000);
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var tabs = {
        customer: document.getElementById("tab-customer"),
        professional: document.getElementById("tab-professional"),
        admin: document.getElementById("tab-admin")
      };

      var roleInput = document.getElementById("loginRoleInput");
      var btnText = document.getElementById("btnText");
      var roleSubtext = document.getElementById("roleSubtext");
      var registerPrompt = document.getElementById("registerPrompt");

      var roleData = {
        customer: {
          btn: "Sign In to Client Portal →",
          sub: "Review milestone gates, approve deliverables, and inspect ledger invoices.",
          prompt: 'Need a client account? <a href="/register" class="text-white hover:underline font-bold">Register Business</a>'
        },
        professional: {
          btn: "Sign In to Specialist Hub →",
          sub: "Access assigned sprints, submit staging URLs, and track 45% allocations.",
          prompt: 'Apply to join our network? <a href="/register" class="text-white hover:underline font-bold">Apply as Specialist</a>'
        },
        admin: {
          btn: "Sign In to Command Center →",
          sub: "Restricted administrative console: pipelines, settlements, and compliance.",
          prompt: '<span class="text-zinc-500">Authorized Personnel Only • Node IST</span>'
        }
      };

      function setRole(role) {
        if (!roleInput || !btnText || !roleSubtext || !registerPrompt) return;
        roleInput.value = role;

        Object.keys(tabs).forEach(function (k) {
          if (tabs[k]) {
            tabs[k].className = "py-2 rounded bg-transparent text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer";
          }
        });

        if (tabs[role]) {
          tabs[role].className = "py-2 rounded bg-white text-zinc-950 font-bold transition cursor-pointer";
        }

        var config = roleData[role];
        btnText.textContent = config.btn;
        roleSubtext.textContent = config.sub;
        registerPrompt.innerHTML = config.prompt;
      }

      if (tabs.customer) tabs.customer.addEventListener("click", function () { setRole("customer"); });
      if (tabs.professional) tabs.professional.addEventListener("click", function () { setRole("professional"); });
      if (tabs.admin) tabs.admin.addEventListener("click", function () { setRole("admin"); });
    });
  </script>
</body>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var btn = document.getElementById("payBtn");
      if (!btn) return;
      btn.addEventListener("click", launchRazorpayCheckout);
    });

    function showError(msg) {
      var box = document.getElementById("paymentErrorBox");
      var text = document.getElementById("paymentErrorMsg");
      if (!box || !text) return;
      text.textContent = msg;
      box.classList.add("flex");
      box.classList.remove("hidden");
    }

    async function launchRazorpayCheckout() {
      var btn = document.getElementById("payBtn");
      var btnText = document.getElementById("btnText");
      if (!btn || !btnText) return;

      var ds = btn.dataset;
      var projectId = ds.projectId;
      var addonId = ds.addonId;
      var milestoneNum = ds.milestoneNum;
      var currency = ds.currency || "INR";
      var csrfToken = ds.csrf;
      var agencyName = ds.agencyName;
      var logoUrl = ds.logoUrl;
      var primaryColor = ds.primaryColor;
      var description = ds.description;
      var grossFormatted = ds.grossFormatted;
      var returnUrl = ds.returnUrl;

      btn.disabled = true;
      btnText.textContent = "Connecting to Gateway...";

      try {
        var payload = {};
        if (addonId) {
          payload.addon_id = parseInt(addonId, 10);
        } else {
          payload.milestone = parseInt(milestoneNum, 10);
        }

        var orderRes = await fetch("/payment/create-order/" + encodeURIComponent(projectId), {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken
          },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });

        var orderData = await orderRes.json();
        if (!orderRes.ok || !orderData.success) {
          throw new Error(orderData.message || "Failed to initialize gateway order.");
        }

        // Automatic development sandbox fallback
        if (orderData.order_id && orderData.order_id.startsWith("order_sim_")) {
          btnText.textContent = "Simulating test verification...";
          var verifyRes = await fetch("/payment/verify", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type": "application/json",
              "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              razorpay_order_id: orderData.order_id,
              razorpay_payment_id: "pay_sim_" + Date.now(),
              razorpay_signature: "simulated_test_signature"
            })
          });

          var verifyData = await verifyRes.json();
          if (verifyRes.ok && verifyData.success) {
            window.location.href = returnUrl;
            return;
          } else {
            throw new Error(verifyData.message || "Simulation failed.");
          }
        }

        // Real Gateway Checkout Modal
        var options = {
          key: orderData.key_id,
          amount: orderData.amount,
          currency: orderData.currency || currency,
          name: agencyName,
          image: logoUrl,
          description: description,
          order_id: orderData.order_id,
          handler: async function (response) {
            btnText.textContent = "Verifying cryptographic ledger...";
            try {
              var verifyRes = await fetch("/payment/verify", {
                method: "POST",
                headers: {
                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                  "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  razorpay_order_id: response.razorpay_order_id,
                  razorpay_payment_id: response.razorpay_payment_id,
                  razorpay_signature: response.razorpay_signature
                })
              });

              var verifyData = await verifyRes.json();
              if (verifyRes.ok && verifyData.success) {
                window.location.href = returnUrl;
              } else {
                throw new Error(verifyData.message || "Payment verification failed.");
              }
            } catch (err) {
              btn.disabled = false;
              btnText.textContent = "Retry Payment";
              showError(err.message);
            }
          },
          modal: {
            ondismiss: function () {
              btn.disabled = false;
              btnText.textContent = "Pay Milestone " + milestoneNum + " of 3 (" + grossFormatted + ") →";
            }
          },
          theme: { color: primaryColor }
        };

        if (window.Razorpay) {
          var rzp = new window.Razorpay(options);
          rzp.open();
        } else {
          throw new Error("Payment gateway SDK not loaded.");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btnText.textContent = "Pay Milestone " + milestoneNum + " of 3 (" + grossFormatted + ") →";
        showError(err.message);
      }
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
