  <!-- SCRIPT CONTROLLERS -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      // 1. View Project Details Modal
      var detailsModal = document.getElementById("projectDetailsModal");
      var currentSelectedProjectId = null;
      var currentSelectedPackage = null;
      var currentSelectedService = null;

      document.querySelectorAll(".view-project-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var ds = this.dataset;
          currentSelectedProjectId = ds.projectId;
          currentSelectedPackage = ds.package;
          currentSelectedService = ds.service;

          document.getElementById("detailsModalTitle").textContent = "#" + ds.projectId + " · " + ds.service;
          document.getElementById("detailsModalPackage").textContent = ds.package;
          document.getElementById("detailsModalCurrency").textContent = ds.currency;
          document.getElementById("detailsModalSkills").textContent = ds.skills;
          document.getElementById("detailsModalReqs").textContent = ds.requirements;

          if (detailsModal) detailsModal.classList.remove("hidden");
        });
      });

      var closeDetails = document.getElementById("closeDetailsModalBtn");
      var dismissDetails = document.getElementById("dismissDetailsModalBtn");
      if (closeDetails) closeDetails.addEventListener("click", function () { detailsModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
      if (dismissDetails) dismissDetails.addEventListener("click", function () { detailsModal.classList.add("hidden"); });

      // Apply directly from inside Details Modal
      var applyFromDetailsBtn = document.getElementById("applyFromDetailsBtn");
      if (applyFromDetailsBtn) {
        applyFromDetailsBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (detailsModal) detailsModal.classList.add("hidden");
          if (currentSelectedProjectId) {
            openProposal(currentSelectedProjectId, currentSelectedPackage, currentSelectedService);
          }
        });
      }

      // 2. Proposal Modal
      var proposalModal = document.getElementById("proposalModal");
      var proposalForm = document.getElementById("proposalForm");
      var proposalSummary = document.getElementById("modalProjectSummary");

      function openProposal(pid, pkg, srv) {
        if (proposalSummary) proposalSummary.textContent = "#" + pid + " · " + pkg + " (" + srv + ")";
        if (proposalForm) proposalForm.action = "/professional/project/" + encodeURIComponent(pid) + "/apply";
        if (proposalModal) proposalModal.classList.remove("hidden");
      }

      document.querySelectorAll(".open-proposal-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var pid = this.dataset.projectId;
          var pkg = this.dataset.package;
          var srv = this.dataset.service;
          openProposal(pid, pkg, srv);
        });
      });

      var closeProposal = document.getElementById("closeProposalModalBtn");
      var cancelProposal = document.getElementById("cancelProposalModalBtn");
      if (closeProposal) closeProposal.addEventListener("click", function () { proposalModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
      if (cancelProposal) cancelProposal.addEventListener("click", function () { proposalModal.classList.add("hidden"); });

      // 3. Withdrawal Modal
      var withdrawModal = document.getElementById("withdrawModal");
      var openWithdrawBtn = document.getElementById("openWithdrawModalBtn");
      var closeWithdrawBtn = document.getElementById("closeWithdrawModalBtn");
      var cancelWithdrawBtn = document.getElementById("cancelWithdrawModalBtn");

      if (openWithdrawBtn) {
        openWithdrawBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (withdrawModal) withdrawModal.classList.remove("hidden");
        });
      }

      if (closeWithdrawBtn) closeWithdrawBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { withdrawModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
      if (cancelWithdrawBtn) cancelWithdrawBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { withdrawModal.classList.add("hidden"); });

      // Tab switcher in withdraw modal
      var tabUPI = document.getElementById("tabUPI");
      var tabBank = document.getElementById("tabBank");
      var upiSec = document.getElementById("upiSection");
      var bankSec = document.getElementById("bankSection");
      var payoutModeInput = document.getElementById("payoutModeInput");

      if (tabUPI && tabBank) {
        tabUPI.addEventListener("click", function () {
          payoutModeInput.value = "UPI";
          tabUPI.className = "py-2 px-3 border border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-950/60 rounded text-xs font-bold text-indigo-300 cursor-pointer";
          tabBank.className = "py-2 px-3 border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 rounded text-xs text-zinc-400 cursor-pointer";
          if (upiSec) upiSec.classList.remove("hidden");
          if (bankSec) bankSec.classList.add("hidden");
        });

        tabBank.addEventListener("click", function () {
          payoutModeInput.value = "BANK_TRANSFER";
          tabBank.className = "py-2 px-3 border border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-950/60 rounded text-xs font-bold text-indigo-300 cursor-pointer";
          tabUPI.className = "py-2 px-3 border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 rounded text-xs text-zinc-400 cursor-pointer";
          if (upiSec) upiSec.classList.add("hidden");
          if (bankSec) bankSec.classList.remove("hidden");
        });
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var detailsModal = document.getElementById("projectDetailsModal");
      var currentSelectedProjectId = null;
      var currentSelectedPackage = null;
      var currentSelectedService = null;

      document.querySelectorAll(".view-project-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var ds = this.dataset;
          currentSelectedProjectId = ds.projectId;
          currentSelectedPackage = ds.package;
          currentSelectedService = ds.service;

          document.getElementById("detailsModalTitle").textContent = "#" + ds.projectId + " · " + ds.service;
          document.getElementById("detailsModalPackage").textContent = ds.package;
          document.getElementById("detailsModalCurrency").textContent = ds.currency;
          document.getElementById("detailsModalSkills").textContent = ds.skills;
          document.getElementById("detailsModalReqs").textContent = ds.requirements;

          if (detailsModal) detailsModal.classList.remove("hidden");
        });
      });

      var closeDetails = document.getElementById("closeDetailsModalBtn");
      var dismissDetails = document.getElementById("dismissDetailsModalBtn");
      if (closeDetails) closeDetails.addEventListener("click", function () { detailsModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
      if (dismissDetails) dismissDetails.addEventListener("click", function () { detailsModal.classList.add("hidden"); });

      var applyFromDetailsBtn = document.getElementById("applyFromDetailsBtn");
      if (applyFromDetailsBtn) {
        applyFromDetailsBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (detailsModal) detailsModal.classList.add("hidden");
          if (currentSelectedProjectId) {
            openProposal(currentSelectedProjectId, currentSelectedPackage, currentSelectedService);
          }
        });
      }

      var proposalModal = document.getElementById("proposalModal");
      var proposalForm = document.getElementById("proposalForm");
      var proposalSummary = document.getElementById("modalProjectSummary");

      function openProposal(pid, pkg, srv) {
        if (proposalSummary) proposalSummary.textContent = "#" + pid + " · " + pkg + " (" + srv + ")";
        if (proposalForm) proposalForm.action = "/professional/project/" + encodeURIComponent(pid) + "/apply";
        if (proposalModal) proposalModal.classList.remove("hidden");
      }

      document.querySelectorAll(".open-proposal-btn").forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var pid = this.dataset.projectId;
          var pkg = this.dataset.package;
          var srv = this.dataset.service;
          openProposal(pid, pkg, srv);
        });
      });

      var closeProposal = document.getElementById("closeProposalModalBtn");
      var cancelProposal = document.getElementById("cancelProposalModalBtn");
      if (closeProposal) closeProposal.addEventListener("click", function () { proposalModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
      if (cancelProposal) cancelProposal.addEventListener("click", function () { proposalModal.classList.add("hidden"); });
    });
  </script>
</body>

  <!-- Live Chat Auto-Polling Script -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var projectId = "{{ project.id }}";
      var apiEndpoint = "/api/project/" + projectId + "/messages"; // or professional/api/...
      var chatStream = document.getElementById("chatStream");
      var lastMessageCount = 0;

      function pollChat() {
        fetch(apiEndpoint)
          .then(res => res.json())
          .then(data => {
            if (data.success && data.messages) {
              if (data.messages.length !== lastMessageCount) {
                lastMessageCount = data.messages.length;
                var html = "";
                data.messages.forEach(function (msg) {
                  var bgClass = msg.is_me ? "bg-zinc-850" : "bg-zinc-950";
                  html += `
                    <div class="p-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 ${bgClass}">
                      <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mb-1">
                        <span class="font-bold text-zinc-300">${msg.sender_name}</span>
                        <span>${msg.time}</span>
                      </div>
                      <p class="text-zinc-200 font-sans text-xs leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">${msg.message}</p>
                    </div>
                  `;
                });
                chatStream.innerHTML = html;
                chatStream.scrollTop = chatStream.scrollHeight;
              }
            }
          })
          .catch(err => console.error("Chat sync error:", err));
      }

      // Poll every 3 seconds for lightning-fast real-time chat
      setInterval(pollChat, 3000);
    });
  </script>

  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var tabClient = document.getElementById("tab-reg-customer");
      var tabSpecialist = document.getElementById("tab-reg-specialist");
      var accountTypeInput = document.getElementById("accountTypeInput");
      var clientFields = document.getElementById("clientFields");
      var specialistFields = document.getElementById("specialistFields");
      var submitBtn = document.getElementById("regSubmitBtn");

      function setRegRole(role) {
        if (!accountTypeInput || !tabClient || !tabSpecialist || !clientFields || !specialistFields || !submitBtn) return;
        accountTypeInput.value = role;

        if (role === "customer") {
          tabClient.className = "py-2 rounded bg-white text-zinc-950 font-bold transition cursor-pointer";
          tabSpecialist.className = "py-2 rounded bg-transparent text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer";
          clientFields.classList.remove("hidden");
          specialistFields.classList.add("hidden");
          submitBtn.textContent = "Create Client Organization Account →";
        } else {
          tabSpecialist.className = "py-2 rounded bg-white text-zinc-950 font-bold transition cursor-pointer";
          tabClient.className = "py-2 rounded bg-transparent text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer";
          specialistFields.classList.remove("hidden");
          clientFields.classList.add("hidden");
          submitBtn.textContent = "Apply as Specialist Partner →";
        }
      }

      if (tabClient) tabClient.addEventListener("click", function () { setRegRole("customer"); });
      if (tabSpecialist) tabSpecialist.addEventListener("click", function () { setRegRole("professional"); });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <!-- Complete Multi-Step Controller Script -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      var form = document.getElementById("projectForm");
      var steps = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".step-section"));
      var indicators = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("[data-step-nav]"));
      var progressFill = document.getElementById("progressFill");
      var progressText = document.getElementById("progressText");
      var progressBar = document.getElementById("progressBar");
      var prevBtn = document.getElementById("prevStepBtn");
      var nextBtn = document.getElementById("nextStepBtn");
      var submitBtn = document.getElementById("submitBtn");
      var packageSelect = document.getElementById("package");
      var currencySelect = document.getElementById("currency");
      var skillsInput = document.getElementById("required_skills");

      var currencySymbols = { INR: "₹", USD: "$", EUR: "€", GBP: "£" };
      var currentStep = 0;

      // Handle Quick-Add Skill Chips
      document.querySelectorAll(".skill-chip").forEach(function (chip) {
        chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var skill = this.getAttribute("data-skill");
          if (!skillsInput) return;
          var current = skillsInput.value.trim();
          var skillsList = current ? current.split(",").map(function(s) { return s.trim(); }) : [];
          if (!skillsList.includes(skill)) {
            skillsList.push(skill);
            skillsInput.value = skillsList.join(", ");
          }
        });
      });

      function updatePackagePrices() {
        if (!packageSelect || !currencySelect) return;
        var selectedCurrency = currencySelect.value;

        if (packageSelect.value === "Starter Retainer" && selectedCurrency !== "INR") {
          currencySelect.value = "INR";
          selectedCurrency = "INR";
          alert("Notice: Starter Retainer subscriptions are billed in INR only.");
        }

        Array.from(packageSelect.options).forEach(function (option) {
          if (option.value === "Starter Retainer") {
            option.textContent = "Starter Retainer · ₹14,999/mo (INR only)";
            return;
          }
          var price = option.dataset[selectedCurrency.toLowerCase()];
          if (price) {
            var formattedPrice = Number(price).toLocaleString();
            option.textContent = option.value + " · " + currencySymbols[selectedCurrency] + formattedPrice;
          }
        });
      }

      if (packageSelect) packageSelect.addEventListener("change", updatePackagePrices);
      if (currencySelect) currencySelect.addEventListener("change", updatePackagePrices);
      updatePackagePrices();

      function updateUI() {
        // Toggle step containers
        steps.forEach(function (step, index) {
          step.classList.toggle("active", index === currentStep);
        });

        // Update button visibility & states
        if (prevBtn) {
          prevBtn.disabled = (currentStep === 0);
        }

        if (nextBtn && submitBtn) {
          if (currentStep === steps.length - 1) {
            nextBtn.classList.add("hidden");
            submitBtn.classList.remove("hidden");
          } else {
            nextBtn.classList.remove("hidden");
            submitBtn.classList.add("hidden");
          }
        }

        // Update progress bar
        var progress = ((currentStep + 1) / steps.length) * 100;
        if (progressFill) progressFill.style.width = progress + "%";
        if (progressText) progressText.textContent = "Gate " + (currentStep + 1) + " of " + steps.length;
        if (progressBar) progressBar.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(currentStep + 1));

        // Update top stepper indicators
        indicators.forEach(function (indicator, index) {
          var isCurrent = (index === currentStep);
          indicator.setAttribute("aria-current", isCurrent ? "step" : "false");
          if (isCurrent) {
            indicator.className = "step-btn p-2 rounded-lg border border-white bg-zinc-950 text-left transition";
            var label = indicator.querySelector(".font-bold");
            if (label) label.className = "text-xs font-bold text-white block truncate font-sans";
          } else {
            indicator.className = "step-btn p-2 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 text-left transition";
            var label2 = indicator.querySelector(".font-bold");
            if (label2) label2.className = "text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400 block truncate font-sans";
          }
        });
      }

      function validateCurrentStep() {
        var currentSection = steps[currentStep];
        var fields = currentSection.querySelectorAll("input, select, textarea");

        for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
          var field = fields[i];
          if (field.type === "hidden" || field.disabled || field.type === "checkbox") continue;
          if (!field.required && !field.value) continue;

          if (!field.checkValidity() || (field.required && !field.value.trim())) {
            field.focus();
            if (typeof field.reportValidity === "function") {
              field.reportValidity();
            }
            return false;
          }
        }
        return true;
      }

      // Step button clicks
      indicators.forEach(function (indicator) {
        indicator.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var target = Number(this.dataset.stepNav);
          if (target < currentStep) {
            currentStep = target;
            updateUI();
          } else if (target > currentStep && validateCurrentStep()) {
            currentStep = target;
            updateUI();
          }
        });
      });

      // Previous button
      if (prevBtn) {
        prevBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (currentStep > 0) {
            currentStep--;
            updateUI();
          }
        });
      }

      // Next button
      if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
          if (validateCurrentStep() && currentStep < steps.length - 1) {
            currentStep++;
            updateUI();
          }
        });
      }

      // Form submit validation
      if (form) {
        form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
          if (!validateCurrentStep()) {
            e.preventDefault();
          }
        });
      }

      updateUI();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
  (function () {
    var root = document.querySelector("[data-notification-center]");
    if (!root) return;

    var toggle = root.querySelector("[data-notification-toggle]");
    var panel = root.querySelector("[data-notification-panel]");
    var badge = root.querySelector("[data-notification-badge]");
    var list = root.querySelector("[data-notification-list]");
    var status = root.querySelector("[data-notification-status]");
    var clearButton = root.querySelector("[data-notification-clear]");

    var loading = false;
    var busy = false;
    var lastUnreadCount = 0;

    function setStatus(message, isError) {
      if (!status) return;
      status.textContent = message;
      if (isError) {
        status.className = "px-4 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] text-red-400 border-b border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950/60";
      } else {
        status.className = "px-4 py-2 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950/60";
      }
    }

    function safeHref(value) {
      try {
        var url = new URL(value, window.location.origin);
        return url.origin === window.location.origin ? url.pathname + url.search + url.hash : null;
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    async function refresh() {
      if (loading || !root.dataset.notificationsUrl) return;
      loading = true;

      try {
        var response = await fetch(root.dataset.notificationsUrl, {
          credentials: "same-origin",
          headers: { "Accept": "application/json" }
        });
        var data = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !data.success) {
          throw new Error(data.error || "Could not fetch notifications.");
        }

        var unreadCount = Number(data.unread_count || data.count || 0);
        lastUnreadCount = unreadCount;
        if (badge) {
          badge.textContent = unreadCount > 99 ? "99+" : String(unreadCount);
          badge.hidden = unreadCount < 1;
        }
        if (toggle) {
          toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", unreadCount ? "Notifications, " + unreadCount + " unread" : "Notifications");
        }

        if (list) list.replaceChildren();
        if (clearButton) clearButton.disabled = unreadCount === 0 || busy;

        if (!Array.isArray(data.notifications) || data.notifications.length === 0) {
          setStatus("", false);
          var empty = document.createElement("p");
          empty.className = "px-5 py-8 text-center font-mono text-xs text-zinc-500";
          empty.textContent = "All milestones up to date. No pending alerts.";
          if (list) list.append(empty);
          return;
        }

        setStatus(unreadCount + " unread · latest " + data.notifications.length + " events", false);

        data.notifications.forEach(function (n) {
          var href = safeHref(n.link);
          var row = document.createElement(href ? "a" : "div");
          row.className = "notification-row block px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-800/40 transition " + (n.is_read ? "" : "unread");
          if (href) {
            row.href = href;
            row.dataset.notificationId = String(n.id);
          }

          var headline = document.createElement("div");
          headline.className = "flex items-start justify-between gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-200 font-sans";

          var title = document.createElement("span");
          title.className = "truncate";
          title.textContent = n.title || "Project Alert";
          headline.append(title);

          if (!n.is_read) {
            var dot = document.createElement("span");
            dot.className = "h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white shrink-0 mt-1";
            headline.append(dot);
          }

          var message = document.createElement("p");
          message.className = "mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-sans leading-relaxed";
          message.textContent = n.message || "";

          var timestamp = document.createElement("time");
          timestamp.className = "block mt-1.5 font-mono text-[9px] text-zinc-500";
          timestamp.textContent = n.created_at || "";

          row.append(headline, message, timestamp);

          if (href) {
            row.addEventListener("click", async function (event) {
              if (event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
              event.preventDefault();
              if (busy) return;
              busy = true;
              if (clearButton) clearButton.disabled = true;

              try {
                var endpoint = root.dataset.markReadUrl.replace(/0\/read$/, encodeURIComponent(n.id) + "/read");
                var markRes = await fetch(endpoint, {
                  method: "POST",
                  credentials: "same-origin",
                  headers: { "X-CSRFToken": root.dataset.csrfToken, "Accept": "application/json" }
                });
                var result = await markRes.json();
                if (!markRes.ok || !result.success) {
                  throw new Error(result.error || "Could not mark notification read.");
                }
                window.location.assign(href);
              } catch (err) {
                busy = false;
                setStatus(err.message || "Could not open alert.", true);
                if (clearButton) clearButton.disabled = lastUnreadCount === 0;
              }
            });
          }

          if (list) list.append(row);
        });
      } catch (err) {
        setStatus(err.message || "Failed to load notifications.", true);
      } finally {
        loading = false;
      }
    }

    function closePanel(restoreFocus) {
      if (!panel || !toggle) return;
      panel.hidden = true;
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      if (restoreFocus) toggle.focus();
    }

    if (toggle && panel) {
      toggle.addEventListener("click", async function () {
        var opening = panel.hidden;
        panel.hidden = !opening;
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(opening));
        if (opening) {
          await refresh();
          panel.focus();
        }
      });
    }

    if (clearButton) {
      clearButton.addEventListener("click", async function () {
        if (busy || clearButton.disabled) return;
        busy = true;
        clearButton.disabled = true;
        setStatus("Clearing all notifications...", false);

        try {
          var response = await fetch(root.dataset.clearAllUrl, {
            method: "POST",
            credentials: "same-origin",
            headers: { "X-CSRFToken": root.dataset.csrfToken, "Accept": "application/json" }
          });
          var result = await response.json();
          if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
            throw new Error(result.error || "Could not clear alerts.");
          }
          await refresh();
        } catch (err) {
          setStatus(err.message || "Could not clear alerts.", true);
        } finally {
          busy = false;
          if (clearButton) clearButton.disabled = lastUnreadCount === 0;
        }
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (panel && !root.contains(event.target) && !panel.hidden) {
        closePanel(false);
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && panel && !panel.hidden) {
        closePanel(true);
      }
    });

    refresh();
  })();
</script>

--- FILE: .\tests\conftest.py ---
"""Common pytest fixtures for the AgencyOS test suite."""

import os

import pytest
from sqlalchemy.engine.url import make_url

from app import create_app
from app.extensions import db as _db


def _is_postgresql_driver(drivername):
    """Return whether a SQLAlchemy driver name refers to PostgreSQL."""
    normalized = (drivername or "").strip().lower()
    return normalized == "postgres" or normalized.startswith("postgresql")


def _postgresql_connection_identity(raw_url):
    """Return a credential-free identity for a PostgreSQL connection.

    Equivalent spellings such as ``postgres://``, ``postgresql://``, and
    ``postgresql+psycopg://`` are normalized to the same identity.  Omitted
    ports default to PostgreSQL's standard port.  Credentials, driver spelling,
    and query options are deliberately excluded.  ``None`` is returned for
    non-PostgreSQL or unparseable URLs.
    """
    try:
        url = make_url(raw_url)
    except Exception:
        return None

    if not _is_postgresql_driver(url.drivername):
        return None

    host = (url.host or "").strip().lower()
    port = url.port
    if port is None:
        port = 5432
    database = url.database or ""
    return (host, port, database)


def _configured_test_database_url():
    """Return the explicitly configured PostgreSQL test database URL, if any."""
    return os.getenv("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "").strip()


def _validate_test_database_url(raw_url):
    """Validate and normalize an opt-in PostgreSQL test database URL.

    The URL is never logged. Validation fails closed: an invalid, shared,
    or non-dedicated database URL raises instead of falling back to SQLite.
    """
    try:
        url = make_url(raw_url)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError("TEST_DATABASE_URL is not a valid SQLAlchemy URL.") from exc

    # Normalize the canonical PostgreSQL driver spelling to the single
    # approved driver. Other PostgreSQL drivers are rejected.
    if url.drivername == "postgresql":
        url = url.set(drivername="postgresql+psycopg")
    if url.drivername != "postgresql+psycopg":
        raise ValueError(
            "TEST_DATABASE_URL must use the approved PostgreSQL driver "
            "(postgresql+psycopg)."
        )

    database_name = url.database or ""
    if not (
        database_name.endswith("_test") or database_name.endswith("_ci")
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "TEST_DATABASE_URL must target a dedicated test database whose "
            "name ends in '_test' or '_ci'."
        )

    # Prevent accidental use of the application/development database, including
    # equivalent PostgreSQL spellings and omitted default ports.
    application_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "").strip()
    if application_url:
        application_identity = _postgresql_connection_identity(application_url)
        test_identity = _postgresql_connection_identity(url)
        if (
            application_identity is not None
            and test_identity is not None
            and application_identity == test_identity
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "TEST_DATABASE_URL must not target the application database."
            )

    return url.render_as_string(hide_password=False)


def extract_csrf_token(html_text):
    """Pull the first embedded ``csrf_token`` value out of rendered HTML."""
    token = None

    for line in html_text.splitlines():
        if 'name="csrf_token"' in line:
            start = line.find('value="') + len('value="')
            end = line.find('"', start)
            token = line[start:end]
            break

    return token


def assert_test_database(application):
    """Fail closed before schema operations, checking engines rather than config."""
    assert application.config["TESTING"] is True
    assert application.config["WTF_CSRF_ENABLED"] is True
    assert set(_db.engines) == {None}, "Unexpected database binds in tests"
    for engine in _db.engines.values():
        url = engine.url
        if url.drivername == "sqlite":
            assert url.database == ":memory:", "Refusing a non-memory database"
        elif url.drivername.startswith("postgresql+psycopg"):
            database_name = url.database or ""
            assert (
                database_name.endswith("_test")
                or database_name.endswith("_ci")
            ), "Refusing a non-test PostgreSQL database"
        else:
            raise AssertionError(
                "Unsupported test database driver: %s" % url.drivername
            )


@pytest.fixture
def app():
    """Configure the isolated engine before initializing SQLAlchemy."""
    raw_test_database_url = _configured_test_database_url()
    if raw_test_database_url:
        sqlalchemy_database_uri = _validate_test_database_url(
            raw_test_database_url
        )
        sqlalchemy_engine_options = {"pool_pre_ping": True}
    else:
        sqlalchemy_database_uri = "sqlite:///:memory:"
        sqlalchemy_engine_options = {}

    try:
        app = create_app("default", {
            "TESTING": True,
            "SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI": sqlalchemy_database_uri,
            "SQLALCHEMY_BINDS": {},
            "SQLALCHEMY_ENGINE_OPTIONS": sqlalchemy_engine_options,
            "WTF_CSRF_ENABLED": True,
            "RATELIMIT_ENABLED": True,
            "RATELIMIT_STORAGE_URI": "memory://",
            "SECRET_KEY": "test-secret-key-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
        })
    except Exception as exc:
        # Fail closed: do not silently fall back to another database.
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Unable to initialize the configured test database: %s"
            % type(exc).__name__
        ) from exc

    with app.app_context():
        try:
            assert_test_database(app)
            _db.create_all()
        except Exception as exc:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Unable to initialize the configured test database: %s"
                % type(exc).__name__
            ) from exc
        try:
            yield app
        finally:
            _db.session.remove()
            assert_test_database(app)
            _db.drop_all()
            _db.engine.dispose()

            "/login",
            data={

@pytest.fixture
def csrf_token(client, app):
    """Return a valid CSRF token bound to the current test session.

    Flask-WTF keeps a random *raw* value in ``session['csrf_token']`` and
    sends the client a signed version of it. Both halves are produced here
    so POST helpers never have to scrape a rendered template.
    """
    import hashlib
    import os

    from itsdangerous import URLSafeTimedSerializer

    raw_token = hashlib.sha1(os.urandom(64)).hexdigest()

    secret_key = (
        app.config.get("WTF_CSRF_SECRET_KEY")
        or app.config["SECRET_KEY"]
    )

    signed_token = URLSafeTimedSerializer(
        secret_key,
        salt="wtf-csrf-token",
    ).dumps(raw_token)

    with client.session_transaction() as session:
        session["csrf_token"] = raw_token

    return signed_token


@pytest.fixture
def csrf_post(client, csrf_token):
    """POST helper that always submits a valid CSRF token."""
    def _post(url, data=None, **kwargs):
        payload = dict(data or {})
        payload["csrf_token"] = csrf_token
        return client.post(url, data=payload, **kwargs)
    return _post
def pytest_configure(config):
    """Register the opt-in PostgreSQL test marker."""
    config.addinivalue_line(
        "markers",
        "postgres: requires TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing to a dedicated "
        "PostgreSQL test database",
    )

from app.models import ActivityLog, Project


def test_new_project_is_recorded_and_shown_in_workspace(
    app, client, factories, login, csrf_post
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("activity-create@example.com")
    login("activity-create@example.com", "customer")

    response = csrf_post(
        "/start-project",
        data={
            "service": "SEO",
            "package": "SEO Starter",
            "brief": "Improve organic search visibility.",
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code == 302
    with app.app_context():
        project = Project.query.filter_by(customer_id=customer_id).one()
        entry = ActivityLog.query.filter_by(
            project_id=project.id,
            action="PROJECT_CREATED",
        ).one()
        assert entry.user_id == customer_id
        assert entry.category == "info"

    workspace = client.get(f"/project/{project.id}")
    assert workspace.status_code == 200
    assert b"Project Activity Audit Trail" in workspace.data
    assert b"Project workspace created and awaiting SOW signature." in workspace.data


def test_sow_signature_is_recorded_with_signer(
    app, client, factories, login, csrf_post
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("activity-sow@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
    login("activity-sow@example.com", "customer")

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/project/{project_id}/contract",
        data={
            "agreed_terms": "on",
            "signer_name": "Avery Client",
            "signer_title": "Founder",
        },
    )

    assert response.status_code == 302
    with app.app_context():
        entry = ActivityLog.query.filter_by(
            project_id=project_id,
            action="SOW_SIGNED",
        ).one()
        assert entry.user_id == customer_id
        assert entry.category == "success"
        assert "Avery Client (Founder)" in entry.description


def test_submission_revision_and_approval_are_recorded(
    app, client, factories, login, csrf_post
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("activity-review@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="In Progress")
    professional_id = factories.professional("activity-specialist@example.com")
    factories.profile(professional_id, verification_status="Verified")
    factories.application(project_id, professional_id, status="Assigned")

    login("activity-specialist@example.com", "professional")
    submitted = csrf_post(
        f"/professional/project/{project_id}/submit",
        data={
            "live_url": "https://example.com",
            "completion_notes": "First staging submission",
        },
    )
    assert submitted.status_code == 302

    login("activity-review@example.com", "customer")
    revision = csrf_post(
        f"/project/{project_id}/revision",
        data={"revision_comment": "Please adjust the mobile navigation."},
    )
    assert revision.status_code == 302

    approval = csrf_post(f"/project/{project_id}/approve", data={})
    assert approval.status_code == 302

    with app.app_context():
        entries = ActivityLog.query.filter_by(project_id=project_id).all()
        by_action = {entry.action: entry for entry in entries}
        assert by_action["DELIVERABLE_SUBMITTED"].user_id == professional_id
        assert by_action["DELIVERABLE_SUBMITTED"].category == "accent"
        assert "First staging submission" in by_action["DELIVERABLE_SUBMITTED"].description
        assert by_action["REVISION_REQUESTED"].user_id == customer_id
        assert "mobile navigation" in by_action["REVISION_REQUESTED"].description
        assert by_action["MILESTONE_APPROVED"].user_id == customer_id
        assert by_action["MILESTONE_APPROVED"].category == "success"

from app.models import Invoice


def _create_paid_project_invoice(factories, db):
    customer_id = factories.user("customer", "payout-client@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
    professional_id = factories.user("professional", "payout-specialist@example.com")
    factories.application(project_id, professional_id, status="Assigned")
    invoice = Invoice(
        invoice_number=f"INV-PAYOUT-{project_id}",
        project_id=project_id,
        customer_id=customer_id,
        gross_amount=100000,
        talent_payout=45000,
        agency_profit=55000,
        tax_amount=0,
        status="Paid",
    )
    db.session.add(invoice)
    db.session.commit()
    factories.payment(
        project_id,
        customer_id,
        razorpay_order_id=f"order-payout-{project_id}",
        amount=100000,
        status="Paid",
    )
    return invoice


def test_admin_can_release_paid_payout(
    client, csrf_post, db, factories, login
):
    invoice = _create_paid_project_invoice(factories, db)
    factories.user("admin", "payout-admin@example.com")
    login("payout-admin@example.com", "admin")

    ledger_response = client.get("/admin/transactions")
    assert ledger_response.status_code == 200
    assert b"Talent Payout (45%)" in ledger_response.data
    assert b"Release" in ledger_response.data

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/admin/invoice/{invoice.id}/release-payout",
        data={"utr_number": "UPI-REFERENCE-123"},
        follow_redirects=False,
    )

    db.session.refresh(invoice)
    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert invoice.payout_status == "Settled"
    assert invoice.payout_utr == "UPI-REFERENCE-123"
    assert invoice.payout_paid_at is not None


def test_unpaid_invoice_cannot_be_released(
    client, csrf_post, db, factories, login
):
    invoice = _create_paid_project_invoice(factories, db)
    invoice.status = "Created"
    db.session.commit()
    factories.user("admin", "payout-unpaid-admin@example.com")
    login("payout-unpaid-admin@example.com", "admin")

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/admin/invoice/{invoice.id}/release-payout",
        data={"utr_number": "UPI-REFERENCE-123"},
        follow_redirects=False,
    )

    db.session.refresh(invoice)
    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert invoice.payout_status == "Pending Approval"
    assert invoice.payout_utr is None
    assert invoice.payout_paid_at is None

--- FILE: .\tests\test_admin_template_encoding.py ---
"""Regression tests for admin template character encoding."""

from pathlib import Path


ADMIN_BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "templates" / "admin_base.html"


def test_admin_base_template_has_no_mojibake():
    text = ADMIN_BASE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    # The corrupted template previously contained UTF-8 bytes that had been
    # decoded as Windows-1252 and re-encoded as UTF-8.
    assert "\u00e2" not in text


def test_admin_base_template_contains_intended_icons():
    text = ADMIN_BASE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    intended = [
        "\u2022",  # bullet
        "\u25a6",  # squared square
        "\u2713",  # check mark
        "\u25a4",  # square with horizontal fill
        "\u2659",  # white chess pawn
        "\u25c9",  # fisheye
        "\u25c7",  # white diamond
        "\u2699",  # gear
        "\u2b05",  # leftwards black arrow
        "\u2630",  # trigram for heaven
        "\u21aa",  # rightwards arrow with hook
        "\u2191",  # upwards arrow
        "\u27a1",  # black rightwards arrow
        "\u2715",  # multiplication x
    ]

    for character in intended:
        assert character in text, f"Missing intended character: {character!r}"

import pytest

from app.models import AgencySetting, Business


VALID_SETTINGS = {
    "agency_name": "Northstar Studio",
    "primary_color": "#1a76c2",
    "logo_url": "https://assets.example.com/brand/logo.png",
    "whatsapp_support_number": "+14155550123",
}


def test_settings_are_admin_only_and_get_does_not_create_row(client, db, factories, login):
    customer_id = factories.customer("settings-client@example.com")
    response = client.get("/admin/settings")
    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert "/login" in response.headers["Location"]

    login("settings-client@example.com", "customer")
    response = client.get("/admin/settings")
    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert AgencySetting.query.count() == 0

    from app.models import User

    User.query.filter_by(id=customer_id).update({"role": "admin"})
    db.session.commit()
    # Login again so the session has the updated role.
    client.post("/logout", data={"csrf_token": _csrf_token(client)})
    login("settings-client@example.com", "admin")
    response = client.get("/admin/settings")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert b"AgencyOS" in response.data
    assert b"#6366f1" in response.data
    assert b'id="primary_color_picker"' in response.data
    assert b'id="primary_color_text"' in response.data
    assert b"colorText.addEventListener" in response.data
    assert AgencySetting.query.count() == 0


def test_settings_post_requires_csrf(client, factories, login):
    factories.admin("settings-csrf@example.com")
    login("settings-csrf@example.com", "admin")
    response = client.post("/admin/settings", data=VALID_SETTINGS)
    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert AgencySetting.query.count() == 0

    response = csrf_post("/admin/settings", data=VALID_SETTINGS)

    assert AgencySetting.query.count() == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("field", "value"),
    [
        ("agency_name", "   "),
        ("agency_name", "x" * 121),
        ("primary_color", "red"),
        ("primary_color", "#12345; background:url(javascript:alert(1))"),
        ("logo_url", "javascript:alert(1)"),
        ("logo_url", "ftp://example.com/logo.png"),
        ("logo_url", "https://user:pass@example.com/logo.png"),
        ("logo_url", "https:///logo.png"),
        ("whatsapp_support_number", "1234567"),
        ("whatsapp_support_number", "++14155550123"),
        ("whatsapp_support_number", "1234567890123456"),
    ],
)
def test_invalid_settings_are_rejected_without_partial_persistence(
    client, db, factories, login, csrf_post, field, value
):
    factories.admin(f"settings-invalid-{field}@example.com")

def test_settings_save_persist_and_update_singleton_row(
    client, db, factories, login, csrf_post
):
    factories.admin("settings-save@example.com")
    login("settings-save@example.com", "admin")

    first = csrf_post(
        "/admin/settings",
        data={**VALID_SETTINGS, "agency_name": "  Northstar Studio  "},
    )
    assert first.status_code == 302
    settings = AgencySetting.query.one()
    assert settings.id == 1
    assert settings.agency_name == "Northstar Studio"
    assert settings.primary_color == "#1a76c2"
    assert settings.logo_url == VALID_SETTINGS["logo_url"]
    assert settings.whatsapp_support_number == "+14155550123"
    row_id = settings.id

    updated = {
        **VALID_SETTINGS,
        "agency_name": "Northstar Digital",
        "logo_url": "",
    }
    second = csrf_post("/admin/settings", data=updated)
    assert second.status_code == 302

    client.get("/admin/settings")
    persisted = AgencySetting.query.one()
    assert persisted.id == row_id
    assert AgencySetting.query.count() == 1
    assert persisted.agency_name == "Northstar Digital"
    assert persisted.logo_url is None

def _csrf_token(client):
    with client.session_transaction() as session:
        return session.get("csrf_token", "")

from app.extensions import db
from app.models import get_ist_now


from app.models import User, ProfessionalProfile

def _register(client, name="Test User", email="new@example.com",
              password="Pass123!x", account_type="customer", **extra):
    data = {
        "name": name,
        "email": email,
        "password": password,
        "account_type": account_type,
    }
    data.update(extra)
    return client.post("/register", data=data, follow_redirects=False)


class TestRegistration:

        # Customer registration
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    def test_customer_registration_creates_user_and_profile(self, app, client):
        response = _register(client, email="cust-reg@example.com")
        assert response.status_code == 302

        with app.app_context():
            user = User.query.filter_by(
                email="cust-reg@example.com", role="customer"
            ).first()
            assert user is not None
            from werkzeug.security import check_password_hash
            assert check_password_hash(user.password, "Pass123!x")
            assert user.customer_profile is not None
            assert user.professional_profile is None

    def test_professional_registration_creates_pending_profile(self, app, client):
        response = _register(
            client,
            email="pro-reg@example.com",
            account_type="professional",
            expertise="SEO",
            experience="3 years",
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        with app.app_context():
            user = User.query.filter_by(
                email="pro-reg@example.com", role="professional"
            ).first()
            assert user is not None
            profile = ProfessionalProfile.query.filter_by(
                user_id=user.id
            ).first()
            assert profile is not None
            assert profile.verification_status == "Pending"

    def test_duplicate_email_same_role_rejected(self, app, client):
        with app.app_context():
            _register(client, email="dup@example.com")
            assert User.query.count() == 1

            _register(client, email="dup@example.com")
            assert User.query.count() == 1  # no second user created

    def test_same_email_other_role_allowed(self, app, client):
        # Same email as customer AND professional is allowed by design.
        _register(client, email="both@example.com", account_type="customer")
        _register(
            client, email="both@example.com", account_type="professional",
            expertise="SEO", experience="3 years",
        )
        with app.app_context():
            assert User.query.filter_by(email="both@example.com").count() == 2

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Professional registration
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    def test_professional_without_expertise_rejected(self, app, client):
        response = _register(
            client,
            email="pro-no-exp@example.com",
            account_type="professional",
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
class TestRateLimiting:

    def test_login_works_below_limit(self, app, client):
        _register(client, email="rate-login@example.com", password="Pass123!x")
        response = client.post(
            "/login",
            data={
                "email": "rate-login@example.com",
                "password": "Pass123!x",
                "login_role": "customer",
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

    def test_login_throttled_after_five_attempts(self, app, client):
        for _ in range(5):
            response = client.post(
                "/login",
                data={
                    "email": "nobody@example.com",
                    "password": "wrong-password",
                    "login_role": "customer",
                },
                follow_redirects=False,
            )
            assert response.status_code == 200

        response = client.post(
            "/login",
            data={
                "email": "nobody@example.com",
                "password": "wrong-password",
                "login_role": "customer",
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 429

    def test_registration_throttled_after_five_attempts(self, app, client):
        for i in range(5):
            response = _register(
                client, email=f"rate-register-{i}@example.com"
            )
            assert response.status_code == 302

        response = _register(
            client, email="rate-register-5@example.com"
        )
        assert response.status_code == 429

class TestSessionHardening:

        response = client.post(

        )

            assert "post_login_marker" not in session
class TestAccountRecovery:

    def test_forgot_password_generic_response(self, app, client, csrf_token):
        _register(client, email="recovery@example.com", password="Pass123!x")

        app.config["TEST_EMAILS"] = []

            follow_redirects=False,
        )

                message

            assert any(

            )

            assert len(app.config.get("TEST_EMAILS", [])) == 1

    def test_password_reset_flow_and_session_revocation(self, app, client, csrf_token):
        _register(client, email="reset-flow@example.com", password="OldPass123!x")
        app.config["TEST_EMAILS"] = []
        client.post(
            "/forgot-password",
            data={"email": "reset-flow@example.com", "csrf_token": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

        with app.app_context():
            from app.models import User
            import re

            user = User.query.filter_by(email="reset-flow@example.com").first()
            assert user is not None
            assert user.session_version == 0
            emails = app.config.get("TEST_EMAILS", [])
            assert len(emails) == 1
            token = re.search(
                r"/reset-password/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)",
                emails[-1]["body"],
            ).group(1)

        login_response = client.post(
            "/login",
            data={
                "email": "reset-flow@example.com",
                "password": "OldPass123!x",
                "login_role": "customer",
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert login_response.status_code == 302

        response = client.post(
            f"/reset-password/{token}",
            data={
                "password": "NewPass123!x",
                "confirm_password": "NewPass123!x",
                "csrf_token": csrf_token,
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        protected = client.get("/dashboard", follow_redirects=False)
        assert protected.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in protected.headers["Location"]

        relogin = client.post(
            "/login",
            data={
                "email": "reset-flow@example.com",
                "password": "NewPass123!x",
                "login_role": "customer",
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert relogin.status_code == 302

        with app.app_context():
            from app.models import User

            user = User.query.filter_by(email="reset-flow@example.com").first()
            assert user.session_version == 1

    def test_reset_rejects_invalid_and_expired_tokens(self, app, client):
        with app.app_context():
            from app.models import User, UserToken
            from datetime import timedelta
            import hashlib

            user = User(
                name="expired",
                email="expired-reset@example.com",
                password="hash",
                role="customer",
            )
            db.session.add(user)
            db.session.commit()

            raw_token = "expired-token"
            expired_token = UserToken(
                user_id=user.id,
                purpose="password_reset",
                token_hash=hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode()).hexdigest(),
                expires_at=get_ist_now() - timedelta(minutes=1),
            )
            db.session.add(expired_token)
            db.session.commit()

        response = client.get(
            f"/reset-password/{raw_token}", follow_redirects=False
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        wrong_purpose_token = "wrong-purpose-token"
        with app.app_context():
            from app.models import User, UserToken
            import hashlib

            user = User.query.filter_by(
                email="expired-reset@example.com"
            ).first()
            token = UserToken(
                user_id=user.id,
                purpose="email_verification",
                token_hash=hashlib.sha256(
                    wrong_purpose_token.encode()
                ).hexdigest(),
                expires_at=get_ist_now() + timedelta(hours=1),
            )
            db.session.add(token)
            db.session.commit()

        response = client.get(
            f"/reset-password/{wrong_purpose_token}",
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

    def test_reset_token_cannot_be_reused(self, app, client):
        _register(client, email="reset-reuse@example.com", password="OldPass123!x")

        with app.app_context():
            from app.models import User, UserToken
            import hashlib
            from datetime import timedelta

            user = User.query.filter_by(email="reset-reuse@example.com").first()
            raw_token = "reuse-token-value"
            token = UserToken(
                user_id=user.id,
                purpose="password_reset",
                token_hash=hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode()).hexdigest(),
                expires_at=get_ist_now() + timedelta(minutes=30),
            )
            db.session.add(token)
            db.session.commit()

        from itsdangerous import URLSafeTimedSerializer

        raw_csrf = "reuse-csrf-raw"
        signed_csrf = URLSafeTimedSerializer(
            app.config["SECRET_KEY"], salt="wtf-csrf-token"
        ).dumps(raw_csrf)

        with client.session_transaction() as session:
            session["csrf_token"] = raw_csrf
            session["session_version"] = 0

        first = client.post(
            f"/reset-password/{raw_token}",
            data={
                "password": "NewPass123!x",
                "confirm_password": "NewPass123!x",
                "csrf_token": signed_csrf,
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert first.status_code == 302

        with client.session_transaction() as session:
            session["session_version"] = 1

        reused = client.post(
            f"/reset-password/{raw_token}",
            data={
                "password": "AnotherPass123!x",
                "confirm_password": "AnotherPass123!x",
                "csrf_token": signed_csrf,
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert reused.status_code == 302

    def test_reset_rejects_weak_password(self, app, client, csrf_token):
        _register(client, email="weak-reset@example.com", password="OldPass123!x")
        app.config["TEST_EMAILS"] = []

        client.post(
            "/forgot-password",
            data={"email": "weak-reset@example.com", "csrf_token": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

            import re

            f"/reset-password/{token}",
            data={
                "password": "short",
                "confirm_password": "short",
                "csrf_token": csrf_token,
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/reset-password/" in response.headers["Location"]

"""Role-based access control tests.

Every protected page must be reachable only by the roles allowed to see it,
and every state-changing endpoint must reject callers without the right role
without mutating any data.
"""

import pytest

from app.models import (
    ProfessionalProfile,
    Project,
    Payment,
    ProfessionalProjectApplication,
)


ADMIN_PAGES = [
    "/admin/dashboard",
    "/admin/customers",
    "/admin/professionals",
    "/admin/applications",
    "/admin/project-management",
    "/admin/project-review",
]

PROFESSIONAL_PAGES = [
    "/professional/dashboard",
    "/professional/profile",
    "/professional/projects",
    "/professional/my-projects",
]

CUSTOMER_PAGES = [
    "/dashboard",
    "/customer/profile",
    "/businesses",
    "/business/add",
]

PROTECTED_PAGES = (
    CUSTOMER_PAGES
    + PROFESSIONAL_PAGES
    + ADMIN_PAGES
    + ["/payment/1", "/project/1"]
)


class TestAnonymousAccess:
    """Anonymous visitors are redirected to login for protected pages."""

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("path", PROTECTED_PAGES)
    def test_protected_pages_redirect_to_login(self, client, path):
        """Every protected page redirects anonymous visitors to /login."""

        response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in response.headers["Location"]

class TestProfessionalAccess:
    """Professionals reach their own pages but are blocked elsewhere."""

    def test_professional_reaches_own_pages(self, client, factories, login):
        """A logged-in professional can open their own pages.

        /professional/profile auto-creates the profile on first visit -- this
        is the regression guard for the old NOT NULL expertise/experience
        IntegrityError (the profile must be created, not 500). The freshly
        created profile is Pending, so the verification-gated
        /professional/projects page redirects to the dashboard.
        """

        professional_id = factories.user(
            "professional", "prof-own@example.com"
        )
        login("prof-own@example.com", "professional")

        # /professional/profile bootstraps the profile (auto-create path).
        response = client.get(
            "/professional/profile", follow_redirects=False
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200

        profile = (
            ProfessionalProfile.query
            .filter_by(user_id=professional_id)
            .first()
        )
        assert profile is not None
        assert profile.expertise == ""
        assert profile.experience == ""
        assert profile.verification_status == "Pending"

        # /professional/projects is gated on verification (Pending -> redirect)
        response = client.get(
            "/professional/projects", follow_redirects=False
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/professional/dashboard" in response.headers["Location"]

        # /professional/dashboard and /professional/my-projects are open to
        # every logged-in professional regardless of verification status.
        for path in ("/professional/dashboard", "/professional/my-projects"):
            response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
            assert response.status_code == 200, path

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ADMIN_PAGES)
    def test_professional_blocked_from_admin_pages(
        self, client, factories, login, path
    ):
        """Professionals cannot open admin pages."""
        factories.user("professional", "prof-admin@example.com")
        login("prof-admin@example.com", "professional")

        response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/admin" not in response.headers["Location"]

    def test_professional_blocked_from_customer_pages(
        self, client, factories, login
    ):
        """Professionals cannot open customer pages."""
        factories.user("professional", "prof-cust@example.com")
        login("prof-cust@example.com", "professional")

        for path in CUSTOMER_PAGES:
            response = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
            assert response.status_code == 302, path
            assert "/dashboard" in response.headers["Location"]

class TestStateChangeGuards:
    """State-changing endpoints reject the wrong role without side effects.

    Each POST carries a valid CSRF token (``csrf_post``) so the request
    reaches the view's own role / ownership guard -- that is what we are
    guarding -- rather than being turned away by CSRF with a generic 400.
    CSRF rejection itself is covered by ``tests/test_csrf.py``.
    """

    def test_anonymous_state_change_redirected(self, csrf_post):
        """Anonymous POSTs to protected actions redirect to login."""

        response = csrf_post(
            "/admin/project/1/approve",
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in response.headers["Location"]

    def test_non_admin_verify_professional_makes_no_change(
        self, csrf_post, factories, login
    ):
        """A non-admin cannot verify a professional."""

        professional_id = factories.user("professional", "verify-guard@example.com")
        profile_id = factories.profile(professional_id)

        factories.user("customer", "verify-actor@example.com")
        login("verify-actor@example.com", "customer")

        response = csrf_post(
            f"/admin/professionals/{profile_id}/verify",
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/admin" not in response.headers["Location"]

        profile = ProfessionalProfile.query.get(profile_id)
        assert profile.verification_status == "Pending"

    def test_non_professional_apply_creates_no_application(
        self, csrf_post, factories, login
    ):
        """A customer cannot apply to a project."""

        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "apply-actor@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)

        login("apply-actor@example.com", "customer")

        response = csrf_post(
            f"/professional/projects/{project_id}/apply",
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        assert (
            ProfessionalProjectApplication.query
            .filter_by(project_id=project_id)
            .count()
            == 0
        )

    def test_non_admin_assign_creates_no_assignment(
        self, csrf_post, factories, login
    ):
        """A non-admin cannot assign a professional to a project."""

        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "assign-owner@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        professional_id = factories.user("professional", "assign-prof@example.com")
        factories.profile(professional_id, verification_status="Verified")
        application_id = factories.application(project_id, professional_id)

        factories.user("customer", "assign-actor@example.com")
        login("assign-actor@example.com", "customer")

        response = csrf_post(
            f"/admin/applications/{application_id}/assign",
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/admin" not in response.headers["Location"]

        application = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.get(application_id)
        assert application.status == "Applied"
        assert Project.query.get(project_id).status == "Pending Assignment"

    def test_non_admin_approve_makes_no_change(
        self, csrf_post, factories, login
    ):
        """A non-admin cannot approve a submitted project."""

        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "approve-owner@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="Submitted")
        professional_id = factories.user("professional", "approve-prof@example.com")
        factories.profile(professional_id, verification_status="Verified")
        factories.delivery(project_id, professional_id)

        factories.user("customer", "approve-actor@example.com")
        login("approve-actor@example.com", "customer")

        response = csrf_post(
            f"/admin/project/{project_id}/approve",
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/admin" not in response.headers["Location"]

        assert Project.query.get(project_id).status == "Submitted"

    def test_customer_cannot_create_payment_order_for_other_customer(
        self, csrf_post, factories, login
    ):
        """A customer cannot create a payment order for someone else's project."""

        owner_id = factories.user("customer", "pay-owner@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(owner_id)

        factories.user("customer", "pay-actor@example.com")
        login("pay-actor@example.com", "customer")

        response = csrf_post(
            f"/payment/create-order/{project_id}",
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 404
        assert Payment.query.count() == 0
class TestAdminRateLimiting:

"""Focused regression tests for test-database URL validation."""

import pytest

from tests.conftest import (
    _configured_test_database_url,
    _postgresql_connection_identity,
    _validate_test_database_url,
)


def test_postgresql_connection_identity_normalizes_spellings_and_default_port():
    expected = ("localhost", 5432, "agencyos_test")

    assert _postgresql_connection_identity(
        "postgres://user:secret@localhost/agencyos_test"
    ) == expected
    assert _postgresql_connection_identity(
        "postgresql://user:secret@localhost:5432/agencyos_test"
    ) == expected
    assert _postgresql_connection_identity(
        "postgresql+psycopg://user:secret@localhost/agencyos_test"
    ) == expected
    assert _postgresql_connection_identity(
        "postgresql+psycopg2://user:secret@LOCALHOST:5432/agencyos_test"
    ) == ("localhost", 5432, "agencyos_test")


def test_postgresql_connection_identity_returns_none_for_non_postgresql_urls():
    assert _postgresql_connection_identity("sqlite:///tmp.db") is None
    assert _postgresql_connection_identity("mysql://user:secret@localhost/db_test") is None
    assert _postgresql_connection_identity("not-a-url") is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "raw_url",
    [
        "postgresql://user:secret@localhost:5432/agencyos_test",
        "postgresql+psycopg://user:secret@localhost/agencyos_test",
    ],
)
def test_validate_accepts_dedicated_postgresql_spellings(raw_url, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("DATABASE_URL", raising=False)

    result = _validate_test_database_url(raw_url)

    assert result.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://")
    assert result.endswith("/agencyos_test")


def test_validate_rejects_non_dedicated_database_name(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("DATABASE_URL", raising=False)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="dedicated test database"):
        _validate_test_database_url("postgresql://user:secret@localhost/agencyos")


def test_validate_rejects_unsupported_driver(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("DATABASE_URL", raising=False)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="approved PostgreSQL driver"):
        _validate_test_database_url("mysql://user:secret@localhost/agencyos_test")


def test_validate_rejects_application_database_with_equivalent_spellings(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv(
        "DATABASE_URL",
        "postgres://user:secret@db.example.com:5432/shared_test",
    )

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must not target the application database"):
        _validate_test_database_url(
            "postgresql://user:secret@DB.example.com/shared_test"
        )


def test_validate_allows_dedicated_test_database_when_application_differs(monkeypatch):

    result = _validate_test_database_url(

    )

    assert result.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://")
    assert result.endswith("/agencyos_test")

--- FILE: .\tests\test_csrf.py ---
"""CSRF protection tests: token validation for state-changing logout flow."""

import pytest


class TestLogoutRoute:
    """Test the CSRF-protected logout flow."""

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # GET /logout – anonymous → redirect to login
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_logout_get_requires_login(self, client):
        """Anonymous GET /logout must redirect to the login page."""
        response = client.get("/logout", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in response.headers["Location"]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # GET /logout – authenticated → renders confirmation form
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_logout_get_confirmation_form(self, client, factories, login):
        """Authenticated GET /logout renders the confirmation form."""
        factories.user("customer", "confirm@example.com")
        login("confirm@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.get("/logout", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert b"Confirm Logout" in response.data

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # POST /logout – anonymous → rejected by CSRF middleware (400)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # POST /logout – authenticated with NO csrf_token → 400
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_post_logout_without_csrf_token_rejected(self, client, factories, login):
        """POST /logout without a CSRF token is rejected (400)."""
        factories.user("customer", "no-token@example.com")
        login("no-token@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.post(
            "/logout",
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        # Flask-WTF CSRFProtect returns 400 for a failed token check.
        assert response.status_code == 400

        # Session must still be alive (logout did NOT happen).
        after = client.get("/dashboard", follow_redirects=False)
        assert after.status_code == 200

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # POST /logout – authenticated with a VALID form-embedded token → 302
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_post_logout_with_valid_token_clears_session(self, client, factories, login):
        """Authenticated POST /logout with a real CSRF token clears the session.

        This test mimics the real browser flow: the confirmation page
        (GET /logout) embeds a fresh csrf_token(), and the form submits it.
        """
        # Create user + log in (session cookie set).
        factories.user("customer", "good-token@example.com")
        login("good-token@example.com", "customer")

        # First GET to obtain a valid csrf_token from the confirmation page.
        page = client.get("/logout", follow_redirects=False)
        assert page.status_code == 200

        # Extract the csrf_token value from the rendered form (Flask-WTF
        # HTMLInput with name="csrf_token" and value=<token>).
        token = None
        for line in page.data.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
            if 'name="csrf_token"' in line:
                # e.g. <input type="hidden" name="csrf_token" value="...">
                start = line.find('value="') + len('value="')
                end = line.find('"', start)
                token = line[start:end]
                break

        assert token, "Could not extract csrf_token from confirmation page"

        # POST the real form with the extracted token.
        response = client.post(
            "/logout",
            data={"csrf_token": token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        # Valid token → logout completes → redirect to index.
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/logout" not in response.headers["Location"]
        # Flask-Login redirects to index after logout_user().
        assert response.headers.get("Location", "").endswith("/") or (
            response.headers.get("Location") == "/"
        )

        # Session is cleared; /dashboard now redirects to /login.
        after = client.get("/dashboard", follow_redirects=False)
        assert after.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in after.headers["Location"]
# =========================================================
# ADDITIONAL LOGOUT FLOW TESTS (matching target node IDs)
# =========================================================

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Anonymous POST /logout → redirect to login (no session, no CSRF)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_anonymous_post_logout_rejected_by_csrf(self, client):
        """Anonymous POST /logout is rejected by the CSRF middleware (400).

        This test documents the correct behavior: anonymous POST /logout
        is rejected by CSRF middleware returning 400. This was previously
        tested by test_anonymous_post_logout_redirects_to_login which
        expected 302, but the correct security behavior is 400 rejection.
        """
        response = client.post("/logout", data={}, follow_redirects=False)
        # CSRF middleware returns 400 for missing token.
        assert response.status_code == 400

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Authenticated GET /logout → renders confirmation page (200)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_get_logout_renders_confirmation_when_logged_in(self, client, factories, login):
        """Authenticated GET /logout renders the confirmation form."""
        factories.user("customer", "confirm@example.com")
        login("confirm@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.get("/logout", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert b"Confirm Logout" in response.data

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # POST /logout with valid token → success (302 redirect)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_post_logout_with_valid_token_success(self, client, factories, login):
        """Authenticated POST /logout with a valid CSRF token succeeds."""
        factories.user("customer", "success@example.com")
        login("success@example.com", "customer")

        # First GET to obtain a valid CSRF token from the confirmation page
        page = client.get("/logout", follow_redirects=False)
        assert page.status_code == 200

        # Extract the CSRF token from the rendered form
        token = None
        for line in page.data.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
            if 'name="csrf_token"' in line:
                start = line.find('value="') + len('value="')
                end = line.find('"', start)
                token = line[start:end]
                break

        assert token, "Could not extract csrf_token from confirmation page"

        # POST the real form with the extracted token
        response = client.post(
            "/logout",
            data={"csrf_token": token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        # Valid token → logout completes → redirect to index
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/logout" not in response.headers["Location"]

        # Dashboard now redirects to login (session cleared)
        after = client.get("/dashboard", follow_redirects=False)
        assert after.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in after.headers["Location"]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # POST /logout without token → rejected when logged in (400)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_post_logout_without_token_rejected_when_logged_in(self, client, factories, login):
        """Authenticated POST /logout without a CSRF token is rejected."""
        factories.user("customer", "no-token2@example.com")
        login("no-token2@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.post("/logout", data={}, follow_redirects=False)
        # CSRF middleware rejects missing token (400)
        assert response.status_code == 400

        # Session must still be alive (logout did NOT happen)
        after = client.get("/dashboard", follow_redirects=False)
        assert after.status_code == 200

from decimal import Decimal
import json
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest

from app.models import Invoice, Payment, Project
from app.utils.currency import (
    INTERNATIONAL_PACKAGE_PRICES,
    format_currency,
    get_package_price,
    to_minor_units,
)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("currency", "package", "expected"),
    [
        ("USD", "Basic Website", 699),
        ("USD", "Advanced Website", 2499),
        ("EUR", "SEO Growth", 850),
        ("GBP", "Business Website", 999),
    ],
)
def test_international_package_prices(currency, package, expected):
    assert get_package_price(package, currency, {}) == Decimal(expected)
    assert package in INTERNATIONAL_PACKAGE_PRICES[currency]


def test_currency_helpers_validate_minor_units_and_formatting():
    assert to_minor_units(Decimal("349.50")) == 34950
    assert format_currency(Decimal("2499"), "USD") == "$2,499.00"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        to_minor_units(Decimal("1.001"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        get_package_price("Basic Website", "CAD", {})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        get_package_price("Starter Retainer", "USD", {})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        format_currency(100, "CAD")


def test_project_checkout_uses_saved_foreign_currency(

):

def test_foreign_payment_verification_checks_and_records_currency(

):
