from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

from app.models import (
    Milestone,
    ProfessionalProfile,
    Project,
    ProjectDelivery,
    ProfessionalProjectApplication,
    Review,
)


def _create_assigned_project(db, factories, customer_id, professional_id, status):
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status=status)
    factories.application(project_id, professional_id, status="Assigned")
    return project_id


def test_admin_roster_shows_evidence_based_metrics_and_badges(
    app, client, db, factories, login
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("meritocracy-client@example.com")
    professional_id = factories.professional("meritocracy-pro@example.com")
    profile_id = factories.profile(
        professional_id,
        verification_status="Verified",
    )
    project_id = _create_assigned_project(
        db, factories, customer_id, professional_id, "Completed"
    )
    submitted_at = datetime.now()
    db.session.add_all(
        (
            ProjectDelivery(
                project_id=project_id,
                professional_id=professional_id,
                submission_number=1,
                completion_notes="Delivered early",
                status="Approved",
                submitted_at=submitted_at,
                reviewed_at=submitted_at,
            ),
            Milestone(
                project_id=project_id,
                title="Final delivery deadline",
                amount=1000,
                due_date=submitted_at + timedelta(days=1),
            ),
            Review(
                project_id=project_id,
                customer_id=customer_id,
                rating=5,
                feedback="Excellent work",
            ),
        )
    )
    db.session.commit()

    profile = db.session.get(ProfessionalProfile, profile_id)
    metrics = profile.get_performance_metrics()
    badge_names = {badge["name"] for badge in profile.get_badges(metrics)}
    assert metrics == {
        "completed_sprints": 1,
        "active_sprints": 0,
        "completion_rate": 100,
        "on_time_rate": 100,
        "average_rating": 5,
        "revision_count": 0,
        "early_sprints": 1,
    }
    assert {
        "Top Rated 🌟",
        "Speed Demon ⚡",
        "Reliable 🎯",
        "Verified Pro 🛡️",
    } == badge_names

    admin_id = factories.admin("meritocracy-admin@example.com")
    login("meritocracy-admin@example.com", "admin")
    response = client.get("/admin/professionals")
    rendered = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", response.data.decode("utf-8"))

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert "Top Rated" in rendered
    assert "Speed Demon" in rendered
    assert "Reliable" in rendered
    assert "1 completed" in rendered
    assert "On-time: 100%" in rendered
    assert "Rating: 5.0/5" in rendered
    assert "Completion: 100%" in rendered


def test_missing_deadlines_and_reviews_are_not_invented_and_revision_blocks_top_rated(
    db, factories
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("meritocracy-no-data@example.com")
    professional_id = factories.professional("meritocracy-no-data-pro@example.com")
    profile_id = factories.profile(

        verification_status="Verified",
    )

        db, factories, customer_id, professional_id, "Completed"
    )

    )
    db.session.add_all(
        (

    assert metrics["revision_count"] == 1
    assert "Top Rated 🌟" not in badge_names
    assert "Speed Demon ⚡" not in badge_names
    assert "Reliable 🎯" not in badge_names

"""Client notification center API and rendering coverage."""

from app.extensions import db
from app.models import Notification


def _notification(user_id, **kwargs):
    values = {
        "title": "Milestone update",
        "message": "A new project milestone is ready to review.",
        "link": "/project/123",
    }
    values.update(kwargs)
    notification = Notification(user_id=user_id, **values)
    db.session.add(notification)
    db.session.commit()
    return notification.id


def test_notification_feed_reports_unread_count_and_safe_links(
    app, client, login, factories
):
    user_id = factories.customer("notification-feed@example.com")
    login("notification-feed@example.com", "customer")
    for index in range(11):
        _notification(user_id, title=f"Update {index}")
    _notification(user_id, is_read=True, link="https://attacker.example/")

    response = client.get("/api/notifications")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    payload = response.get_json()
    assert payload["unread_count"] == 11
    assert payload["count"] == 11
    assert len(payload["notifications"]) == 10
    assert all(item["link"].startswith("/") for item in payload["notifications"])
    assert all("attacker.example" not in item["link"] for item in payload["notifications"])


def test_mark_read_is_owner_scoped_and_missing_ids_are_explicit(
    app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
):
    owner_id = factories.customer("notification-owner@example.com")
    other_id = factories.customer("notification-other@example.com")
    owned_notification_id = _notification(owner_id)
    other_notification_id = _notification(other_id)
    login("notification-owner@example.com", "customer")

    forbidden = csrf_post(f"/api/notifications/{other_notification_id}/read")
    missing = csrf_post("/api/notifications/999999/read")
    marked = csrf_post(f"/api/notifications/{owned_notification_id}/read")

    assert forbidden.status_code == 404
    assert forbidden.get_json() == {
        "success": False,
        "error": "Notification not found.",
    }
    assert missing.status_code == 404
    assert marked.status_code == 200
    with app.app_context():
        assert db.session.get(Notification, owned_notification_id).is_read is True
        assert db.session.get(Notification, other_notification_id).is_read is False


def test_clear_all_marks_only_current_users_notifications_read(
    app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
):
    owner_id = factories.customer("notification-clear@example.com")
    other_id = factories.customer("notification-clear-other@example.com")
    first_id = _notification(owner_id)
    second_id = _notification(owner_id)
    already_read_id = _notification(owner_id, is_read=True)
    other_id_value = _notification(other_id)
    login("notification-clear@example.com", "customer")

    response = client.post(
        "/api/notifications/clear-all",
        headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.get_json() == {"success": True, "updated_count": 2, "count": 0}
    with app.app_context():
        assert db.session.get(Notification, first_id).is_read is True
        assert db.session.get(Notification, second_id).is_read is True
        assert db.session.get(Notification, already_read_id) is not None
        assert db.session.get(Notification, other_id_value).is_read is False
        assert Notification.query.filter_by(user_id=owner_id).count() == 3

"""Payment tests: order creation and payment verification.

Razorpay client calls are mocked; no real payments are made.
"""
import json
import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

import razorpay

from app.models import Project, Payment


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _make_razorpay_order(order_id="order_test_123", amount=499900,
                         currency="INR", status="created"):
    return {
        "id": order_id,
        "amount": amount,
        "currency": currency,
        "status": status,
        "receipt": "agencyos_project_1",
    }


def _make_razorpay_payment(payment_id="pay_test_456", order_id="order_test_123",
                           amount=499900, currency="INR", status="captured"):
    return {
        "id": payment_id,
        "order_id": order_id,
        "amount": amount,
        "currency": currency,
        "status": status,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TestCreateOrder
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestCreateOrder:
    """Test payment order creation."""

    def test_anonymous_redirected(self, app, client, csrf_token):
        """Anonymous users must be redirected to login for order creation."""
        response = client.post(
            "/payment/create-order/1", data={"csrf_token": csrf_token}, follow_redirects=False
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in response.headers["Location"]

    def test_non_customer_forbidden(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        """A professional cannot create a payment order (403)."""
        factories.user("professional", "pro@example.com")
        login("pro@example.com", "professional")

        response = client.post(
            "/payment/create-order/1", data={"csrf_token": csrf_token}, follow_redirects=False
        )
        assert response.status_code == 403

    def test_foreign_project_not_found(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        """A customer cannot create an order for another customer's project (404)."""
        owner_id = factories.user("customer", "owner@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(owner_id)

        factories.user("customer", "actor@example.com")
        login("actor@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.post(
            f"/payment/create-order/{project_id}",
            data={"csrf_token": csrf_token}, follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 404
        with app.app_context():
            assert Payment.query.count() == 0

    def test_already_paid_project_rejected(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        """A project that already has a Paid payment cannot create a new order."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "paid@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        factories.payment(project_id, customer_id, status="Paid")
        login("paid@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.post(
            f"/payment/create-order/{project_id}",
            data={"csrf_token": csrf_token}, follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 400
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is False

    def test_non_payable_assigned_project_rejected(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        """A project already assigned is not payable."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "assigned@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="Assigned")
        login("assigned@example.com", "customer")

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.create",
        ) as mock_create:
            response = client.post(

        assert data["message"] == "Project is not in a payable state."

    def test_success_creates_created_payment_row(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        """Successful order creation creates a Payment row with status 'Created'."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "success@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        login("success@example.com", "customer")

        fake_order = _make_razorpay_order()

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.create",
            return_value=fake_order,
        ):
            response = client.post(
                f"/payment/create-order/{project_id}",
                data={"csrf_token": csrf_token}, follow_redirects=False,

class TestVerifyPayment:
    """Test payment verification."""

    def test_anonymous_redirected(self, app, client, csrf_token):
        """Anonymous users must be redirected to login for verification."""
        response = client.post(
            "/payment/verify",
            data=json.dumps({}),
            content_type="application/json",
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in response.headers["Location"]

    def test_non_customer_forbidden(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        """A professional cannot verify a payment (403)."""
        factories.user("professional", "pro2@example.com")
        login("pro2@example.com", "professional")

        response = client.post(
            "/payment/verify",
            data=json.dumps({
                "razorpay_order_id": "order_x",
                "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_x",
                "razorpay_signature": "sig_x",
            }),
            content_type="application/json",
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 403

    def test_missing_fields_rejected(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        """Missing verification fields return 400."""
        factories.user("customer", "missing@example.com")

            content_type="application/json",
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 400
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is False

        factories.payment(project_id, owner_id, razorpay_order_id="order_other")

        factories.user("customer", "actor2@example.com")
        login("actor2@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.post(
            "/payment/verify",
            data=json.dumps({
                "razorpay_order_id": "order_other",
                "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_other",
                "razorpay_signature": "sig_other",
            }),
            content_type="application/json",
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 404

    def test_invalid_signature_rejected_payment_stays_created(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        """Invalid Razorpay signature rejects verification; payment stays 'Created'."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "sigfail@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        factories.payment(project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id="order_sig")
        login("sigfail@example.com", "customer")

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility."
            "verify_payment_signature",
            side_effect=razorpay.errors.SignatureVerificationError("bad signature"),
        ):
            response = client.post(
                "/payment/verify",
                data=json.dumps({
                    "razorpay_order_id": "order_sig",
                    "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_sig",
                    "razorpay_signature": "bad_sig",
                }),
                content_type="application/json",
                headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )

        assert response.status_code == 400
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is False

        with app.app_context():
            payment = Payment.query.filter_by(razorpay_order_id="order_sig").first()
            assert payment.status == "Created"

    def test_full_success_marks_paid_and_project_in_progress(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        """Successful verification marks payment 'Paid' and project 'In Progress'."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "fullsuccess@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        factories.payment(project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id="order_full")
        login("fullsuccess@example.com", "customer")

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility."
            "verify_payment_signature",
            return_value=True,
        ), patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.fetch",
            return_value=_make_razorpay_order(order_id="order_full", amount=499900),
        ), patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.payment.fetch",
            return_value=_make_razorpay_payment(order_id="order_full", amount=499900, status="captured"),
        ):
            response = client.post(
                "/payment/verify",
                data=json.dumps({
                    "razorpay_order_id": "order_full",
                    "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_full",
                    "razorpay_signature": "sig_full",
                }),
                content_type="application/json",
                headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )

        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is True

        with app.app_context():
            from app.models import ActivityLog

            payment = Payment.query.filter_by(razorpay_order_id="order_full").first()
            assert payment.status == "Paid"
            assert payment.razorpay_payment_id == "pay_full"
            project = Project.query.get(project_id)
            assert project.status == "In Progress"
            audit_entry = ActivityLog.query.filter_by(
                project_id=project_id,
                action="PAYMENT_RECEIVED",
            ).one()
            assert audit_entry.user_id == customer_id
            assert audit_entry.category == "success"
            assert "₹4,999.00" in audit_entry.description

    def test_repeated_verification_is_idempotent(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        """Repeated verification of an already-paid payment returns success
        without re-calling Razorpay or mutating state."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "idem@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        factories.payment(project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id="order_idem", status="Paid")
        login("idem@example.com", "customer")

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility."
            "verify_payment_signature",
        ) as mock_sig, patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.fetch",
        ) as mock_order_fetch:
            response = client.post(
                "/payment/verify",
                data=json.dumps({
                    "razorpay_order_id": "order_idem",
                    "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_idem",
                    "razorpay_signature": "sig_idem",
                }),
                content_type="application/json",
                headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )

        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is True
        mock_sig.assert_not_called()
        mock_order_fetch.assert_not_called()

        with app.app_context():
            payment = Payment.query.filter_by(razorpay_order_id="order_idem").first()
            assert payment.status == "Paid"

    def test_service_unavailable_returns_503(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token, monkeypatch):

    def test_duplicate_razorpay_payment_id_rejected(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        """The same Razorpay payment ID cannot be used for two local payments."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "duppay@example.com")
        project_id_1 = factories.project(customer_id)
        project_id_2 = factories.project(customer_id)
        factories.payment(project_id_1, customer_id, razorpay_order_id="order_dup_first", status="Created", amount=4999)
        factories.payment(project_id_2, customer_id, razorpay_order_id="order_dup_second", status="Created", amount=4999)
        login("duppay@example.com", "customer")

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility.verify_payment_signature",
            return_value=True,
        ), patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.fetch",
            return_value=_make_razorpay_order(order_id="order_dup_first", amount=499900),
        ), patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.payment.fetch",
            return_value=_make_razorpay_payment(
                payment_id="pay_dup_shared", order_id="order_dup_first", amount=499900, status="captured"
            ),
        ):
            first = client.post(
                "/payment/verify",
                data=json.dumps({
                    "razorpay_order_id": "order_dup_first",
                    "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_dup_shared",
                    "razorpay_signature": "sig_dup",
                }),
                content_type="application/json",
                headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )
        assert first.status_code == 200

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility.verify_payment_signature",
            return_value=True,
        ), patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.fetch",
            return_value=_make_razorpay_order(order_id="order_dup_second", amount=499900),
        ), patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.payment.fetch",
            return_value=_make_razorpay_payment(
                payment_id="pay_dup_shared", order_id="order_dup_second", amount=499900, status="captured"
            ),
        ):
            second = client.post(
                "/payment/verify",
                data=json.dumps({
                    "razorpay_order_id": "order_dup_second",
                    "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_dup_shared",
                    "razorpay_signature": "sig_dup",
                }),
                content_type="application/json",
                headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )
        assert second.status_code == 400
        data = json.loads(second.data)
        assert data["success"] is False

    def test_duplicate_razorpay_order_id_database_rejection(
        self, app, db, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        """Database rejects insertion of duplicate razorpay_order_id."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "orderdup@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        # Create first payment with unique order ID
        factories.payment(
            project_id, customer_id,
            razorpay_order_id="order_unique_1",
            status="Created", amount=4999
        )

        with app.app_context():
            # Attempt to insert a second payment with same order_id
            # This should fail at database level due to unique constraint
            from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
            dup = Payment(
                project_id=project_id,
                customer_id=customer_id,
                razorpay_order_id="order_unique_1",
                amount=4999,
                currency="INR",
                status="Created"
            )
            db.session.add(dup)
            with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
                db.session.commit()

    def test_duplicate_razorpay_payment_id_database_rejection(
        self, app, db, factories
    ):
        """Database rejects insertion of duplicate non-NULL razorpay_payment_id."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "payiddb@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        factories.payment(
            project_id, customer_id,
            razorpay_order_id="order_payid_first",
            razorpay_payment_id="pay_shared",
            status="Created", amount=4999,
        )

class TestDatabaseUniquenessAndRecovery:
    """Deterministic database-level uniqueness conflict and recovery tests."""

    def test_rollback_and_session_recovery_after_failed_write(self, app, db, factories):
        """A failed write can be rolled back and the session remains usable."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "rollback@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        factories.payment(
            project_id, customer_id,
            razorpay_order_id="order_rollback",
            status="Created", amount=4999,
        )

        with app.app_context():
            from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

            dup = Payment(
                project_id=project_id,
                customer_id=customer_id,
                razorpay_order_id="order_rollback",
                amount=4999,
                currency="INR",
                status="Created",
            )
            db.session.add(dup)
            with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
                db.session.commit()

            db.session.rollback()

            # Session is recovered and queries work.
            assert Payment.query.count() >= 1

    def test_verification_uniqueness_conflict_returns_safe_message(
        self, app, client, db, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        """Verification hitting a duplicate payment ID returns a safe 400."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "verifyconflict@example.com")
        project_id_1 = factories.project(customer_id)
        project_id_2 = factories.project(customer_id)
        factories.payment(
            project_id_1, customer_id,
            razorpay_order_id="order_conflict_first",
            status="Created", amount=4999,
        )
        factories.payment(
            project_id_2, customer_id,
            razorpay_order_id="order_conflict_second",
            status="Created", amount=4999,
        )
        # Pre-assign the shared payment id to the second row so the
        # application-level duplicate check triggers during verification.
        with app.app_context():
            second = Payment.query.filter_by(
                razorpay_order_id="order_conflict_second"
            ).first()
            second.razorpay_payment_id = "pay_conflict_shared"
            db.session.commit()

        login("verifyconflict@example.com", "customer")

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility.verify_payment_signature",
            return_value=True,
        ), patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.fetch",
            return_value=_make_razorpay_order(order_id="order_conflict_first", amount=499900),
        ), patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.payment.fetch",
            return_value=_make_razorpay_payment(
                payment_id="pay_conflict_shared",
                order_id="order_conflict_first",
                amount=499900,
                status="captured",
            ),
        ):
            response = client.post(
                "/payment/verify",
                data=_json.dumps({
                    "razorpay_order_id": "order_conflict_first",
                    "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_conflict_shared",
                    "razorpay_signature": "sig_conflict",
                }),
                content_type="application/json",
                headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )

        assert response.status_code == 400
        data = _json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is False

    def test_simulated_race_order_creation_recovers(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token, monkeypatch):
        """Simulated race: IntegrityError during insert is handled gracefully."""
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "racesim@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        login("racesim@example.com", "customer")

        fake_order = _make_razorpay_order(order_id="order_racesim")

        from app.extensions import db as _db
        original_commit = _db.session.commit
        state = {"raised": False}

        def flaky_commit():
            if not state["raised"]:
                state["raised"] = True
                from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

                raise IntegrityError("race", None, None)
            return original_commit()

        monkeypatch.setattr(_db.session, "commit", flaky_commit)

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.create",
            return_value=fake_order,
        ):
            response = client.post(
                f"/payment/create-order/{project_id}",
                data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )

        # Either recovery success or safe failure is acceptable; must not 500.
        assert response.status_code in (200, 400)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Genuine multi-connection concurrency tests (SQLite file-backed)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
import os
import tempfile
import threading
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

from app import create_app
from app.extensions import db as _db
from app.models import User, Project, Payment
from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash


class TestGenuineConcurrency:
    """Genuine multi-connection SQLite concurrency tests.

    These tests use a temporary file-backed SQLite database and a separate
    application/session context per thread. They do not touch the application
    database or any repository scratch files.
    """

    def _make_file_app(self):
        fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".sqlite")
        os.close(fd)
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.remove(path)
        app = create_app(
            "default",
            {
                "TESTING": True,
                "SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI": "sqlite:///"
                + path.replace(os.sep, "/"),
                "WTF_CSRF_ENABLED": True,
                "SECRET_KEY": "concurrency-test-secret-0123456789abcdef",
                "SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS": False,
                "SQLALCHEMY_ENGINE_OPTIONS": {
                    "connect_args": {"timeout": 30}
                },
            },
        )
        with app.app_context():
            _db.create_all()
        return app, path

    def _cleanup(self, app, path):
        try:
            with app.app_context():
                _db.session.remove()
                _db.drop_all()
                _db.engine.dispose()
        except Exception:
            pass
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm", "-journal"):
            try:
                os.remove(path + suffix)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass

    def test_concurrent_duplicate_created_payment_one_succeeds(self):
        """Two connections inserting the same open-payment key: one wins."""
        app, path = self._make_file_app()
        try:
            with app.app_context():
                user = User(
                    name="Concurrency Customer",
                    email="concurrency@example.com",
                    password=generate_password_hash("Password123"),
                    role="customer",
                )
                _db.session.add(user)
                _db.session.commit()
                project = Project(
                    customer_id=user.id,
                    service="Website",
                    package="Basic",
                    requirements="Concurrency test",
                    status="Payment Pending",
                )
                _db.session.add(project)
                _db.session.commit()
                user_id = user.id
                project_id = project.id

            results = []
            barrier = threading.Barrier(2, timeout=10)

            def worker(order_id):
                try:
                    barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                except threading.BrokenBarrierError:
                    results.append("barrier_error")
                    return
                try:
                    with app.app_context():
                        payment = Payment(
                            project_id=project_id,
                            customer_id=user_id,
                            razorpay_order_id=order_id,
                            amount=4999,
                            currency="INR",
                            status="Created",
                        )
                        _db.session.add(payment)
                        _db.session.commit()
                        _db.session.remove()
                        results.append("ok")
                except IntegrityError:
                    try:
                        _db.session.rollback()
                        _db.session.remove()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    results.append("conflict")
                except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - diagnostic only
                    try:
                        _db.session.rollback()
                        _db.session.remove()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    results.append(f"error:{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}")

            threads = [
                threading.Thread(
                    target=worker, args=("order_concurrent_first",), daemon=True
                ),
                threading.Thread(
                    target=worker, args=("order_concurrent_second",), daemon=True
                ),
            ]
            for thread in threads:
                thread.start()
            for thread in threads:
                thread.join(timeout=30)

            assert all(not thread.is_alive() for thread in threads)
            assert not any(result.startswith("error:") for result in results)
            assert sorted(results) == ["conflict", "ok"]

            with app.app_context():
                count = Payment.query.filter_by(
                    project_id=project_id,
                    customer_id=user_id,
                    status="Created",
                ).count()
                assert count == 1
                _db.session.remove()
        finally:
            self._cleanup(app, path)

    def test_concurrent_claim_same_payment_one_wins(self):
        """Two connections claiming the same Created payment: one update wins."""
        app, path = self._make_file_app()
        try:
            with app.app_context():
                user = User(
                    name="Claim Customer",
                    email="claim@example.com",
                    password=generate_password_hash("Password123"),
                    role="customer",
                )
                _db.session.add(user)
                _db.session.commit()
                project = Project(
                    customer_id=user.id,
                    service="Website",
                    package="Basic",
                    requirements="Claim test",
                    status="Payment Pending",
                )
                _db.session.add(project)
                _db.session.commit()
                payment = Payment(
                    project_id=project.id,
                    customer_id=user.id,
                    razorpay_order_id="order_claim_concurrent",
                    amount=4999,
                    currency="INR",
                    status="Created",
                )
                _db.session.add(payment)
                _db.session.commit()
                payment_id = payment.id

            results = []
            barrier = threading.Barrier(2, timeout=10)

            def worker():
                try:
                    barrier.wait(timeout=10)
                except threading.BrokenBarrierError:
                    results.append("barrier_error")
                    return
                try:
                    with app.app_context():
                        updated = Payment.query.filter_by(
                            id=payment_id, status="Created"
                        ).update(
                            {
                                "status": "Paid",
                                "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_claim_shared",
                                "paid_at": datetime.utcnow(),
                            },
                            synchronize_session=False,
                        )
                        _db.session.commit()
                        _db.session.remove()
                        results.append(updated)
                except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - diagnostic only
                    try:
                        _db.session.rollback()
                        _db.session.remove()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    results.append(f"error:{type(exc).__name__}:{exc}")

            threads = [
                threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True)
                for _ in range(2)
            ]
            for thread in threads:
                thread.start()
            for thread in threads:
                thread.join(timeout=30)

            assert all(not thread.is_alive() for thread in threads)
            assert not any(
                isinstance(result, str) and result.startswith("error:")
                for result in results
            )
            assert sorted(results) == [0, 1]

            with app.app_context():
                final_payment = Payment.query.get(payment_id)
                assert final_payment is not None
                assert final_payment.status == "Paid"
                assert final_payment.razorpay_payment_id == "pay_claim_shared"
                _db.session.remove()
        finally:
            self._cleanup(app, path)
class TestRateLimitingPayments:

    def test_payment_order_creation_throttled(self, app, client, csrf_token):
        for _ in range(10):
            response = client.post(
                "/payment/create-order/1",
                data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )
            assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 400, 403, 404)

        response = client.post(
            "/payment/create-order/1",
            data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 429

    def test_payment_verification_throttled(self, app, client, csrf_token):
        for _ in range(20):
            response = client.post(
                "/payment/verify",
                data=json.dumps({
                    "razorpay_order_id": "order_rate",
                    "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_rate",
                    "razorpay_signature": "sig_rate",
                }),
                content_type="application/json",
                headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )
            assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 400, 403, 404)

        response = client.post(
            "/payment/verify",
            data=json.dumps({
                "razorpay_order_id": "order_rate",
                "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_rate",
                "razorpay_signature": "sig_rate",
            }),
            content_type="application/json",
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 429

    def test_create_order_recovers_matching_payment_after_integrity_error(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token, monkeypatch
    ):
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "recover-race@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)

        state = {"raised": False}

        def flaky_commit():
            if not state["raised"]:
                state["raised"] = True
                from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

                raise IntegrityError("simulated race", None, None)
            return original_commit()

        monkeypatch.setattr(_db.session, "commit", flaky_commit)

    def test_create_order_logs_orphan_after_persistence_failure(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token, monkeypatch, caplog
    ):
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "orphan-log@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        login("orphan-log@example.com", "customer")

        fake_order = _make_razorpay_order(order_id="order_orphan_log")

        from app.extensions import db as _db
        from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

        monkeypatch.setattr(
            _db.session,
            "commit",
            lambda: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
                IntegrityError("forced failure", None, None)
            ),
        )

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.create",
            return_value=fake_order,
        ), caplog.at_level("ERROR"):
            response = client.post(
                f"/payment/create-order/{project_id}",
                data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )

        assert response.status_code == 400
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is False
        assert data["message"] == "Unable to create payment order."

        assert "Razorpay order could not be reconciled" in caplog.text
        orphan_record = next(
            record for record in caplog.records
            if "Razorpay order could not be reconciled" in record.getMessage()
        )
        assert getattr(orphan_record, "razorpay_order_id", None) == "order_orphan_log"
        assert getattr(orphan_record, "project_id", None) == project_id

        with app.app_context():
            assert Payment.query.filter_by(
                razorpay_order_id="order_orphan_log"
            ).count() == 0

'''PostgreSQL-specific payment tests.

These tests are opt-in. They run only when TEST_DATABASE_URL points to a
dedicated PostgreSQL test database and psycopg is installed.
'''

import os
import threading

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import inspect, text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from unittest.mock import patch

from app.extensions import db as _db
from app.models import User, Project, Payment

try:

except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - environment dependent
    _PSYCOPG_AVAILABLE = False


pytestmark = [
    pytest.mark.postgres,
    pytest.mark.skipif(
        not os.getenv('TEST_DATABASE_URL'),
        reason='TEST_DATABASE_URL is not set',

def _make_razorpay_order(order_id='order_pg_test', amount=499900,
                         currency='INR', status='created'):
    return {
        'id': order_id,
        'amount': amount,
        'currency': currency,
        'status': status,
        'receipt': 'agencyos_project_1',
    }


def test_payment_unique_constraints_and_indexes_exist(app, db):
    '''PostgreSQL exposes all three uniqueness definitions.'''
    with app.app_context():
        inspector = inspect(db.engine)
        index_names = {index['name'] for index in inspector.get_indexes('payment')}
        constraint_names = {
            constraint['name']
            for constraint in inspector.get_unique_constraints('payment')
        }
        assert 'uq_payment_razorpay_order_id' in (index_names | constraint_names)
        assert 'uq_payment_razorpay_payment_id_partial' in index_names
        assert 'uq_payment_project_customer_created' in index_names

        rows = db.session.execute(
            text(
                "SELECT indexname, indexdef FROM pg_indexes "
                "WHERE tablename = 'payment'"
            )
        ).mappings().all()
        definitions = {row['indexname']: row['indexdef'] for row in rows}

        payment_index = definitions['uq_payment_razorpay_payment_id_partial']
        assert 'razorpay_payment_id' in payment_index
        assert 'IS NOT NULL' in payment_index.upper()

        created_index = definitions['uq_payment_project_customer_created']
        assert 'project_id' in created_index
        assert 'customer_id' in created_index
        assert 'Created' in created_index
def test_concurrent_duplicate_created_payment_postgres(app, db):
    '''Two PostgreSQL sessions inserting the same open-payment key: one wins.'''
    with app.app_context():
        user = User(
            name='PG Concurrency Customer',
            email='pg_concurrency@example.com',
            password=generate_password_hash('Password123'),
            role='customer',
        )
        db.session.add(user)
        db.session.commit()
        project = Project(
            customer_id=user.id,
            service='Website',
            package='Basic Website',
            requirements='PG concurrency test',
            status='Payment Pending',
        )
        db.session.add(project)
        db.session.commit()
        user_id = user.id
        project_id = project.id

    results = []
    barrier = threading.Barrier(2, timeout=10)

    def worker(order_id):
        try:
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
        except threading.BrokenBarrierError:
            results.append('barrier_error')
            return
        try:
            with app.app_context():
                payment = Payment(
                    project_id=project_id,
                    customer_id=user_id,
                    razorpay_order_id=order_id,
                    amount=4999,
                    currency='INR',
                    status='Created',
                )
                db.session.add(payment)
                db.session.commit()
                db.session.remove()
                results.append('ok')
        except IntegrityError:
            try:
                db.session.rollback()
                db.session.remove()
            except Exception:
                pass
            results.append('IntegrityError')
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - diagnostic only
            try:
                db.session.rollback()
                db.session.remove()
            except Exception:
                pass
            results.append(type(exc).__name__)

    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=worker, args=('order_pg_first',), daemon=True),
        threading.Thread(target=worker, args=('order_pg_second',), daemon=True),
    ]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join(timeout=30)

    assert all(not thread.is_alive() for thread in threads)
    assert sorted(results) == ['IntegrityError', 'ok']

    with app.app_context():
        count = Payment.query.filter_by(
            project_id=project_id,
            customer_id=user_id,
            status='Created',
        ).count()
        assert count == 1
        db.session.remove()


def test_concurrent_payment_verification_postgres(app, db):
    '''Two PostgreSQL sessions claiming one Created payment: one update wins.'''
    with app.app_context():
        user = User(
            name='PG Claim Customer',
            email='pg_claim@example.com',
            password=generate_password_hash('Password123'),
            role='customer',
        )
        db.session.add(user)
        db.session.commit()
        project = Project(
            customer_id=user.id,
            service='Website',
            package='Basic Website',
            requirements='PG claim test',
            status='Payment Pending',
        )
        db.session.add(project)
        db.session.commit()
        payment = Payment(
            project_id=project.id,
            customer_id=user.id,
            razorpay_order_id='order_pg_claim',
            amount=4999,
            currency='INR',
            status='Created',
        )
        db.session.add(payment)
        db.session.commit()
        payment_id = payment.id

    results = []
    barrier = threading.Barrier(2, timeout=10)

    def worker(payment_value):
        try:
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
        except threading.BrokenBarrierError:
            results.append('barrier_error')
            return
        try:
            with app.app_context():
                updated = Payment.query.filter_by(
                    id=payment_id, status='Created'
                ).update(
                    {
                        'status': 'Paid',
                        'razorpay_payment_id': payment_value,
                    },
                    synchronize_session=False,
                )
                db.session.commit()
                db.session.remove()
                results.append(updated)
        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - diagnostic only
            try:
                db.session.rollback()
                db.session.remove()
            except Exception:
                pass
            results.append('error:' + type(exc).__name__)

    threads = [
        threading.Thread(target=worker, args=('pay_pg_first',), daemon=True),
        threading.Thread(target=worker, args=('pay_pg_second',), daemon=True),
    ]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join(timeout=30)

    assert all(not thread.is_alive() for thread in threads)
    assert not any(
        isinstance(result, str) and result.startswith('error:')
        for result in results
    )
    assert sorted(results) == [0, 1]

    with app.app_context():
        final_payment = db.session.get(Payment, payment_id)
        assert final_payment is not None
        assert final_payment.status == 'Paid'
        assert final_payment.razorpay_payment_id in {'pay_pg_first', 'pay_pg_second'}
        db.session.remove()

def test_integrity_error_rollback_recovers_session_postgres(app, db):
    '''A rolled-back IntegrityError leaves the PostgreSQL session usable.'''
    with app.app_context():
        user = User(
            name='PG Rollback Customer',
            email='pg_rollback@example.com',
            password=generate_password_hash('Password123'),
            role='customer',
        )
        db.session.add(user)
        db.session.commit()
        project = Project(
            customer_id=user.id,
            service='Website',
            package='Basic Website',
            requirements='PG rollback test',
            status='Payment Pending',
        )
        db.session.add(project)
        db.session.commit()

        first_payment = Payment(
            project_id=project.id,
            customer_id=user.id,
            razorpay_order_id='order_pg_rollback',
            amount=4999,
            currency='INR',
            status='Created',
        )
        db.session.add(first_payment)
        db.session.commit()

        duplicate_payment = Payment(
            project_id=project.id,
            customer_id=user.id,
            razorpay_order_id='order_pg_rollback',
            amount=4999,
            currency='INR',
            status='Created',
        )
        db.session.add(duplicate_payment)
        with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
            db.session.commit()
        db.session.rollback()

        second_project = Project(
            customer_id=user.id,
            service='Website',
            package='Basic Website',
            requirements='PG rollback recovery',
            status='Payment Pending',
        )
        db.session.add(second_project)
        db.session.commit()
        recovered_payment = Payment(
            project_id=second_project.id,
            customer_id=user.id,
            razorpay_order_id='order_pg_rollback_recovered',
            amount=4999,
            currency='INR',
            status='Created',
        )
        db.session.add(recovered_payment)
        db.session.commit()

        assert recovered_payment.id is not None
        db.session.remove()


def test_duplicate_order_creation_conflict_recovers_postgres(app, client, login, factories, csrf_token, monkeypatch):
    '''Simulated order-creation conflict is handled without a 500 under PostgreSQL.'''
    customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'pg_racesim@example.com')
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Payment Pending')
    login('pg_racesim@example.com', 'customer')

    fake_order = _make_razorpay_order(order_id='order_pg_racesim')

    from app.extensions import db as _db

    original_commit = _db.session.commit
    state = {'raised': False}

    def flaky_commit():
        if not state['raised']:
            state['raised'] = True
            raise IntegrityError('race', None, None)
        return original_commit()

    monkeypatch.setattr(_db.session, 'commit', flaky_commit)

    with patch(
        'app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.create',
        return_value=fake_order,
    ):
        response = client.post(
            '/payment/create-order/' + str(project_id),
            data={'csrf_token': csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    assert response.status_code in (200, 400)


def test_payment_and_project_state_preserved_after_failed_verification_postgres(
    app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
):
    '''Failed verification leaves payment and project states unchanged.'''
    customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'pg_state@example.com')
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Payment Pending')
    factories.payment(
        project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id='order_pg_state', status='Created'
    )
    login('pg_state@example.com', 'customer')

    import razorpay

    with patch(
        'app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility.verify_payment_signature',
        side_effect=razorpay.errors.SignatureVerificationError('bad signature'),
    ):
        response = client.post(
            '/payment/verify',
            data=__import__('json').dumps({
                'razorpay_order_id': 'order_pg_state',
                'razorpay_payment_id': 'pay_pg_state',
                'razorpay_signature': 'bad_sig',
            }),
            content_type='application/json',
            headers={'X-CSRFToken': csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    assert response.status_code == 400

    with app.app_context():
        payment = Payment.query.filter_by(
            razorpay_order_id='order_pg_state'
        ).first()
        assert payment is not None
        assert payment.status == 'Created'
        assert payment.razorpay_payment_id is None
        project = _db.session.get(Project, project_id)
        assert project is not None
        assert project.status == 'Payment Pending'
        _db.session.remove()

from app.models import Invoice, Notification


def _create_approved_paid_invoice(factories, db, project_status="Completed"):
    customer_id = factories.user("customer", "redeem-client@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status=project_status)
    professional_id = factories.user("professional", "redeem-specialist@example.com")
    factories.application(project_id, professional_id, status="Assigned")
    invoice = Invoice(
        invoice_number=f"INV-REDEEM-{project_id}",
        project_id=project_id,
        customer_id=customer_id,
        gross_amount=100000,
        talent_payout=45000,
        agency_profit=55000,
        tax_amount=0,
        status="Paid",
    )
    db.session.add(invoice)
    db.session.commit()
    return invoice


def test_specialist_can_request_approved_payout_once(
    client, csrf_post, db, factories, login
):
    invoice = _create_approved_paid_invoice(factories, db)
    admin_id = factories.user("admin", "redeem-admin@example.com")
    login("redeem-specialist@example.com", "professional")

    dashboard_response = client.get("/professional/dashboard")
    assert dashboard_response.status_code == 200
    assert b"Redeem to UPI" in dashboard_response.data

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/professional/invoice/{invoice.id}/redeem",
        data={},
        follow_redirects=False,
    )

    db.session.refresh(invoice)
    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert invoice.payout_status == "Requested"
    notification = Notification.query.filter_by(user_id=admin_id).one()
    assert "Project #{}".format(invoice.project_id) in notification.message
    assert notification.link == "/admin/transactions"

    repeated_response = csrf_post(
        f"/professional/invoice/{invoice.id}/redeem",
        data={},
        follow_redirects=False,
    )
    assert repeated_response.status_code == 302
    assert Notification.query.filter_by(user_id=admin_id).count() == 1
    dashboard_response = client.get("/professional/dashboard")
    assert b"Redemption Processing" in dashboard_response.data


def test_payout_cannot_be_requested_before_client_approval(
    client, csrf_post, db, factories, login
):
    invoice = _create_approved_paid_invoice(
        factories, db, project_status="Submitted"
    )
    login("redeem-specialist@example.com", "professional")

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/professional/invoice/{invoice.id}/redeem",
        data={},
        follow_redirects=False,
    )

    db.session.refresh(invoice)
    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert invoice.payout_status == "Pending Approval"
    assert Notification.query.count() == 0


def test_another_specialist_cannot_redeem_invoice(
    client, csrf_post, db, factories, login
):
    invoice = _create_approved_paid_invoice(factories, db)
    factories.user("professional", "other-specialist@example.com")
    login("other-specialist@example.com", "professional")

    csrf_post(
        f"/professional/invoice/{invoice.id}/redeem",
        data={},
        follow_redirects=False,
    )

    db.session.refresh(invoice)
    assert invoice.payout_status == "Pending Approval"
    assert Notification.query.count() == 0

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
from unittest.mock import patch

from app.models import Invoice, Payment, Project, ProjectAddOn


def _create_addon(db, project_id, customer_id, amount=12000):
    invoice = Invoice(
        invoice_number=f"ADDON-TEST-{project_id}-{amount}",
        project_id=project_id,
        customer_id=customer_id,
        gross_amount=amount,
        talent_payout=0,
        agency_profit=amount - round(amount - amount / 1.18),
        tax_amount=round(amount - amount / 1.18),
        status="Pending",
        payout_status="Pending Approval",
    )
    db.session.add(invoice)
    db.session.flush()
    addon = ProjectAddOn(
        project_id=project_id,
        invoice_id=invoice.id,
        title="Extra checkout integration",
        amount=amount,
    )
    db.session.add(addon)
    db.session.commit()
    return addon.id, invoice.id


def test_admin_issues_linked_scope_addon_invoice(
    client, db, factories, login, csrf_post
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("addon-client@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="In Progress")
    factories.admin("addon-admin@example.com")
    login("addon-admin@example.com", "admin")

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/admin/project/{project_id}/add-on",
        data={"title": "Extra checkout integration", "amount": "12000"},
    )

    assert response.status_code == 302
    addon = ProjectAddOn.query.filter_by(project_id=project_id).one()
    assert addon.title == "Extra checkout integration"
    assert addon.amount == 12000
    assert addon.status == "Pending Payment"
    assert addon.invoice.project_id == project_id
    assert addon.invoice.customer_id == customer_id
    assert addon.invoice.gross_amount == 12000
    assert addon.invoice.status == "Pending"
    assert addon.invoice.invoice_number.startswith(f"ADDON-{project_id}-")


def test_admin_rejects_invalid_addon_amount(client, db, factories, login, csrf_post):

def test_customer_workspace_shows_pending_and_paid_addons(
    client, db, factories, login
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("addon-workspace@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="In Progress")
    pending_id, _ = _create_addon(db, project_id, customer_id)
    paid_id, _ = _create_addon(db, project_id, customer_id, amount=6000)
    ProjectAddOn.query.filter_by(id=paid_id).one().status = "Paid"
    db.session.commit()
    login("addon-workspace@example.com", "customer")

    response = client.get(f"/project/{project_id}")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert b"Extra checkout integration" in response.data
    assert b"Authorize Add-On Payment" in response.data
    assert ProjectAddOn.query.filter_by(id=pending_id).one().status == "Pending Payment"

def test_create_addon_order_uses_saved_amount_and_reuses_order(
    app, client, db, factories, login, csrf_token
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("addon-order@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="In Progress")
    addon_id, _ = _create_addon(db, project_id, customer_id, amount=12000)
    login("addon-order@example.com", "customer")

    order = {"id": "order_addon_123"}
    with patch(
        "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.create",
        return_value=order,
    ) as create_order:
        response = client.post(
            f"/payment/create-order/{project_id}",
            json={"addon_id": addon_id},
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200
        assert response.get_json()["amount"] == 1_200_000
        assert Payment.query.filter_by(addon_id=addon_id).count() == 1
        create_order.assert_called_once()
        assert create_order.call_args.args[0]["amount"] == 1_200_000

        duplicate_response = client.post(
            f"/payment/create-order/{project_id}",
            json={"addon_id": addon_id},
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
        )

    assert duplicate_response.status_code == 200
    assert duplicate_response.get_json()["order_id"] == "order_addon_123"
    assert create_order.call_count == 1


def test_verified_addon_payment_marks_invoice_and_addon_paid_only(
    app, client, db, factories, login, csrf_token
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("addon-verify@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="Revision")
    addon_id, invoice_id = _create_addon(db, project_id, customer_id, amount=12000)
    payment = Payment(
        project_id=project_id,
        customer_id=customer_id,
        addon_id=addon_id,
        razorpay_order_id="order_addon_verify",
        amount=12000,
        status="Created",
    )
    db.session.add(payment)
    db.session.commit()
    login("addon-verify@example.com", "customer")

    with patch(
        "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility.verify_payment_signature",
        return_value=True,
    ), patch(
        "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.fetch",
        return_value={
            "id": "order_addon_verify",
            "amount": 1_200_000,
            "currency": "INR",
        },
    ), patch(
        "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.payment.fetch",
        return_value={
            "order_id": "order_addon_verify",
            "amount": 1_200_000,
            "currency": "INR",
            "status": "captured",
        },
    ):
        response = client.post(
            "/payment/verify",
            json={
                "razorpay_order_id": "order_addon_verify",
                "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_addon_verify",
                "razorpay_signature": "valid_signature",
            },
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
        )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.get_json()["addon_id"] == addon_id
    assert ProjectAddOn.query.filter_by(id=addon_id).one().status == "Paid"
    assert Invoice.query.filter_by(id=invoice_id).one().status == "Paid"
    assert Payment.query.filter_by(id=payment.id).one().status == "Paid"
    assert Project.query.filter_by(id=project_id).one().status == "Revision"


def test_addon_verification_rejects_mismatched_gateway_amount(
    app, client, db, factories, login, csrf_token
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("addon-mismatch@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="In Progress")

        project_id=project_id,

        amount=12000,
        status="Created",
    )
    db.session.add(payment)
    db.session.commit()
    login("addon-mismatch@example.com", "customer")

    with patch(
        "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.utility.verify_payment_signature",
        return_value=True,
    ), patch(
        "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.order.fetch",
        return_value={
            "id": "order_addon_mismatch",
            "amount": 1_199_999,
            "currency": "INR",
        },
    ), patch(
        "app.blueprints.payments.razorpay_client.payment.fetch",
        return_value={
            "order_id": "order_addon_mismatch",
            "amount": 1_199_999,
            "currency": "INR",
            "status": "captured",
        },
    ):
        response = client.post(
            "/payment/verify",
            json={
                "razorpay_order_id": "order_addon_mismatch",
                "razorpay_payment_id": "pay_addon_mismatch",
                "razorpay_signature": "valid_signature",
            },
            headers={"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token},
        )

    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert Payment.query.filter_by(id=payment.id).one().status == "Created"
    assert ProjectAddOn.query.filter_by(id=addon_id).one().status == "Pending Payment"
    assert Invoice.query.filter_by(id=invoice_id).one().status == "Pending"


def test_webhook_marks_linked_addon_paid(app, client, db, factories, monkeypatch):
    customer_id = factories.customer("addon-webhook@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="In Progress")
    addon_id, invoice_id = _create_addon(db, project_id, customer_id)
    payment = Payment(
        project_id=project_id,
        customer_id=customer_id,
        addon_id=addon_id,
        razorpay_order_id="order_addon_webhook",
        amount=12000,
        status="Created",
    )
    db.session.add(payment)
    db.session.commit()
    secret = "test-webhook-secret"
    monkeypatch.setenv("RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET", secret)
    payload = json.dumps({
        "event": "payment.captured",
        "payload": {
            "payment": {
                "entity": {
                    "id": "pay_addon_webhook",
                    "order_id": "order_addon_webhook",
                    "amount": 1_200_000,
                    "currency": "INR",
                }
            }
        },
    }).encode()
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

    response = client.post(
        "/webhook",
        data=payload,
        content_type="application/json",
        headers={"X-Razorpay-Signature": signature},
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert ProjectAddOn.query.filter_by(id=addon_id).one().status == "Paid"
    assert Invoice.query.filter_by(id=invoice_id).one().status == "Paid"

        in project.requirements
    )
    assert "Injected feature" not in project.requirements
    assert "Custom Features: Appointment booking" in project.requirements

from io import BytesIO
import os

from app.models import Project, ProjectDelivery


def test_customer_can_attach_srs_to_project(
    app, client, db, factories, login, csrf_post, tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    customer_id = factories.user("customer", "upload-client@example.com")
    login("upload-client@example.com", "customer")
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "static_folder", str(tmp_path))

    response = csrf_post(
        "/start-project",
        data={
            "brief": "Build a customer portal",
            "srs_document": (BytesIO(b"project requirements"), "../requirements.pdf"),
        },
        follow_redirects=False,
    )

    assert response.status_code == 302
    project = Project.query.filter_by(customer_id=customer_id).one()
    assert "Attached Client Document: /static/uploads/" in project.requirements
    stored_name = project.requirements.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    with open(os.path.join(tmp_path, "uploads", stored_name), "rb") as saved_file:
        assert saved_file.read() == b"project requirements"


def test_assigned_specialist_can_attach_deliverable(
    app, client, db, factories, login, csrf_post, tmp_path, monkeypatch
):
    customer_id = factories.user("customer", "delivery-client@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="In Progress")
    professional_id = factories.user("professional", "delivery-specialist@example.com")
    factories.application(project_id, professional_id, status="Assigned")
    login("delivery-specialist@example.com", "professional")
    monkeypatch.setattr(app, "static_folder", str(tmp_path))

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/professional/project/{project_id}/submit",
        data={
            "preview_url": "https://preview.example.com",
            "completion_notes": "Delivery notes",
            "deliverable_file": (BytesIO(b"deliverable archive"), "assets.zip"),
        },
        follow_redirects=False,
    )

    assert response.status_code == 302
    delivery = ProjectDelivery.query.filter_by(project_id=project_id).one()
    assert "Attached Deliverable File: /static/uploads/" in delivery.completion_notes
    stored_name = delivery.completion_notes.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
    with open(os.path.join(tmp_path, "uploads", stored_name), "rb") as saved_file:
        assert saved_file.read() == b"deliverable archive"

"""Project workflow tests: application, assignment, submission, and approval."""

import pytest


class TestAdminVerification:
    """Test admin verification of professionals."""

    def test_verify_and_reject_professional(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Admin should verify and reject professional profiles."""
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'verify@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Pending')

        admin_id = factories.user('admin', 'admin-verify@example.com')
        login('admin-verify@example.com', 'admin')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/admin/professionals/' + str(prof_id) + '/verify',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        from app.models import ProfessionalProfile

        with app.app_context():
            profile = ProfessionalProfile.query.get(prof_id)
            assert profile.verification_status == 'Verified'

        # Reject the professional
        response = csrf_post(
            '/admin/professionals/' + str(prof_id) + '/reject',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        with app.app_context():
            profile = ProfessionalProfile.query.get(prof_id)
            assert profile.verification_status == 'Rejected'


class TestApply:
    """Test project application flows."""

    def test_apply_to_non_pending_project_blocked(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Applying to a non-Pending Assignment project is blocked."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'apply-nonpending@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Assigned')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'apply-nonpending-prof@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Verified')
        login('apply-nonpending-prof@example.com', 'professional')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/professional/projects/' + str(project_id) + '/apply',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        from app.models import ProfessionalProjectApplication

        with app.app_context():
            count = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(
                project_id=project_id, professional_id=prof_id
            ).count()
            assert count == 0

    def test_duplicate_apply_rejected(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Duplicate application to same project is rejected."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'apply-dup@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Pending Assignment')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'apply-dup-prof@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Verified')
        login('apply-dup-prof@example.com', 'professional')

        response1 = csrf_post(
            '/professional/projects/' + str(project_id) + '/apply',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response1.status_code == 302

        response2 = csrf_post(
            '/professional/projects/' + str(project_id) + '/apply',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response2.status_code == 302

        from app.models import ProfessionalProjectApplication

        with app.app_context():
            count = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(
                project_id=project_id, professional_id=prof_id
            ).count()
            assert count == 1

    def test_expertise_mismatch_blocked(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Professional without matching expertise cannot apply."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'apply-mismatch@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Pending Assignment')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'apply-mismatch-prof@example.com')
        factories.profile(
            prof_id, verification_status='Verified', expertise='Web Development'
        )
        login('apply-mismatch-prof@example.com', 'professional')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/professional/projects/' + str(project_id) + '/apply',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        from app.models import ProfessionalProjectApplication

        with app.app_context():
            count = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(
                project_id=project_id, professional_id=prof_id
            ).count()
            assert count == 0

    def test_unverified_professional_blocked(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Unverified professional cannot apply."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'apply-unverified@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Pending Assignment')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'apply-unverified-prof@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Pending')
        login('apply-unverified-prof@example.com', 'professional')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/professional/projects/' + str(project_id) + '/apply',

            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        from app.models import ProfessionalProjectApplication

        with app.app_context():
            count = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(

    def test_verified_professional_applies(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Verified professional with matching expertise can apply."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'apply-ok@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Pending Assignment')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'apply-ok-prof@example.com')
        # Default profile expertise matches the default project service.
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Verified')
        login('apply-ok-prof@example.com', 'professional')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/professional/projects/' + str(project_id) + '/apply',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        with app.app_context():
            app_row = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.filter_by(
