            ).first()
            assert app_row is not None
            assert app_row.status == 'Applied'
            assert db.session.get(Project, project_id) is not None


class TestAssignAndStart:
    """Test project assignment and starting."""

    def test_assign_blocked_when_application_not_applied(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Assign blocked when application status is not 'Applied'"""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'assign-notapp@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Pending Assignment')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'assign-notapp-prof@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Verified')
        app_id = factories.application(project_id, prof_id, status='Not Selected')

        admin_id = factories.user('admin', 'assign-notapp-admin@example.com')
        login('assign-notapp-admin@example.com', 'admin')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/admin/applications/' + str(app_id) + '/assign',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        from app.models import ProfessionalProjectApplication, Project

        with app.app_context():
            application = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.get(app_id)
            assert application.status == 'Not Selected'
            assert Project.query.get(project_id).status == 'Pending Assignment'

    def test_assign_blocked_when_project_not_pending(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Assign blocked when project is not 'Pending Assignment'"""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'assign-notpending@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Assigned')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'assign-notpending-prof@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Verified')
        app_id = factories.application(project_id, prof_id, status='Applied')

        admin_id = factories.user('admin', 'assign-notpending-admin@example.com')
        login('assign-notpending-admin@example.com', 'admin')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/admin/applications/' + str(app_id) + '/assign',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        from app.models import ProfessionalProjectApplication, Project

        with app.app_context():
            application = ProfessionalProjectApplication.query.get(app_id)
            assert application.status == 'Applied'
            # Project remains 'Assigned' (was never 'Pending Assignment')
            assert Project.query.get(project_id).status == 'Assigned'

    def test_assign_transitions_all_applications(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Assign transitions selected app to 'Assigned' and others to 'Not Selected'."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'assign-all@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Pending Assignment')
        prof1_id = factories.user('professional', 'assign-all-prof1@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof1_id, verification_status='Verified')
        prof2_id = factories.user('professional', 'assign-all-prof2@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof2_id, verification_status='Verified')

        app1_id = factories.application(project_id, prof1_id, status='Applied')
        app2_id = factories.application(project_id, prof2_id, status='Applied')

        admin_id = factories.user('admin', 'assign-all-admin@example.com')
        login('assign-all-admin@example.com', 'admin')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/admin/applications/' + str(app1_id) + '/assign',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        from app.extensions import db
        from app.models import ProfessionalProjectApplication, Project

        with app.app_context():
            app1 = db.session.get(ProfessionalProjectApplication, app1_id)
            app2 = db.session.get(ProfessionalProjectApplication, app2_id)
            project = db.session.get(Project, project_id)
            assert app1 is not None
            assert app2 is not None
            assert project is not None
            assert app1.status == 'Assigned'
            assert app2.status == 'Not Selected'
            assert project.status == 'Assigned'

    def test_assign_rejected_when_professional_pending(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Assign is rejected when professional verification is Pending."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'assign-pending@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='Pending Assignment')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'assign-pending-prof@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Pending')
        other_prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'assign-pending-other@example.com')
        factories.profile(other_prof_id, verification_status='Verified')

        selected_app_id = factories.application(project_id, prof_id, status='Applied')
        competing_app_id = factories.application(project_id, other_prof_id, status='Applied')

        admin_id = factories.user('admin', 'assign-pending-admin@example.com')
        login('assign-pending-admin@example.com', 'admin')

        response = csrf_post(
            '/admin/applications/' + str(selected_app_id) + '/assign',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        from app.extensions import db
        from app.models import ProfessionalProjectApplication, Project

        with app.app_context():
            selected = db.session.get(ProfessionalProjectApplication, selected_app_id)
            competing = db.session.get(ProfessionalProjectApplication, competing_app_id)
            project = db.session.get(Project, project_id)
            assert selected is not None
            assert competing is not None
            assert project is not None
            assert selected.status == 'Applied'
            assert competing.status == 'Applied'
            assert project.status == 'Pending Assignment'

    def test_assign_rejected_when_verification_empty(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Assign is rejected when professional verification status is empty."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'assign-empty@example.com')

    def test_full_review_cycle(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_post
    ):
        """Full review cycle: submit -> revision -> resubmit -> approve."""
        customer_id = factories.user('customer', 'review-cycle@example.com')
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status='In Progress')
        prof_id = factories.user('professional', 'review-cycle-prof@example.com')
        factories.profile(prof_id, verification_status='Verified')
        factories.application(project_id, prof_id, status='Assigned')
        login('review-cycle-prof@example.com', 'professional')

        # Start the project
        csrf_post(
            '/professional/project/' + str(project_id) + '/start',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

        # Submit work (moves from In Progress -> Submitted)
        csrf_post(
            '/professional/project/' + str(project_id) + '/submit',
            data={'live_url': 'https://example.com', 'completion_notes': 'Work complete'},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

        from app.models import Project

        with app.app_context():
            assert Project.query.get(project_id).status == 'Submitted'

        # Admin requests revision
        admin_id = factories.user('admin', 'review-cycle-admin@example.com')
        login('review-cycle-admin@example.com', 'admin')
        factories.delivery(project_id, prof_id)

        response = csrf_post(
            '/admin/project/' + str(project_id) + '/revision',
            data={'revision_comment': 'Needs fixes'},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        with app.app_context():
            assert Project.query.get(project_id).status == 'Revision'

        # Professional resubmits
        login('review-cycle-prof@example.com', 'professional')
        response = csrf_post(
            '/professional/project/' + str(project_id) + '/resubmit',
            data={'live_url': 'https://example.com/fixed', 'completion_notes': 'Fixed'},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        with app.app_context():
            assert Project.query.get(project_id).status == 'Submitted'

        # Admin approves
        login('review-cycle-admin@example.com', 'admin')
        response = csrf_post(
            '/admin/project/' + str(project_id) + '/approve',
            data={},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302

        with app.app_context():
            assert Project.query.get(project_id).status == 'Completed'

--- FILE: .\tests\test_recovery_auth.py ---
"""Tests for the selective AgencyOS recovery script."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from scripts import recover_agencyos_source as recovery


SCHEMA = r'''
CREATE TABLE user (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL,
    password TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME
);

CREATE TABLE customer_profile (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    phone TEXT,
    location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE professional_profile (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    expertise TEXT NOT NULL,
    experience TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME
);

CREATE TABLE business (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME
);

CREATE TABLE project (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    service TEXT NOT NULL,
    package TEXT NOT NULL,
    requirements TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME,
    business_id INTEGER REFERENCES business(id)
);

CREATE TABLE professional_project_application (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id),
    professional_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    status TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME
);

CREATE TABLE project_delivery (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id),
    professional_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    submission_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    completion_notes TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    submitted_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
    reviewed_at DATETIME
);

CREATE TABLE payment (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id),
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    razorpay_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    razorpay_payment_id TEXT,
    amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
    currency TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME,
    paid_at DATETIME
);

CREATE TABLE chat_message (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id),
    sender_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE invoice (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id),
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    gross_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
    talent_payout INTEGER NOT NULL,
    agency_profit INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tax_amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE notification (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES user(id),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_read INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL
);
'''


def create_empty_db(path: Path) -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


def insert_user(conn, user_id, name, email, role="customer", created_at=None):
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO user (id, name, email, password, role, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (user_id, name, email, "hashed-password", role, created_at),
    )


def fk_issues(conn):
    return conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()


@pytest.fixture
def source_db(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    path = tmp_path / "source.db"
    create_empty_db(path)
    return path


@pytest.fixture
def target_db(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    path = tmp_path / "target.db"
    create_empty_db(path)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
    insert_user(conn, 1, "Admin", "admin@example.com", role="admin")
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return path
def test_collision_remapping_and_admin_preservation(source_db, target_db):
    sconn = sqlite3.connect(str(source_db))
    for uid in (1, 2, 3):
        insert_user(sconn, uid, f"Source User {uid}", f"source{uid}@example.com")
    sconn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO customer_profile (id, user_id, phone, location) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (1, 1, "123", "City"),
    )
    sconn.commit()
    sconn.close()

    summary = recovery.run_migration(source_db, target_db, recovery.DEFAULT_MIGRATION_TIMESTAMP)

    assert summary["user_id_map"][1] != 1
    assert summary["user_id_map"][1] >= 4

    tconn = sqlite3.connect(str(target_db))
    tconn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    admin = tconn.execute("SELECT name, email, role, password FROM user WHERE id = 1").fetchone()
    assert admin == ("Admin", "admin@example.com", "admin", "hashed-password")
    remapped = tconn.execute(
        "SELECT name, password FROM user WHERE id = ?", (summary["user_id_map"][1],)
    ).fetchone()
    assert remapped == ("Source User 1", "hashed-password")
    profile = tconn.execute(
        "SELECT user_id FROM customer_profile WHERE id = 1"
    ).fetchone()
    assert profile == (summary["user_id_map"][1],)
    assert fk_issues(tconn) == []
    tconn.close()


def test_timestamp_normalization_related_and_fallback(source_db, target_db):
    sconn = sqlite3.connect(str(source_db))
    insert_user(sconn, 1, "Source User", "source@example.com")
    sconn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO project (id, customer_id, service, package, requirements, status, created_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (1, 1, "Svc", "Pkg", "Req", "Pending", None),
    )
    sconn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO payment (id, project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id, amount, currency, status, created_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (1, 1, 1, "order_ts_1", 100, "INR", "Created", "2024-02-02 10:00:00"),
    )
    sconn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO project (id, customer_id, service, package, requirements, status, created_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (2, 1, "Svc2", "Pkg2", "Req2", "Pending", None),
    )
    sconn.commit()
    sconn.close()

    migration_ts = "2020-01-01 00:00:00"
    summary = recovery.run_migration(source_db, target_db, migration_ts)
    assert summary["normalized_projects"] == 2
    assert summary["normalized_related"] == 1
    assert summary["normalized_fallback"] == 1

    tconn = sqlite3.connect(str(target_db))
    first = tconn.execute("SELECT created_at FROM project WHERE id = 1").fetchone()[0]
    second = tconn.execute("SELECT created_at FROM project WHERE id = 2").fetchone()[0]
    assert first == "2024-02-02 10:00:00"
    assert second == migration_ts
    tconn.close()
def test_payment_preservation_and_fields(source_db, target_db):
    sconn = sqlite3.connect(str(source_db))
    insert_user(sconn, 1, "Source User", "source@example.com")
    sconn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO project (id, customer_id, service, package, requirements, status, created_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (1, 1, "Svc", "Pkg", "Req", "Pending", "2024-01-01 00:00:00"),
    )
    sconn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO payment (id, project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, amount, currency, status, created_at, paid_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (1, 1, 1, "order_pay_1", "pay_1", 4999, "INR", "Paid", "2024-01-02 00:00:00", "2024-01-03 00:00:00"),
    )
    sconn.commit()
    sconn.close()

    summary = recovery.run_migration(source_db, target_db, recovery.DEFAULT_MIGRATION_TIMESTAMP)
    assert summary["empty_payment_ids"] == 0

    tconn = sqlite3.connect(str(target_db))
    row = tconn.execute(
        "SELECT project_id, customer_id, razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, amount, currency, status, created_at, paid_at "
        "FROM payment WHERE id = 1"
    ).fetchone()
    remapped_user = summary["user_id_map"][1]
    assert row[0] == 1
    assert row[1] == remapped_user
    assert row[2] == "order_pay_1"
    assert row[3] == "pay_1"
    assert row[4] == 4999
    assert row[5] == "INR"
    assert row[6] == "Paid"
    assert row[7] == "2024-01-02 00:00:00"
    assert row[8] == "2024-01-03 00:00:00"
    tconn.close()


def test_duplicate_emails_are_preserved(source_db, target_db):
    sconn = sqlite3.connect(str(source_db))
    insert_user(sconn, 1, "Source Admin", "duplicate@example.com")
    insert_user(sconn, 2, "Source Admin Two", "duplicate@example.com")
    sconn.commit()
    sconn.close()

    summary = recovery.run_migration(source_db, target_db, recovery.DEFAULT_MIGRATION_TIMESTAMP)
    assert summary["user_id_map"][1] != 1

    tconn = sqlite3.connect(str(target_db))
    emails = [r[0] for r in tconn.execute("SELECT email FROM user").fetchall()]
    assert emails.count("duplicate@example.com") == 2
    tconn.close()

def test_unsafe_paths():
    original = Path(r"D:\AgencyOS\instance\agencyos.db")
    backup = Path(r"D:\AgencyOS1_recovery_backups\20261027_010754\source.db")
    assert recovery.is_protected(original)[0] is True
    assert recovery.is_protected(backup)[0] is True

    dummy = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "dummy.db"
    create_empty_db(dummy)
    try:
        import sys as _sys

        _sys.argv = [
            "recover_agencyos_source.py",
            "--source-copy",
            str(dummy),
            "--target-copy",
            str(dummy),
            "--confirm-disposable-target",
        ]
        assert recovery.main() == 1
    finally:
        dummy.unlink(missing_ok=True)

def test_password_hash_mismatch_detection(source_db, target_db):
    sconn = sqlite3.connect(str(source_db))
    insert_user(sconn, 1, "Source User", "source@example.com")
    sconn.commit()
    sconn.close()

    summary = recovery.run_migration(source_db, target_db, recovery.DEFAULT_MIGRATION_TIMESTAMP)

    tconn = sqlite3.connect(str(target_db))
    tconn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    baseline = recovery.capture_admin_baseline(tconn)
    tconn.execute(
        "UPDATE user SET password = ? WHERE id = ?",
        ("tampered-hash", summary["user_id_map"][1]),
    )
    tconn.commit()

    sconn = sqlite3.connect(str(source_db))
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        recovery.validate_imported_users(sconn, tconn, summary["user_id_map"], baseline)
    tconn.close()
    sconn.close()

from datetime import datetime

from app.models import Project, ProjectDelivery
from app.services.email import EmailDeliveryError
from app.services.reminders import (
    send_payment_reminder,
    send_review_reminder,
)


def _set_mail_base_url(app):
    app.config["APP_BASE_URL"] = "https://agencyos.example"
    app.config["MAIL_BACKEND"] = "console"
    app.config["TEST_EMAILS"] = []


def test_payment_reminder_sends_once_after_24_hours(app, db, factories):
    _set_mail_base_url(app)
    customer_id = factories.customer("payment-reminder@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(
        customer_id,
        status="Payment Pending",
        created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10),
    )
    now = datetime(2026, 1, 2, 11)

    assert send_payment_reminder(project_id, now=now) is True
    assert send_payment_reminder(project_id, now=now) is False

    project = db.session.get(Project, project_id)
    assert project.payment_reminder_sent_at == now
    email = app.config["TEST_EMAILS"][0]
    assert email["to"] == "payment-reminder@example.com"
    assert "https://agencyos.example/payment/" in email["body"]


def test_payment_reminder_waits_until_24_hours(app, db, factories):
    _set_mail_base_url(app)
    customer_id = factories.customer("payment-wait@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(
        customer_id,
        status="Payment Pending",
        created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10),
    )

    assert send_payment_reminder(
        project_id, now=datetime(2026, 1, 2, 9, 59)
    ) is False
    assert app.config["TEST_EMAILS"] == []


def test_review_reminder_targets_latest_submitted_delivery(
    app, db, factories
):
    _set_mail_base_url(app)
    customer_id = factories.customer("review-reminder@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="Submitted")
    professional_id = factories.professional("review-specialist@example.com")
    delivery_id = factories.delivery(
        project_id,
        professional_id,
        submitted_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10),
    )

    assert send_review_reminder(
        project_id, now=datetime(2026, 1, 3, 10)
    ) is True

    delivery = db.session.get(ProjectDelivery, delivery_id)
    assert delivery.review_reminder_sent_at == datetime(2026, 1, 3, 10)
    email = app.config["TEST_EMAILS"][0]
    assert email["to"] == "review-reminder@example.com"
    assert "https://agencyos.example/project/" in email["body"]


def test_failed_email_does_not_mark_reminder_sent(
    app, db, factories, monkeypatch
):
    _set_mail_base_url(app)
    customer_id = factories.customer("failed-reminder@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(
        customer_id,
        status="Payment Pending",
        created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10),
    )

    def fail_delivery(*args, **kwargs):
        raise EmailDeliveryError("SMTP unavailable")

    monkeypatch.setattr("app.services.reminders.send_email", fail_delivery)

    assert send_payment_reminder(
        project_id, now=datetime(2026, 1, 2, 11)
    ) is False
    assert db.session.get(Project, project_id).payment_reminder_sent_at is None


def test_admin_can_manually_send_reminder_before_due(
    app, client, db, factories, login, csrf_post
):
    _set_mail_base_url(app)
    customer_id = factories.customer("manual-reminder@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="Payment Pending")
    factories.admin("reminder-admin@example.com")
    login("reminder-admin@example.com", "admin")

    page = client.get("/admin/project-management")
    assert page.status_code == 200
    assert b"Remind Client" in page.data

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/admin/project/{project_id}/send-reminder",
    )

    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert response.headers["Location"].endswith("/admin/project-management")
    assert len(app.config["TEST_EMAILS"]) == 1


def test_admin_can_manually_send_review_reminder(
    app, factories, login, csrf_post
):
    _set_mail_base_url(app)
    customer_id = factories.customer("manual-review@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="Submitted")
    professional_id = factories.professional("manual-review-specialist@example.com")

        professional_id,
        submitted_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10),
    )
    factories.admin("manual-review-admin@example.com")
    login("manual-review-admin@example.com", "admin")

    response = csrf_post(f"/admin/project/{project_id}/send-reminder")

    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert app.config["TEST_EMAILS"][0]["to"] == "manual-review@example.com"
    assert "Review requested" in app.config["TEST_EMAILS"][0]["subject"]

    customer_id = factories.customer("client-reminder@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="Payment Pending")

def test_scheduled_reminder_command_sends_only_due_reminders(app, factories):
    _set_mail_base_url(app)
    customer_id = factories.customer("scheduled-reminder@example.com")
    factories.project(
        customer_id,
        status="Payment Pending",
        created_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10),
    )
    review_customer_id = factories.customer("scheduled-review@example.com")
    review_project_id = factories.project(
        review_customer_id,
        status="Submitted",
    )
    professional_id = factories.professional("scheduled-specialist@example.com")
    factories.delivery(
        review_project_id,
        professional_id,
        submitted_at=datetime(2026, 1, 1, 10),
    )

    result = app.test_cli_runner().invoke(args=["send-reminders"])

    assert result.exit_code == 0
    assert "1 payment, 1 review, 0 failed" in result.output
    assert len(app.config["TEST_EMAILS"]) == 2

class TestSafeErrorHandlers:

    def test_not_found_browser_response(self, app, client):
        response = client.get("/definitely-not-a-route", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 404
        assert response.data == b"Page not found."

    def test_not_found_json_response_for_api(self, app, client):
        response = client.get("/api/definitely-not-a-route", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 404
        assert response.get_json() == {
            "success": False,
            "message": "Not found.",
        }

    def test_not_found_json_response_for_payment(self, app, client):
        response = client.get("/payment/definitely-not-a-route", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 404
        assert response.get_json() == {
            "success": False,
            "message": "Not found.",
        }

    def test_internal_server_error_browser_response(self, app, client):
        def boom():
            raise RuntimeError("secret internal detail")

        app.add_url_rule("/__test_internal_error", view_func=boom)

        original_testing = app.config.get("TESTING", False)
        original_propagate = app.config.get("PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS", None)
        app.config["TESTING"] = False
        app.config["PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS"] = False
        try:
            response = client.get("/__test_internal_error", follow_redirects=False)
        finally:
            app.config["TESTING"] = original_testing
            app.config["PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS"] = original_propagate
        assert response.status_code == 500
        assert response.data == b"Internal server error."
        assert b"secret internal detail" not in response.data

    def test_internal_server_error_json_response(self, app, client):
        def boom():
            raise RuntimeError("secret internal detail")

        app.add_url_rule("/api/__test_internal_error", view_func=boom)

        original_testing = app.config.get("TESTING", False)
        original_propagate = app.config.get("PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS", None)
        app.config["TESTING"] = False
        app.config["PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS"] = False
        try:
            response = client.get("/api/__test_internal_error", follow_redirects=False)
        finally:
            app.config["TESTING"] = original_testing
            app.config["PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS"] = original_propagate
        assert response.status_code == 500
        assert response.get_json() == {
            "success": False,
            "message": "Internal server error.",
        }
        assert b"secret internal detail" not in response.data

--- FILE: .\tests\test_sow_pdf.py ---
import re

from app.models import Project


def _signed_requirements(brief="Build a website"):
    return (
        f"{brief} [Signed by: Test Signer (Founder) from IP: "
        "127.0.0.1 on 01 Nov 2026 10:00 IST]"
    )


def test_unsigned_project_cannot_download_signed_sow(client, factories, login):
    customer_id = factories.customer("sow-client@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
    login("sow-client@example.com", "customer")

    response = client.get(f"/project/{project_id}/sow-pdf")

    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert f"/project/{project_id}/contract" in response.headers["Location"]


def test_contract_requires_explicit_acceptance_before_signing(
    client, factories, login, csrf_post
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("sow-unchecked@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
    login("sow-unchecked@example.com", "customer")

    response = csrf_post(
        f"/project/{project_id}/contract",
        data={"signer_name": "Test Signer", "signer_title": "Founder"},
    )

    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert f"/project/{project_id}/contract" in response.headers["Location"]

    assert (
        Project.query.filter_by(id=project_id).one().requirements == "Build a website"
    )


def test_customer_can_download_owned_signed_sow(client, factories, login):
    customer_id = factories.customer("sow-owner@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(
        customer_id, requirements=_signed_requirements("Create <b>safe</b> scope")
    )
    login("sow-owner@example.com", "customer")

    response = client.get(f"/project/{project_id}/sow-pdf")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.mimetype == "application/pdf"
    assert response.headers["Content-Disposition"] == (
        f"attachment; filename=AgencyOS_SOW_Project_{project_id}.pdf"
    )
    assert response.data.startswith(b"%PDF-")
    assert len(re.findall(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", response.data)) == 2


def test_customer_cannot_download_another_customers_signed_sow(
    client, factories, login
):
    owner_id = factories.customer("sow-other-owner@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(
        owner_id, requirements=_signed_requirements()
    )
    factories.customer("sow-other-customer@example.com")
    login("sow-other-customer@example.com", "customer")

    response = client.get(f"/project/{project_id}/sow-pdf")

    assert response.status_code == 302
    assert "/dashboard" in response.headers["Location"]

"""Stripe integration tests: checkout session creation and webhook handling.

Stripe API calls are mocked; no real payments are made.
"""

import json
from decimal import Decimal
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

import pytest
import stripe

from app.models import Project, Payment, Invoice, StripeWebhookEvent
from app.utils.currency import calculate_tax_rate
from app.utils.stripe_config import (
    STRIPE_PRICE_MATRIX,
    SUPPORTED_STRIPE_CURRENCIES,
    get_stripe_price_id,
    build_checkout_session_params,
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tax rate tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestCalculateTaxRate:
    def test_inr_domestic_18_percent(self):
        assert calculate_tax_rate("IN", "INR") == Decimal("0.18")

    def test_usd_international_zero(self):
        assert calculate_tax_rate("US", "USD") == Decimal("0.00")

    def test_eur_international_zero(self):
        assert calculate_tax_rate("DE", "EUR") == Decimal("0.00")

    def test_gbp_international_zero(self):
        assert calculate_tax_rate("GB", "GBP") == Decimal("0.00")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stripe config tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestStripeConfig:
    def test_price_matrix_has_all_currencies(self):
        for currency in ("USD", "EUR", "GBP"):
            assert currency in STRIPE_PRICE_MATRIX
            assert "Basic Website" in STRIPE_PRICE_MATRIX[currency]

    def test_supported_currencies(self):
        assert "USD" in SUPPORTED_STRIPE_CURRENCIES
        assert "EUR" in SUPPORTED_STRIPE_CURRENCIES
        assert "GBP" in SUPPORTED_STRIPE_CURRENCIES
        assert "INR" not in SUPPORTED_STRIPE_CURRENCIES

    def test_get_stripe_price_id_usd(self):
        price_id = get_stripe_price_id("USD", "Basic Website")
        assert price_id == "price_usd_basic_placeholder"

    def test_get_stripe_price_id_eur(self):
        price_id = get_stripe_price_id("EUR", "SEO Growth")
        assert price_id == "price_eur_seo_growth_placeholder"

    def test_get_stripe_price_id_invalid_currency(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unsupported currency for Stripe"):
            get_stripe_price_id("CAD", "Basic Website")

    def test_get_stripe_price_id_invalid_package(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not found in Stripe price matrix"):
            get_stripe_price_id("USD", "Nonexistent Package")

    def test_build_checkout_session_params(self):
        params = build_checkout_session_params(
            project_id=42,
            package_name="Basic Website",
            currency="USD",
            success_url="https://example.com/success",
            cancel_url="https://example.com/cancel",
        )
        assert params["mode"] == "payment"
        assert params["payment_method_types"] == ["card"]
        assert len(params["line_items"]) == 1
        assert params["line_items"][0]["quantity"] == 1
        assert params["client_reference_id"] == "42"
        assert params["metadata"]["project_id"] == "42"
        assert params["metadata"]["package_name"] == "Basic Website"
        assert params["metadata"]["currency"] == "USD"

class TestCreateStripeCheckout:
    def _make_stripe_session(self, session_id="cs_test_123",
                             url="https://checkout.stripe.com/s/cs_test_123"):
        return MagicMock(id=session_id, url=url)

    def test_anonymous_redirected(self, app, client, csrf_token):
        response = client.post(
            "/payment/stripe/checkout/1",
            data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 302
        assert "/login" in response.headers["Location"]

    def test_non_customer_forbidden(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        factories.user("professional", "stripe-pro@example.com")
        login("stripe-pro@example.com", "professional")

        response = client.post(
            "/payment/stripe/checkout/1",
            data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 403

    def test_project_not_found(self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token):
        factories.user("customer", "stripe-cust@example.com")
        login("stripe-cust@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.post(
            "/payment/stripe/checkout/99999",
            data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 404

    def test_non_payable_state_rejected(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "stripe-nonpay@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id, status="Assigned")
        login("stripe-nonpay@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.post(
            f"/payment/stripe/checkout/{project_id}",
            data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 400
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is False
        assert data["message"] == "Project is not in a payable state."
    def test_already_paid_rejected(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "stripe-paid@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(customer_id)
        payment = Payment(
            project_id=project_id,
            customer_id=customer_id,
            stripe_session_id="cs_paid_123",
            gateway_type="stripe",
            amount=Decimal("100.00"),
            currency="USD",
            status="Paid",
        )
        from app.extensions import db as _db
        _db.session.add(payment)
        _db.session.commit()
        login("stripe-paid@example.com", "customer")

        response = client.post(
            f"/payment/stripe/checkout/{project_id}",
            data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
            follow_redirects=False,
        )
        assert response.status_code == 400
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is False
        assert data["message"] == "Project has already been paid."

    def test_success_creates_checkout_session(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "stripe-success@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(
            customer_id,
            package="Basic Website",
            currency="USD",
            status="Payment Pending",
        )
        login("stripe-success@example.com", "customer")

        fake_session = self._make_stripe_session()

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.stripe.stripe.checkout.Session.create",
            return_value=fake_session,
        ):
            response = client.post(
                f"/payment/stripe/checkout/{project_id}",
                data={"csrf_token": csrf_token},
                follow_redirects=False,
            )

        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is True
        assert data["session_id"] == "cs_test_123"
        assert data["currency"] == "USD"
        assert data["url"] == fake_session.url

        with app.app_context():
            payment = Payment.query.filter_by(
                stripe_session_id="cs_test_123"
            ).first()
            assert payment is not None
            assert payment.status == "Created"
            assert payment.gateway_type == "stripe"
            assert payment.currency == "USD"

    def test_unsupported_currency_rejected(

        )

        data = json.loads(response.data)
        assert data["success"] is False

    def test_reuses_existing_created_session(
        self, app, client, login, factories, csrf_token
    ):
        customer_id = factories.user("customer", "stripe-reuse@example.com")
        project_id = factories.project(
            customer_id,
            package="Basic Website",
            currency="USD",
            status="Payment Pending",
        )
        payment = Payment(
            project_id=project_id,
            customer_id=customer_id,
            stripe_session_id="cs_existing_123",
            gateway_type="stripe",
            amount=Decimal("349.50"),
            currency="USD",
            status="Created",
        )
        from app.extensions import db as _db
        _db.session.add(payment)
        _db.session.commit()
        login("stripe-reuse@example.com", "customer")

        with patch(
            "app.blueprints.payments.stripe.stripe.checkout.Session.create",

class TestStripeWebhook:
    def _make_stripe_event(
        self, event_id="evt_test_123", event_type="checkout.session.completed",
        project_id=1, amount_total=34950, currency="usd",
        payment_status="paid",
    ):
        return {
            "id": event_id,
            "type": event_type,
            "data": {
                "object": {
                    "id": "cs_test_123",
                    "metadata": {
                        "project_id": str(project_id),
                    },
                    "amount_total": amount_total,
                    "currency": currency,
                    "payment_status": payment_status,
                }
            },
        }

    def test_invalid_signature_rejected(self, app, client):

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
from datetime import datetime
from types import SimpleNamespace
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from app.models import (
    AgencySetting,
    Invoice,
    Payment,
    Project,
    RazorpaySubscription,
    RazorpaySubscriptionPlan,
    SubscriptionCharge,
    get_ist_now,
)


STARTER_RETAINER_AMOUNT = 14999


def _subscription_event(
    subscription_id="sub_starter_test",
    payment_id="pay_starter_test",
    amount=STARTER_RETAINER_AMOUNT * 100,
    status="captured",
):
    return {
        "event": "subscription.charged",
        "payload": {
            "subscription": {
                "entity": {
                    "id": subscription_id,
                    "plan_id": "plan_starter_test",
                    "status": "active",
                    "notes": {"project_id": "1", "customer_id": "1"},
                }
            },
            "payment": {
                "entity": {
                    "id": payment_id,
                    "amount": amount,
                    "currency": "INR",
                    "status": status,
                    "order_id": f"order_{payment_id}",
                }
            },
        },
    }


def _post_signed_webhook(client, monkeypatch, payload, event_id="evt_starter_test"):
    secret = "test-subscription-webhook-secret"
    monkeypatch.setenv("RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET", secret)
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    headers = {"X-Razorpay-Signature": signature}
    if event_id:
        headers["X-Razorpay-Event-Id"] = event_id
    return client.post(
        "/subscription/webhook",
        data=body,
        content_type="application/json",
        headers=headers,
    )


def _create_local_subscription(db, project_id, customer_id):
    plan = RazorpaySubscriptionPlan(
        code="starter_seo_retainer",
        razorpay_plan_id="plan_starter_test",
        name="Starter SEO Retainer",
        amount=STARTER_RETAINER_AMOUNT,
        currency="INR",
    )
    db.session.add(plan)
    db.session.flush()
    subscription = RazorpaySubscription(
        project_id=project_id,
        customer_id=customer_id,
        plan_id=plan.id,
        razorpay_subscription_id="sub_starter_test",
        amount=STARTER_RETAINER_AMOUNT,
        currency="INR",
        status="active",
        start_at=datetime(2026, 12, 1, 9, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Asia/Kolkata")),
    )
    db.session.add(subscription)
    db.session.commit()
    return subscription


def test_subscription_creation_is_owned_retainer_only_and_idempotent(
    client, db, factories, login, csrf_token, monkeypatch
):
    customer_id = factories.customer("subscription-client@example.com")
    project_id = factories.project(
        customer_id,
        package="Starter Retainer",
        service="SEO Retainer & Growth",
    )
    login("subscription-client@example.com", "customer")

    calls = {"plans": 0, "subscriptions": 0, "subscription_data": None}

    def create_plan(data):
        calls["plans"] += 1
        assert data["period"] == "monthly"
        assert data["interval"] == 1
        assert data["item"]["amount"] == STARTER_RETAINER_AMOUNT * 100
        return {"id": "plan_starter_created"}

    def create_subscription(data):
        calls["subscriptions"] += 1
        calls["subscription_data"] = data
        return {"id": "sub_starter_created", "status": "created"}

    import app.blueprints.payments as payments_mod

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        payments_mod,
        "razorpay_client",
        SimpleNamespace(
            plan=SimpleNamespace(create=create_plan),
            subscription=SimpleNamespace(create=create_subscription),
        ),
    )
    db.session.add(AgencySetting(
        id=1,
        agency_name="Northstar Studio",
        primary_color="#1a76c2",
    ))
    db.session.commit()

    headers = {"X-CSRFToken": csrf_token}
    response = client.post(
        f"/subscription/create/{project_id}",
        json={},
        headers=headers,
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.get_json()
    assert data["success"] is True
    assert data["subscription_id"] == "sub_starter_created"
    assert data["amount"] == STARTER_RETAINER_AMOUNT * 100
    assert data["agency_name"] == "Northstar Studio"
    assert data["primary_color"] == "#1a76c2"
    assert calls["plans"] == 1
    assert calls["subscriptions"] == 1
    assert calls["subscription_data"]["total_count"] == 12
    local_subscription = RazorpaySubscription.query.one()
    assert calls["subscription_data"]["notes"] == {
        "project_id": str(project_id),
        "customer_id": str(customer_id),
        "local_subscription_id": str(local_subscription.id),
    }
    scheduled = datetime.fromtimestamp(
        calls["subscription_data"]["start_at"],
        tz=ZoneInfo("Asia/Kolkata"),
    )
    assert (scheduled.day, scheduled.hour, scheduled.minute) == (1, 9, 0)
    expected_month = (get_ist_now().month % 12) + 1
    assert scheduled.month == expected_month

    repeated = client.post(
        f"/subscription/create/{project_id}",
        json={},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert repeated.status_code == 200
    assert repeated.get_json()["subscription_id"] == "sub_starter_created"
    assert calls["plans"] == 1
    assert calls["subscriptions"] == 1
    assert RazorpaySubscription.query.count() == 1
    assert RazorpaySubscriptionPlan.query.one().razorpay_plan_id == "plan_starter_created"

    "/payment/create-order/<int:project_id>",
    "/payment/verify",
    "/professional/dashboard",
    "/professional/my-projects",
    "/professional/profile",
    "/professional/project/<int:project_id>",
    "/professional/project/<int:project_id>/resubmit",
    "/professional/project/<int:project_id>/start",
    "/professional/project/<int:project_id>/submit",
    "/professional/projects",
    "/professional/projects/<int:project_id>/apply",
    "/project/<int:project_id>",
    "/register",
    "/requirements/<service_slug>",
    "/start-project/<service_slug>",
}

SAMPLE_VALUES = {
    "project_id": 1,
    "business_id": 1,
    "application_id": 1,
    "profile_id": 1,
    "service_slug": "website-development",
    "filename": "app.css",
}

def template_url_for_names():
    """Collect every endpoint name referenced by url_for in templates."""
    pattern = re.compile(r"url_for\(\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)")
    names = set()
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "templates", "*.html")):
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            names.update(pattern.findall(fh.read()))
    return names

class SmokeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.app = create_app("development")
        cls.app.config["TESTING"] = True
        with cls.app.app_context():
            db.create_all()
            customer = User(
                name="Smoke Customer",
                email="smoke-customer@example.com",
                password=generate_password_hash("SmokePass123!"),
                role="customer",
            )
            db.session.add(customer)
            db.session.flush()
            db.session.add(CustomerProfile(user_id=customer.id))
            professional = User(
                name="Smoke Pro",
                email="smoke-pro@example.com",
                password=generate_password_hash("SmokePass123!"),
                role="professional",
            )
            admin = User(
                name="Smoke Admin",
                email="smoke-admin@example.com",
                password=generate_password_hash("SmokePass123!"),
                role="admin",
            )
            db.session.add_all([professional, admin])
            db.session.flush()
            project = Project(
                customer_id=customer.id,
                service="Website Design & Development",
                package="Basic Website",
                requirements="Smoke test project",
                status="Draft",
            )
            db.session.add(project)
            db.session.commit()
            cls.customer_id = customer.id
            cls.admin_id = admin.id
            cls.project_id = project.id
        cls.client = cls.app.test_client()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Startup / route registration
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def test_app_boots(self):
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.app)

    def test_route_map_matches_legacy(self):
        rules = {str(r) for r in self.app.url_map.iter_rules()}
        missing = LEGACY_ROUTES - rules
        self.assertFalse(missing, f"Missing legacy routes: {sorted(missing)}")

    def test_no_doubled_url_prefixes(self):
        rules = {str(r) for r in self.app.url_map.iter_rules()}
        doubled = [
            r for r in rules
            if r.startswith(("/admin/admin", "/api/api", "/payment/payment"))
        ]
        self.assertEqual(doubled, [], f"Doubled prefixes present: {doubled}")

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # URL generation
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def test_bare_endpoint_resolution(self):
        with self.app.test_request_context():
            from flask import url_for
            self.assertEqual(url_for("dashboard"), "/dashboard")
            self.assertEqual(url_for("index"), "/")
            self.assertEqual(url_for("login"), "/login")
            self.assertEqual(url_for("logout"), "/logout")
            self.assertEqual(url_for("register"), "/register")
            self.assertEqual(url_for("admin_dashboard"), "/admin/dashboard")
            self.assertEqual(url_for("api_services"), "/api/services")
            self.assertEqual(
                url_for("payment_page", project_id=1), "/payment/1"
            )
            self.assertEqual(url_for("verify_payment"), "/payment/verify")

    def test_qualified_endpoints_still_work(self):
        with self.app.test_request_context():
            from flask import url_for
            self.assertEqual(url_for("customer.dashboard"), "/dashboard")
            self.assertEqual(url_for("auth.index"), "/")
            self.assertEqual(
                url_for("admin.admin_dashboard"), "/admin/dashboard"
            )

    def test_all_template_endpoint_references_build(self):
        unresolved = []
        with self.app.test_request_context():
            from flask import url_for
            for name in sorted(template_url_for_names()):
                try:
                    url_for(name, **SAMPLE_VALUES)
                except BuildError:
                    unresolved.append(name)
        self.assertEqual(
            unresolved, [],
            f"Template url_for endpoints that fail to build: {unresolved}"
        )

    def test_unknown_endpoint_still_raises_build_error(self):
        with self.app.test_request_context():
            from flask import url_for
            with self.assertRaises(BuildError):
                url_for("no_such_endpoint_anywhere")

    def test_ambiguous_bare_names_rejected_at_startup(self):
        def _a(): pass
        def _b(): pass
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as ctx:
            _build_bare_endpoint_map({"one.foo": _a, "two.foo": _b})
        self.assertIn("foo", str(ctx.exception))

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # .env loading & precedence (subprocess; no secrets printed)
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def _run_env_check(self, extra_env):
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite:///:memory:"
        env.update(extra_env)
        script = (
            "import os, sys\n"
            f"sys.path.insert(0, {BASE_DIR!r})\n"
            "import app.config  # triggers load_dotenv\n"
            "checks = []\n"
            "checks.append(('SECRET_KEY_LOADED',"
            " bool(os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY')) and"
            f" os.environ['SECRET_KEY'] != {SECRET_KEY_FALLBACK!r}))\n"
            "checks.append(('RAZORPAY_KEY_ID_LOADED',"
            " bool(os.environ.get('RAZORPAY_KEY_ID'))))\n"
            "if 'EXPECTED_SECRET_KEY' in os.environ:\n"
            "    checks.append(('PRESERVED_PRESET_SECRET_KEY',"
            " os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY')"
            " == os.environ['EXPECTED_SECRET_KEY']))\n"
            "print(','.join(f'{k}={int(v)}' for k, v in checks))\n"
        )
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-c", script],
            capture_output=True, text=True, env=env,
            cwd=BASE_DIR, timeout=120,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            result.returncode, 0,
            f"subprocess failed: {result.stderr[-500:]}",
        )
        return result.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]

    def test_env_file_is_loaded(self):
        # Without a pre-set SECRET_KEY, .env values must take effect and
        # the insecure fallback must NOT be used.
        out = self._run_env_check({})
        self.assertIn("SECRET_KEY_LOADED=1", out)
        self.assertIn("RAZORPAY_KEY_ID_LOADED=1", out)

    def test_env_precedence_preserves_existing_vars(self):
        # A SECRET_KEY already in the environment must NOT be
        # overridden by .env (dotenv default behavior).
        out = self._run_env_check(
            {
                "SECRET_KEY": "precedence-test-value",
                "EXPECTED_SECRET_KEY": "precedence-test-value",
            }
        )
        self.assertIn("PRESERVED_PRESET_SECRET_KEY=1", out)


    def test_real_app_bare_map_has_no_ambiguity(self):
        # create_app() succeeded in setUpClass, which already proves the
        # real endpoint set is unambiguous; re-check the helper directly.
        _build_bare_endpoint_map(self.app.view_functions)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Page smoke tests (auth behavior unchanged)
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def _login(self, email, role):
        return self.client.post(
            "/login",
            data={
                "email": email,
                "password": "SmokePass123!",
                "login_role": role,
            },
            follow_redirects=False,
        )

    def test_public_pages_render(self):
        for path in ("/", "/login", "/register"):
            response = self.client.get(path)
            self.assertEqual(
                response.status_code, 200, f"{path} -> {response.status_code}"
            )

    def test_protected_page_redirects_anonymous(self):
        # Fresh client so no login session from another test leaks in.
        anon = self.app.test_client()
        response = anon.get("/dashboard", follow_redirects=False)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        self.assertIn("/login", response.headers["Location"])

    def test_customer_login_and_dashboard(self):
        response = self._login("smoke-customer@example.com", "customer")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        self.assertEqual(response.headers["Location"], "/dashboard")
        for path in ("/dashboard", "/businesses", "/customer/profile"):
            page = self.client.get(path)
            self.assertEqual(
                page.status_code, 200, f"{path} -> {response.status_code}"
            )

    def test_customer_blocked_from_admin(self):
        self._login("smoke-customer@example.com", "customer")
        response = self.client.get("/admin/dashboard", follow_redirects=False)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        self.assertEqual(response.headers["Location"], "/dashboard")

    def test_admin_login_and_admin_dashboard(self):
        response = self._login("smoke-admin@example.com", "admin")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        self.assertEqual(response.headers["Location"], "/admin/dashboard")
        page = self.client.get("/admin/dashboard")
        self.assertEqual(page.status_code, 200)

    def test_professional_login_and_dashboard(self):
        response = self._login("smoke-pro@example.com", "professional")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        self.assertEqual(
            response.headers["Location"], "/professional/dashboard"
        )
        page = self.client.get("/professional/dashboard")
        self.assertEqual(page.status_code, 200)

    def test_payment_page_renders_for_owner(self):
        self._login("smoke-customer@example.com", "customer")
        page = self.client.get(f"/payment/{self.project_id}")
        self.assertEqual(page.status_code, 200)

    def test_payment_page_blocked_for_other_customer(self):
        other = User(
            name="Other Customer",
            email="smoke-other@example.com",
            password=generate_password_hash("SmokePass123!"),
            role="customer",
        )
        with self.app.app_context():
            db.session.add(other)
            db.session.commit()
        self._login("smoke-other@example.com", "customer")
        response = self.client.get(
            f"/payment/{self.project_id}", follow_redirects=False
        )
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # API
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def test_api_services(self):
        response = self.client.get("/api/services")
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        data = response.get_json()
        self.assertIsInstance(data, list)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(data), 1)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PACKAGE_PRICES coverage of project packages in this DB
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def test_package_prices_covers_project_packages(self):
        with self.app.app_context():
            stored = {p.package for p in Project.query.all()}
        missing = stored - set(PACKAGE_PRICES)
        self.assertFalse(
            missing, f"Packages missing from PACKAGE_PRICES: {missing}"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
